title: Transcript:'Beedy-eye' Jones
content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
* {{trandom}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 1}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
** '''Player:''' No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
** '''Player:''' Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
** '''Player:''' 'Bye.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 2}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
** '''Player:''' More info than I wanted, thanks!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 3}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
** '''Player:''' No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Oh, sorry, my mistake then. 
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
** '''Player:''' Why, what do they usually look like?
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Erm... I've never actually met one...
** '''Player:''' Okay then...
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 4}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' Brrrr! Its cold up here!
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
** '''Player:''' REALLY?
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 5}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' So... You're a pirate, huh?
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
** '''Player:''' How's that working out for you?
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
** '''Player:''' You mean you have insurance?
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
** '''Player:''' I can imagine.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 6}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
** '''Player:''' Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
** '''Player:''' Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 7}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Hello to you too.
** '''Player:''' Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
** '''Player:''' Oh. Okay. Sorry.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 8}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' So how's life as a pirate?
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
** '''Player:''' I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' What does that entail then?
** '''Player:''' Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
** '''Player:''' I collect stuff.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' So how's that life?
** '''Player:''' Can't complain, can't complain...
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Well, there you go.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 9}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
** '''Player:''' I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 10}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
** '''Player:''' I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
** ''' 'Beedy-eye' Jones:''' Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
** {{tact|end}}

title: Transcript:'Beefy' Burns
content:

content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

title: Transcript:'Gummy'
content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue before [[Tower of Life]]==

* '''<nowiki>'Gummy'</nowiki>:''' Rock, Paper, Scissors. Can't you tell?
* '''Player:''' It was more of a rhetorical question.
* '''<nowiki>'Gummy'</nowiki>:''' Rhetora-what?
* '''Player:''' Shouldn't you be working?
* '''<nowiki>'Gummy'</nowiki>:''' We are. It's team building.

* '''<nowiki>'Gummy':</nowiki>''' It's a draw at the moment. First it was best of three, then it was best of five.
* '''Player:''' And now?
* '''<nowiki>'Gummy':</nowiki>''' Best of a hundred and one.
* {{tact|end}}

title: Transcript:'No fingers'
content:
{{Transcript|npc}}
==Standard dialogue==
===Before [[Tower of Life]]===
* '''Player:''' You seem to like playing with danger, there.
* '''<nowiki>'No fingers':</nowiki>''' They don't call me 'No-fingers' for nothing!
* '''Player:''' Well, correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to have all your fingers.
* '''<nowiki>'No fingers':</nowiki>''' It may seem that way mate, but I think you'll find I don't have any.
* '''Player:''' What?
* '''<nowiki>'No fingers':</nowiki>''' These not be fingers. These 'ere be wooden fingers.
* '''Player:''' Wooden fingers?
* '''<nowiki>'No fingers':</nowiki>''' Yep.
* '''Player:''' That's not possible, how could you move them?
* '''<nowiki>'No fingers':</nowiki>''' Magic wood.
* '''Player:''' Yes, well I think I'd better be going now.
* {{tact|end}}

===After [[Tower of Life]]===
* '''Player:''' Hi.
* '''<nowiki>'No fingers':</nowiki>''' Don't suppose you've seen any boots around here? Size nine, steel toed, brown leather...
* '''Player:''' Nope, not at all. I'd best be going. Have a nice day. Bye!
* {{tact|end}}

** '''Player:''' I collect stuff.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' So how's that life?
** '''Player:''' Can't complain, can't complain...
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Well, there you go.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 2}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
** '''Player:''' More info than I wanted, thanks!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 3}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
** '''Player:''' I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 4}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
** '''Player:''' No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
** '''Player:''' Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
** '''Player:''' 'Bye.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 5}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' Brrrr! Its cold up here!
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
** '''Player:''' REALLY?
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 6}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Hello to you too.
** '''Player:''' Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
** '''Player:''' Oh. Okay. Sorry.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 7}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
** '''Player:''' No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
** '''Player:''' Why, what do they usually look like?
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Erm... I've never actually met one...
** '''Player:''' Okay then...
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 8}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' So... You're a pirate, huh?
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
** '''Player:''' How's that working out for you?
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
** '''Player:''' You mean you have insurance?
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
** '''Player:''' I can imagine.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 9}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
** '''Player:''' Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
** '''Player:''' Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 10}}
** '''Player:''' Hello.
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
** '''Player:''' I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
** ''' 'Sticky' Sanders:''' Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
** {{tact|end}}

{{Transcript list|Gnome child|Hans|Captain Tobias|Sir Tiffy Cashien|Seaman Lorris|Seaman Thresnor}}

==Starting out==
===Speaking to Gnome child===
* '''Player:''' Hello, what are you doing here?
* '''Gnome child:''' I was visiting Lumbridge and a terrible thing has happened.
* '''Player:''' Oh no! What unfortunate series of event have befallen you?
* '''Gnome child:''' I have lost my hat, it is the source of everything that makes me what I am.
* '''Player:''' And what are you?
* '''Gnome child:''' Incomprehensible to those of lesser perception.
* '''Player:''' Ooookayyy... Do you want some help?
* '''Gnome child:''' Yes, my hat must be somewhere close by. I'd imagine if you ask someone who always hangs around here, they may have seen it.
* '''Player:''' I'm on it boss!
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking to Hans===
* '''Hans:''' Hello. What are you doing here?
* {{topt|Gnomechild's missing hat.}}
** '''Player:''' Hans! Hans! You've been walking around this courtyard since we were two dimensional, have you seen the Gnome Child's hat? He has lost it.
** '''Hans:''' Ummm... a little green hat? Yes, a seagull picked it up and flew off.
** '''Player:''' Really? A seagull picked up a hat? Can they do that?
** '''Hans:''' So it seems! I'm afraid I didn't happen to see which way it went.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|event=No|Talk about something else.}}

===Speaking to Captain Tobias, Seaman Lorris, or Seaman Thresnor=== <!--all have the same dialogue-->
* {{topt|Gnomechild's missing hat.}}
** '''Player:''' Hey, this is a bit of a long shot, but have you seen a seagull carrying a small green conical hat?
** '''Captain Tobias:''' Any other day I'd ask if you've been on the Karamjan rum, but today has been an odd day for hats.
** '''Player:''' What do you mean?
** '''Captain Tobias:''' Well... I'm sure I saw an old man in White armour walk by earlier wearing the hat you described.
** '''Player:''' Brilliant, thanks!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|event=No|Talk about something else.}}

===Speaking to Sir Tiffy Cashien===
* {{topt|Gnomechild's missing hat.}}
** '''Sir Tiffy Cashien:''' What ho, [milady/sirrah]. Have you come for the present?
** '''Player:''' What?
** '''Sir Tiffy Cashien:''' You are the courier I sent for to collect this present?
** '''Player:''' Er yes, of course. Courier, that's me. I'm from the umm... Castle Courier Service.
** '''Sir Tiffy Cashien:''' Jolly good, it is for my grandson you see. His name is Ebel Lum. I hope one day he'll follow in my footsteps and become a White Knight.
** '''Player:''' Did you get your grandson anything nice?
** '''Sir Tiffy Cashien:''' Why yes, I found a green hat that would fit him perfectly.
** '''Player:''' I'm sure he'll love it. I better be off now, I wouldn't want to be late.
** '''Sir Tiffy Cashien:''' Please look after the present, I wouldn't want my grandson to think I forgot his birthday.
** {{tbox|Sir Tiffy Cashien hands you a nicely wrapped present.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|event=No|Talk about something else.}}

===Speaking to Sir Tiffy Cashien again===
* {{topt|Gnomechild's missing hat.}}
** '''Sir Tiffy Cashien:''' Please look after the present, I wouldn't want my grandson to think I forgot his birthday.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|event=No|Talk about something else.}}

===Speaking to Gnome child===
* '''Player:''' All hail! I have thou hat of power oh magnificent one!
* '''Gnome child:''' Why are you talking like that?
* '''Player:''' Oh sorry, I mean... I have found your hat in this box.
* '''Gnome child:''' No you haven't.
* '''Player:''' Huh?
* '''Gnome child:''' I've got my hat back already.
* '''Player:''' So what's in this box?
* '''Gnome child:''' The hat is being considered to be simultaneously present and absent until the box is opened and the hat observed.
* '''Player:''' I don't think I understood any of that.
* '''Gnome child:''' Open it and find out!
* {{tact|end}}

==Post-event dialogue==
===Gnome child===
* '''Gnome child:''' I'm so glad I found my hat, it's a shame you couldn't have been more help!
* '''Player:''' Uhh...
* {{tmissing}}

* {{tmissing}}

title: Transcript:2016 Christmas event

content:
{{Transcript|event}}
{{Transcript list|Easter Bunny}}

==Starting out==
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Terrible... just terrible...
* '''Player:''' What happened this time?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' It's the evil chocolate chicken you see, it's destroyed everything.
* '''Player:''' What chicken? Look, you're all ruffled, calm down and tell me what happened.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' While preparing to produce this year's chocolate eggs, I was visited by a travelling merchant. He persuaded me to buy this potion for making the chocolate taste better...
* '''Player:''' Let me guess... it didn't.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' No... as soon as I added it to the mix, it started to bubble and that terrible thing came out of it. I bet that merchant was sent by Anti Santa.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Only he's locked up in Scape Rune{{sic}} for attempting to ruin Christmas.
* '''Player:''' Interesting, perhaps someone is carrying on his fowl work in his absence?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' *Sigh* Yes, the chicken - and it destroyed everything in the workshop, and ate some of the eggs that had presents in them.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Those presents have given the chicken the ability to teleport out of reach of anyone who attempts to capture it. Unless someone can startle the chicken into relinquishing all the presents, Easter's going to flop.
* '''Player:''' And I'm going to guess that you're asking me to do just that?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Oh would you? That would be great!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Easter Bunny again===
* '''Easter Bunny:''' How are you getting on with the chicken?
* '''Player:''' Not touched a feather.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' But it's destroying my workshop! It's eating my supplies! It's got to be stopped!
* '''Player:''' Ok, ok, keep your ears on. I just had to pluck up my courage.
* {{tact|end}}

===Entering the workshop===
* '''Player:''' Now to find that pesky chicken and chase it off.
* {{tact|end}}

===Chasing the chicken===
* {{tcond|After catching it for the eighth time:}}
* '''Player:''' Ha! Had enough running away have you?
* {{tact|end}}

===Destroying the chicken===
* '''Player:''' What a fowl beast. Looks like I finally got rid of that pesky thing.
* {{tbox|pic=Chronicle detail.png|The chicken leaves behind an odd book.}}
* {{tact|end}}

==Finishing up==
* '''Player:''' I did it! That chicken really went to pieces!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' That's great! Thanks to you, Easter can go ahead, albeit a little late this year.
* '''Player:''' It dropped some kind of Chronicle for storing these teleport cards.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Oh, you can keep it for your hard work - if you need another or more cards, I'm sure Diango can help you out.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Here, take these as a reward.
* {{tact|end}}

===Post event dialogue===
* '''Player:''' Hello! How's easter{{sic}} going?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Great thank you!
* {{tact|end}}

{{Transcript|event}}
{{Transcript list|Anti-Santa|Beverly|Bill|Georgie|Jack Frost|Jess (2019 Christmas event)|Mary (2019 Christmas event){{!}}Mary|Paul (2019 Christmas event){{!}}Paul|Santa Claus|Worried Baker|Icelord (2019 Christmas event)|Icelord}}

==Before starting the event==
===Speaking to the Worried Baker===
* '''Player:''' Hello there friend.
* '''Worried Baker:''' Oh..what am I to do, Christmas is ruined.
* '''Player:''' What's the matter?
* '''Worried Baker:''' Christmas is ruined, my bakery is ruined, everything is ruined!
* '''Player:''' Maybe this has something to do with Santa in Varrock Square.
* {{tact|end}}

===Attempting to go down the trapdoor===
* '''Player:''' Never noticed this before, maybe Santa in Varrock Square will know something about it.
* {{tact|end}}

==Starting out==
===Speaking to the children===
{{tact|Speaking to [[Beverly]], [[Bill]], [[Georgie]], or [[Jess (2019 Christmas event)|Jess]] will result in the same dialogue:}}
* '''Player:''' Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
* '''Child:''' Christmas is ruined!
* '''Player:''' Again? What's happened this time?
* '''Child:''' The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
* '''Player:''' That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
* '''Child:''' Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
* '''Player:''' Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
* '''Child:''' Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
* {{tact|end}}

====Speaking to a child before continuing with the event====
* '''Child:''' Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
* '''Player:''' I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
* '''Child:''' Hurry up!
* {{tact|end}}

====Overhead dialogue====
* {{trandom}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 1}}
** '''Child:''' {{overhead|You've ruined Christmas!}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 2}}
** '''Child:''' {{overhead|Give us the Gnomes!}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 3}}
** '''Child:''' {{overhead|Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!}}

===Speaking to Santa===
* '''Player:''' Hello Santa, long time no see!
* '''Santa:''' Ho Ho Hello [player name], it certainly has been a long time.
* '''Player:''' Quick question, why are you hanging out with a bunch of angry children?
* '''Santa:''' Christmas is ruined! My son, Jack Frost, has messed it all up!
* '''Santa:''' I put him in charge of this year's Christmas to learn some much needed responsibility.
* '''Santa:''' All he does is sit at home, eating my mince pies, drinking my eggnog and throwing snowballs at my elves.
* '''Player:''' So why has that caused a problem with the Gingerbread Gnomes?
* '''Santa:''' A major part of my job is overseeing Gingerbread Gnome production here in Varrock. I like to... ensure production is top quality... and do some taste testing from time to time.
* '''Santa:''' As soon as he stepped in, production came to a stand still. I need my Gingerbread Gnomes, it's part of my balanced diet.
* '''Player:''' So why don't you go help him out instead of standing around Varrock?
* '''Santa:''' I'm trying a new parenting technique, he needs to learn from his mistakes.
* '''Santa:''' But in the mean time, could you go and have a word with him? The bakery is south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
* '''Player:''' Great, now this is my problem, thanks Santa.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Santa without going to the bakery====
* '''Santa:''' Have you managed to solve the problem at the Bakery yet?
* '''Santa:''' In case you forgot, the bakery is just south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
* '''Player:''' I'm still working on it.
* '''Santa:''' Hurry it along would you, I'm getting quite hungry.
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking to the baker outside the bakery===
* '''Player:''' Hello there friend.
* '''Worried Baker:''' Adventurer! You've come at the right time. I need your help.
* '''Player:''' Could this have something to do with some missing Gingerbread Gnomes?
* '''Worried Baker:''' How did you know?
* '''Player:''' Santa told me to sort it out for him, he said his son has taken over the Gingerbread Gnome production.
* '''Worried Baker:''' He has been an absolute disaster, he suddenly showed up and took control of our bakery. We tried to stop him, but he locked up the two other bakers!
* '''Player:''' How did you manage to escape?
* '''Worried Baker:''' Well... I don't think he knows how Gingerbread Gnomes are made, he brought in an Icelord to ice the gingerbread.
* '''Worried Baker:''' I threw a stone at it to cause a distraction, giving me a chance to escape. After I got out, I heard Jack lock the entrance behind me.
* '''Player:''' He brought in an Icelord!? I don't know how to deal with one of those.
* '''Worried Baker:''' It's terrifying! I think Jack must have a few screws loose to think that was a good idea.
* '''Player:''' Well, I better tell Santa, since I can't get into the bakery from here....
* '''Worried Baker:''' Please hurry, we need to restart production as soon as possible.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to the Worried Baker before going back to Santa====
* '''Worried Baker:''' Have you managed to free the other bakers and stop Jack Frost yet?
* '''Player:''' Not yet, I'm still working on it.
* '''Worried Baker:''' Hurry we need to get back into production, before it's too late.
* {{tact|end}}

==Anti-Santa and the Jack Frost duel==
* '''Player:''' Hello again Santa.
* '''Santa:''' Ho Ho Hello [player name], have you managed to sort out my son?
* '''Player:''' Not yet, I found the bakery and it appears Jack has thrown a tantrum....
* '''Santa:''' Oh dear, what has he done?
* '''Player:''' Well he's locked the bakers up and brought in an Icelord.
* '''Player:''' One of the bakers managed to escape and is outside.
* '''Santa:''' Where did I go wrong... Jack used to be such a happy young boy.
* '''Santa:''' Looks like I'm going to need to step in if we're going to save Christmas.
* '''Player:''' Great! So you're going to go and talk to him?
* '''Santa:''' Ho Ho Ho, of course not [player name], I've got a better idea.
* '''Player:''' Fantastic... and that is?
* '''Santa:''' You're going to bring Anti-Santa to sort him out, Jack is terrified of him.
* {{tcond|If the player has completed any Christmas event involving [[Anti-Santa]]:}}
** '''Player:''' Anti-Santa?! No way am I freeing him after all that work a few years ago.
** '''Santa:''' Don't you think I know that! We have no choice I'm afraid.
** '''Player:''' I'm sure we can come up with something better than freeing him.
** '''Santa:''' Well if you have a better idea, spit it out.
** '''Player:''' ...
** '''Santa:''' Thought so, now I'm going to need you to free him from his prison in ScapeRune.
** '''Player:''' How am I going to do that? Evil Bob took him away....
** '''Santa:''' Yes, but we don't need Evil Bob's help this time, I can teleport you into his cell.
** '''Santa:''' You'll still need to convince him to help us though.
** {{tact|continues}}
* {{tcond|If the player has not completed any Christmas event involving Anti-Santa:}}
** '''Player:''' Anti-Santa? Never heard of him, sound's{{sic}} like an edgy version of you.
** '''Santa:''' He certainly has his... unique aspects to his personality.
** '''Santa:''' But he'll be very useful for scaring Jack. There aren't many things Jack's afraid of, but that giant skeleton is one of them.
** '''Player:''' Where can I find Anti-Santa? I've never come across him in my travels.
** '''Santa:''' A few years ago, Evil Bob locked him away in ScapeRune.
** '''Player:''' Great, I'm sure if we wait long enough, Evil Bob will appear out of nowhere....
** '''Santa:''' We don't have time for that, he trusted me to look after him. Evil Bob was tired of dealing with his dirty laundry.
** '''Santa:''' I'll teleport you right into his cell, you're going to need to convince him to help us.
** {{tact|continues}}
* '''Player:''' Surely he'll still be angry about last time?
* '''Santa:''' Most likely, but if you tell him that I'm considering setting him free, he'll change his tune.
* '''Santa:''' Take this as well. After you've convinced him to help, you can use this to teleport both of you to the bakery.
* {{tcond|If the player has a full inventory:}}
** '''Santa:''' You've got too much on you, come back when you've got some free space.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tbox|Santa gives you a teleport tablet to teleport you to the bakery.}}
* {{tact|receives=a [[Scaperune teleport]]}}
* {{Qact|Fade to black, player appears in [[ScapeRune#Prison|ScapeRune prison]]}}
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Ha Ha Ha. Well if it isn't [player name], why do you dare enter my domain....
* {{tcond|If the player has completed any Christmas event involving [[Anti-Santa]]:}}
** '''Player:''' Long time no see Anti-Santa, how's prison life been treating you?
** '''Anti-Santa:''' It has been glorious, you may have thought me to be rotting inside these walls, but I've been coming up with plot to end Christmas once and for all!
** '''Anti-Santa:''' You may of {{sic}} stopped me all those years ago, but you didn't stop my mind.
** '''Anti-Santa:''' Soon I'll escape these walls and there'll be naught to stop me.
** '''Anti-Santa:''' This pathetic holiday will come to an end and I'll laugh as it burns.
** '''Anti-Santa:''' That red buffoon will not be able to stop me, nor you, nor that dumb cat!
** {{tact|continues}}
* {{tcond|If the player has not completed any Christmas event involving Anti-Santa:}}
** '''Player:''' Anti-Santa, Santa told me all about you.
** '''Anti-Santa:''' Don't mention his name to me, he's everything I hate about this repulsive holiday, I have always dreamed about tearing down this revolting time of year.
** '''Anti-Santa:''' Years ago I almost succeeded, but I was thwarted by that red buffoon and some dumb cat!
** '''Anti-Santa:''' But in the years I've been locked away, I've been plotting and scheming. When I escape from this cell....
** '''Anti-Santa:''' Yes, Christmas will never be the same, children will be crying instead of laughing!
** '''Anti-Santa:''' The streets will be cold and lifeless.
** {{tact|continues}}
* '''Anti-Santa:''' I will stop Christmas once and for all!
* '''Anti-Santa:''' And soon it will be the year of the Anti-Christmas!
* '''Player:''' *Snores*
* '''Anti-Santa:''' OI!
* '''Player:''' *Wakes up* Oh sorry! You were going on for a bit, I thought it'd never end.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' You've been moved to the top of my kill list [player name].
* '''Player:''' Let's cut to the chase, I need your help Anti-Santa.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Oh, so you've come begging to me for help, what makes you think I would help you?
* '''Player:''' What other choice do you have? It looks incredibly boring in this cell.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Well, that's true, but I'd rather that than help you.
* '''Player:''' You're so over dramatic. Santa said he'd consider freeing you only if you help us.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Oh did he... ...now might be my chance to escape this cell... you know what. I will help you.
* '''Player:''' Finally, he needs you to deal with Jack Frost at a bakery in Varrock.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Is that it? Why can't he do it himself?
* '''Player:''' He's testing a new parenting technique.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Really? How are we meant to get into this bakery?
* '''Player:''' He gave me this teleport tablet, it will take us right inside of the bakery.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' After all these years, he's still making adventurers do his dirty work. He's just as bad as me.
* '''Player:''' Trust me, I'm getting tired of it as well, we need to go before it's too late.
* {{Qact|Player teleports, fade to black, appears in workshop with Anti-Santa}}
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Ha Ha Ha If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
* '''Jack Frost:''' A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' I'm here to sort you out.
* '''Jack Frost:''' What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
* '''Anti-Santa:''' When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
* '''Jack Frost:''' You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
* '''Jack Frost:''' I won't let you stop me. Take this!
* {{tact|Jack Frost casts [[Water Blast]], dealing 0 damage.}}
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
* '''Jack Frost:''' Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
* '''Anti-Santa:''' You're weak just like your father.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
* {{tact|Anti-Santa casts [[Fire Surge]], dealing 60 damage.}}
* '''Jack Frost:''' Argh!
* '''Jack Frost:''' You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' Good thing I'm not done yet.
* '''Anti-Santa:''' I learned this from an old friend of mine.
* '''Jack Frost:''' {{overhead|Ouch!}}

title: Transcript:2020 Birthday event

content:
{{Transcript|event}}
{{Transcript list|Scrubfoot|General Wartface|General Bentnoze|Goblin Cook|Grubfoot}}

==Before starting the event==
===Attempting to close doors at the Goblin Village===
* {{tbox|The door seems frozen in place.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Searching the Treasure chest===
* {{tbox|There is nothing of interest in there.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Attempting to enter the cave===
====Prior to a game update on 6 January 2021====
* '''Player:''' The cave smells funny. I'd rather not go in there without a good reason.
* {{tact|end}}

====After a game update on 6 January 2021 (post-event)====
* {{qact|The camera fades to black and player enters the cave.}}

===Scrubfoot at Goblin Village===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Scrubfoot busy. Must scrub generals' feet.
* {{tact|end}}

===Grubfoot===
* {{topt|Talk about Christmas.}}
** '''Player:''' Hello Grubfoot. Merry Christmas!
** '''Grubfoot:''' Grubfoot like Christmas. Grubfoot think it different from human Christmas. Goblins call it Gobmas.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|event=No|Talk about something else.}}

==Starting out==
===Speaking to Scrubfoot near the tree for the first time===
* '''Player:''' Hi. Who are you?
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Me Scrubfoot. Me Grubfoot's twin.
* '''Player:''' Scrubfoot? What a strange name. What are you doing here?
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Scrubfoot on mission for General Wartface and General Bentnoze.<!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 0 -> 1 -->
* {{tact|continue}} <!-- continues from the state of varbit 11718 -->

===Speaking to Scrubfoot after learning about his mission===
<!-- If varbit 11718 >= 1 || varbit 11718 =< 5; he will not appear at the tree some time after speaking with generals and being "busy", while he may still appear at the Goblin Village if varbit 11726 == 0. -->
* '''Player:''' Hi again, Scrubfoot.
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Hello.
* {{tact|continue}} <!-- continues from the state of varbit 11718 -->

===Learning from Scrubfoot more about his mission===
* '''Player:''' A mission? What kind of mission?
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Scrubfoot not tell. Secret mission.
* '''Player:''' Secret? They must trust you a lot to send you on a secret mission.
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Yes. Scrubfoot small so the humans no see Scrubfoot spying.<!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 1 -> 2 -->
* {{tact|continue}} <!-- continues from the state of varbit 11718 -->

===Learning from Scrubfoot about Goblins' intent to steal Christmas===
* '''Player:''' Did you say you're spying on the humans?
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Uh... no... Scrubfoot not say such things. Secret mission. Not talk about it.
* '''Player:''' You know. I could tell the goblin generals that you told me the secret.
* '''Scrubfoot:''' No! Human not do that! Scrubfoot needs to prove he worthy goblin.
* '''Player:''' If you tell me what you're doing here, I won't tell the generals.
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Fine... Scrubfoot sent here to spy on humans. We find their weakness before great goblin invasion.
* '''Player:''' Invasion?
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Yes. Goblins hear humans have Christmas. Christmas good. Goblins take it from humans.<!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 2 -> 3 -->
* {{tact|continue}} <!-- continues from the state of varbit 11718 -->

===Confronting Scrubfoot after learning about stealing Christmas===
* {{topt|You can't just take Christmas. That's not how it works.}}
** '''Player:''' You can't just take Christmas. That's not how it works.
** '''Scrubfoot:''' Yes. Goblins strong. Goblins take what goblins wants.
** '''Player:''' It's not just a physical thing you can take away from someone.
** '''Scrubfoot:''' Human confusing. Goblins take Christmas from you first.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Why do the goblins want Christmas, anyway?}}
** '''Player:''' Why do the goblins want Christmas, anyway?
** '''Scrubfoot:''' Christmas good. Humans say so. Christmas make humans happy. It too can make goblins happy.
** '''Player:''' That... actually makes sense. But you don't need to take away Christmas from the humans to celebrate it as well!
** '''Scrubfoot:''' Human silly. Goblins and humans not share Christmas. Only one can has it. And goblins stronger so goblins get it.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|cond=Only accessible after selecting option 1 or 2:|I have to stop this. I can't let you take Christmas.}}
** '''Player:''' I have to stop this. I can't let you take Christmas. Even though you can't really take it because it's not a physical thing.
** '''Scrubfoot:''' Human cannot stop goblins. Generals in Goblin Village not let human destroy great plan.
** '''Player:''' Goblin Village you say? I better head up there.<!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 3 -> 5 -->
** '''Scrubfoot:''' No! Stop! Human not go there. And human not tell generals that Scrubfoot tell secret.
** '''Player:''' Human will do as human please.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Goodbye.}}
** '''Player:''' Goodbye.
** '''Scrubfoot:''' Goodbye human.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Scrubfoot at the event start location after learning of their plans===
<!-- He likely won't be here any longer if varbit 1178 is >= 6, should the player happen to talk to the generals and get called a "silly human". -->
* '''Player:''' Hi again, Scrubfoot.
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Hello.
* '''Player:''' Where did you say the goblin generals were?
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Scrubfoot not say anything about goblin generals in Goblin Village to the north. Also Scrubfoot not say anything about secret plan to steal Christmas.
* '''Scrubfoot:''' ... Oh no.
* '''Player:''' Thanks, Scrubfoot!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Scrubfoot at the Goblin Village after his introduction, before speaking to the generals===
<!-- Requires varbit 11718 >= 1 && < 6; will not work with varbit 11718 == 0 || >= 6; in other words, not after General Bentnoze exclaims "Silly human!" and not before Scrubfoot introduces himself. -->
* '''Player:''' Hey, Scrubfoot. How did you make it up here so fast?
* '''Scrubfoot:''' Scrubfoot fast when Scrubfoot in trouble with generals. Run between village and humans a lot.
* {{tact|end}}

==Talking to the Generals==
{{tcond|After the player has exclaimed to Scrubfoot earlier, "I better head up there."}}

* {{topt|Talk about Christmas.}}
** '''Player:''' Hi, excuse me, I-
** '''General Wartface:''' Green armour for when we go to war!
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Noooo! Red armour! Big High War God said so.
** '''Player:''' Stop it, both of you! There's no need to go to war.
** '''General Wartface:''' Human funny! 'No need for war' - it joke.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Silly human!
<!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 5 -> 6; Scrubfoot becomes busy at Goblin Village again and likely disappears from the tree location -->
** {{tact|continue}}
* {{topt|event=No|Talk about something else.}}

===Talking about Christmas, after being told to be a silly human===
* '''Player:''' I heard you are trying to take Christmas.
* '''General Wartface:''' Yes. Christmas good. We take it from humans.
* '''General Bentnoze:''' We take it so goblins happy. It great honour for Big High War God!
* '''General Wartface:''' We invade when we agree that colour for armour is green.
* '''General Bentnoze:''' No! We invade when we agree that colour for armour is red!
* '''General Wartface:''' No! Green armour!
* '''General Bentnoze:''' Red!
* '''Player:''' You will never agree on this. At this rate, I guess we will never have to worry about the invasion at all.
* '''Player:''' But stranger things have happened. Besides, you seem to not really know what Christmas is. Maybe I should teach you.
* '''General Wartface:''' Silly human think goblins not know Christmas.
* '''General Bentnoze:''' Christmas good.
* {{tact|continue}}
<!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 6 -> 7 -->

===Talking about Christmas, after being told goblins know and enjoy Christmas===
* {{topt|If you know Christmas so well...}}
** '''Player:''' If you know Christmas so well, name one thing you do during that time?
** '''General Wartface:''' Uhhh.. the uhh... the fighting!
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Yes, the fighting! And the uh... the pillaging?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|What's your favourite thing about Christmas?}}
** '''Player:''' What's your favourite thing about Christmas?
** '''General Wartface:''' Uhh... General Wartface not know. It all good.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Christmas good. It hard to pick one favourite thing.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|cond=If the player has previously selected option 1 or 2 in this conversation:|You don't know anything about Christmas, do you?}}
** {{tact|continue}}
* {{topt|Goodbye.}}
** '''Player:''' Goodbye.
** '''General Wartface:''' Bye human.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Bye-bye.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking about Christmas, after confronting the generals' knowledge===
* '''Player:''' You don't know anything about Christmas, do you? <!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 7 -> 8 -->
* '''General Wartface:''' Goblins not need to know about it.
* '''General Bentnoze:''' All goblins know is humans has it and humans say it good. So we take it. Goblins deserve good.
* '''Player:''' I guess you do deserve good, just like everyone else. Why don't I teach you about Christmas?
* '''General Bentnoze:''' Teach goblins? War easy. Learning hard.
* '''Player:''' I'll teach you about Christmas and help you celebrate it in your own way. In return you don't invade the humans. Deal?
* '''General Bentnoze:''' General Bentnoze not think this work.
* '''General Wartface:''' General Wartface say goblins try. And when it no work, goblins invade humans.
* '''General Bentnoze:''' Yes, then goblins invade.
* '''Player:''' Sigh. Guess it's worth a try.
<!-- Varbit 11718 changed: 8 -> 10 -->
* {{tact|continue}}

===Talking about Christmas, teaching the generals about Christmas===
* {{topt|Talk about decorations.}}
** '''Player:''' Let's talk about decorations. Around Christmas we like to decorate things to make them look pretty and feel festive.
** '''General Wartface:''' Goblins not care for pretty.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Pretty is puny. Goblins need power!
** '''Player:''' Well, you can decorate with things you like. People typically use fairy lights and stockings, to name a few.
** '''General Wartface:''' Sockings? Goblins have socks. Goblins put socks on things?
** '''Player:''' That's not quite what I-
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Stinky sockings! Human so funny.
** '''Player:''' Aren't there other things you maybe would want to decorate with?
** '''General Bentnoze:''' In cave below village are glowy flying lights.
** '''General Wartface:''' Oh yes glowy lights. Scrubfoot! Go get green glowy lights.
** '''Scrubfoot:''' Y-yes, at once, General Wartface.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' No! Scrubfoot bring red lights!
** '''General Wartface:''' It too late! Scrubfoot already gone. <!-- Varbit 11726 changed: 0 -> 1. Scrubfoot becomes invisible at Goblin Village. -->
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Human! Go get red lights before Scrubfoot! They in cave below village.
** '''Player:''' I'll see what I can do.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Talk about trees.}}
** '''Player:''' One of the highlights of Christmas is the Christmas tree. Typically we take a large tree - like a pine - into our house and decorate it nicely.
** '''General Wartface:''' Tree? Goblins not like trees.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' They stinky and green.
** '''Player:''' Well if you don't like trees, perhaps we could decorate something else. Is there something around here you think would make a good centrepiece?
** '''General Wartface:''' As long as it not tree, General Wartface happy.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Above village goblins have sacred boulder. Goblins go there sometimes to look at boulder.
** '''General Wartface:''' Oh yes, sacred boulder! Big High War God place it there. It look like goblin so it symbol of goblin world domination!
** '''Player:''' While I highly doubt that, I will go take a look at this boulder. <!-- Varbit 11724 changed: 0 -> 1 -->
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Talk about gifts.}}
** '''Player:''' An important part of Christmas - some would actually say it's the most important part - is gifts.
** '''General Wartface:''' General Wartface loves gifts!
** '''General Bentnoze:''' General Bentnoze too. And taking gifts from others. That good too.
** '''Player:''' Well, around Christmas we tend to focus more on giving rather than receiving. We call it the gift of giving.
** '''General Wartface:''' Give? No. No give. Only get.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Yes, only get. And take. It the goblin way.
** '''Player:''' OK let's see. What if, to start with, you give yourselves a present? General Wartface will give one to himself, and General Bentnoze, you give one to yourself.
** '''Player:''' That way you still get a present, but we can practice giving one away. Sound good?
** '''General Wartface:''' Human weird. But General Wartface loves gifts.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' General Bentnoze wants good gift! Better than General Wartface gift.
** '''Player:''' What in particular would you like?
** '''General Wartface:''' Goblins keep treasures in village. Goblins like Big High War God, meat and powerful things.
** '''Player:''' OK. I'll bring you your own presents to give to yourself. This isn't weird at all.
** '''General Wartface:''' Hurry up, human! Me wants gift now. <!-- Varbit 11725 changed: 0 -> 1 -->
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Talk about food.}}
** '''Player:''' A way to really get into the festive mood is to have delicious food that you only eat around this time of year.
** '''General Wartface:''' General Wartface likes food.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' That obvious. General Wartface has big belly.
** '''General Wartface:''' Me not fat! Me just has powerful belly.
** '''Player:''' What kind of food do you goblins like?
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Me like meat!
** '''General Wartface:''' Me like eyes.
** '''Player:''' Eyes?
** '''General Wartface:''' Yes. With cream.
** '''Player:''' Eyes, cream. I see. I'll have a look in the kitchens and see if I can find anything to cook for you. <!-- Varbit 11727 changed: 0 -> 1 -->
** '''General Wartface:''' Goblins have kitchen here in village.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Mudknuckles in there.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Goodbye.}}
** {{tact|above}}

===Talking about Christmas, after telling them about it===
* {{topt|Talk about decorations.}}
** '''General Wartface:''' Did human get the green glowy lights yet?
** '''Player:''' No, not yet.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Human get the red ones! In cave below village.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Talk about trees.}}

** '''Player:''' I haven't finished cooking yet.
** '''Goblin Wartface:''' Goblins have kitchen here in village.
** '''General Bentnoze:''' Mudknuckles in there.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Goodbye.}}
** {{tact|above}}

===Talking to the Easter Bunny===
* '''Player:''' Hello there!

* '''Easter Bunny:''' You know, like hunting for ancient desert temples, fighting some big evil water storm, standard adventurer things.
* '''Player:''' Okay, that all sounds exciting, but why is that a problem?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' That's not specifically. It's the fact they're in the desert. Deserts are hot!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' The last time I tried to deliver Easter eggs in the desert, they all melted!
* '''Player:''' Hence the sticky situation!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Yes. Melted chocolate does not get on well with my fur. I don't want to go through that again!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' So I need to find a solution. I've came to Al Kharid since the people here know how to handle food in desert temperatures.
* '''Player:''' That's clever. Well, good luck. I hope you find the information you're looking for!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Wait! There is one other thing.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' It turns out that a giant pink rabbit like myself is quite frightening to people who haven't seen me before.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' I only managed to start speaking to one person before they realised it wasn't a costume. Now everybody is scared!
* '''Player:''' Oh, I can see why. You are a big rabbit! I've been on lots of adventures so I'm not really scared of anything anymore.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' BOO!
* '''Player:''' Ahhhhhhhh-*cough* I mean, almost got me!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' I see, very brave!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Well, since you're so brave, would you be able to help me out by asking some of the locals about my melting chocolate issue?
* '''Player:''' What is in it for me?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' I'll give you some super cool rewards of course! Although I'm not sure what they'll be yet...
* '''Easter Bunny:''' ...but I'm sure I'll find something super cool for you!
* {{tselect|Start the Easter 2022 event?}}
* {{topt|Sounds good to me!}}
** '''Player:''' Sounds good to me! Any idea on where to start?
** '''Easter Bunny:''' You could speak to Karim the kebab seller. He's the person I started speaking to before he realised I'm a big bunny and ran off.
** '''Easter Bunny:''' He'll definitely have some knowledge about food! His shop is just south-east of here.
** '''Player:''' I'll go and ask him. Will you stay here?
** '''Easter Bunny:''' Yes. A downside to being a big fluffy bunny is I don't get on too well with hot weather. So much fur.
** '''Easter Bunny:''' I thought about shaving it all off, but that would probably scare the locals even more.
** '''Player:''' It most definitely would!
** '''Easter Bunny:''' What?
** '''Player:''' I said it most definitely wouldn't! And that there is no need to anyway now that I am here to help.
** '''Easter Bunny:''' Thank you! I'll stay here by the coast where it's a bit cooler. See you soon, good luck!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Nah, I'm busy.}}
** '''Player:''' Nah, I'm busy. I might have some time later!

* {{tbox|pic=Easter egg (2022 Easter event) detail.png|pic2=Ice cream easter egg detail.png|The Easter Bunny places two new test eggs into your cooler.}}

*** {{tcond|If the player does not have 2 open inventory spaces:}}

*** {{tbox|pic=Easter egg (2022 Easter event) detail.png|pic2=Ice cream easter egg detail.png|You remove the two chocolate eggs from the cooler.}}

===Talking to the Easter Bunny after testing the eggs===
* '''Player:''' Hey, Easter Bunny. I have news.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Good news I hope? Did the experiment work?
* '''Player:''' It did! The normal egg melted instantly and the ice cream filled egg didn't!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' This is amazing news! So this means I can finally deliver Easter eggs into the desert. Those adventurers will be so happy!
* '''Player:''' I am glad we figured something out!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' There is one last thing, these new eggs need a name!
* '''Player:''' How about... Ice Cream Filled Chocolate Eggs?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' That doesn't really roll off the tongue.
* '''Player:''' Okay, how about... Chocolate Eggs With Nice Cold Ice Cream Centre?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' That's no better.
* '''Player:''' Fine, how about... Yummy for My Tummy Eggs Sort of Like a Choc-Ice But Bigger and Better?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Are you okay?
* '''Player:''' Of course, what is wrong? Don't you like my name ideas?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' They're just a bit long really. It's quite hard to remember a fourteen word name. I was thinking more like one or two words.
* '''Player:''' Ohhhh right, you should have said! How about... Choc-ice Eggs?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' That's better, but it doesn't sound very exciting. There is no air of mystery!
* '''Player:''' Oooo I know! Maybe we could shorten that to Cheggs!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' We can't use that. That's my friends name!
* '''Player:''' Your friend?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Yeah, Scott. Scott Cheggs.
* '''Player:''' Who is that?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' My friend! Look him up, he's quite famous.
* '''Player:''' I'll take your word for that.
* '''Player:''' Fine, one last idea, how about... Easter Eggs?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Just Easter Eggs?
* '''Player:''' Yeah, why not! It's a name everyone knows and loves. The ice cream inside will just be a cool surprise, an air of mystery.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' You've convinced me, Easter Eggs it is!
* '''Easter Bunny:''' I'll get working on these immediately. Can't have those adventurers waiting any longer.
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Thank you for your help [player name]. I don't have much to give you, but I found these things earlier, maybe you can make use of them?
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Here you go. Hopefully they are acceptable as a reward!
* {{tcond|If the player has no inventory space:}}
** '''Easter Bunny:''' You need some more space before I can give you your rewards! You need [1-3] more [space/spaces].
** '''Player:''' I'll free up some space then. I'll be back in a second.
** {{tact|end}}
* '''Easter Bunny:''' Thanks again, [player name]. Happy Easter!
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to the Easter Bunny before getting the rewards====

* '''Easter Bunny:''' Okay, here are your rewards.
* {{tcond|If the player has no inventory space:}}
** '''Easter Bunny:''' You still need some more space before I can give you your rewards! You need [1-3] more [space/spaces].
** '''Player:''' I'll free up some more space then. I'll be back in a second.
** {{tact|end}}

* {{tact|end}}

content:
{{Transcript|event}}
{{Transcript list|Gilbert|Aven|Wolf (2022 Pride event)|Alan (2022 Pride event)|Oscar|Sylvia|Marsha}}

==Before starting the event==
===Talking to Aven===
* '''Player:''' Hello!
* '''Aven:''' Hello there, [player name].
* '''Player:''' What are you doing here?
* '''Aven:''' I'm collecting some seeds!
* '''Player:''' Seeds? For what?
* '''Aven:''' Flowers! I'm a flower trader. I've been selling so many that I'm almost out of stock, so I'm looking around for some more.
* '''Player:''' Oh I see, well I hope you find some more!
* '''Aven:''' Thanks!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Wolf===
* '''Player:''' Hi!
* '''Wolf:''' Hey there, [player name].
* '''Player:''' What is going on here?
* '''Wolf:''' I'm selling flowers and flower seeds. I'm a travelling flower trader!
* '''Player:''' That's cool! Maybe I'll stop buy and get some later.
* '''Wolf:''' See you then!
* {{tact|end}}

==Starting out==
===Talking to Gilbert===
* '''Player:''' Hello, Gilbert!
* '''Gilbert:''' Hi, [player name]!
* '''Player:''' What are you doing here?
* '''Gilbert:''' I'm just relaxing and enjoying the nature. I need a break!
* '''Player:''' A break? From what?
* '''Gilbert:''' Oh, you haven't heard? There is quite the dilemma going on in Misthalin right now.
* '''Gilbert:''' We, the inhabitants, have decided we'd like a bit more colour. It's very green!
* '''Gilbert:''' Green is nice, but what about red, orange, yellow, indigo, and violet. We need some more of those!
* '''Player:''' That sounds like a nice idea. The world is always a better place with a bit more colour!
* '''Gilbert:''' Exactly! We've had many ideas on how to do this, but none of them are suitable.
* '''Gilbert:''' Aggie suggested we paint all the roads different colours, but Doric said that would clash too much with the green grass.
* '''Gilbert:''' Abbot Langley suggested we dye the trees' leaves different colours, but Fred the Farmer said that would scare his sheep.
* '''Gilbert:''' Aris suggested they paint the wheat different shades of the rainbow, but the cook in Lumbridge said that would ruin the flavour of his baking.
* '''Gilbert:''' So you see... many ideas, but not many suitable ones!
* '''Player:''' Hmm... maybe I could help out? I'm pretty good at coming up with ideas!
* '''Gilbert:''' That would be super helpful, if you wouldn't mind?
* {{tselect|Start the 2022 Pride event?}}
* {{topt|I'd love to help!}}
** '''Player:''' I'd love to help!
** {{mes|You've started the {{Colour|#e11a1a|20}}{{Colour|#ff5f00|22}} {{Colour|#edf419|PR}}{{Colour|#208542|ID}}{{Colour|#3a06b3|E E}}{{Colour|#9240db|VE}}{{Colour|#e11a1a|NT}}!}}
** '''Gilbert:''' Amazing news!
** '''Gilbert:''' Okay, so, do you have any ideas?
** '''Player:''' Ah, well... now you ask, my mind is a bit blank. Let me think for a second.
** {{tbox|*pondering expression*}}
** '''Player:''' How about... we paint ourselves all the rainbow colours!
** '''Gilbert:''' Wouldn't that mess up all our clothes? And it'll wash away if it rains!
** '''Player:''' Alright, then, hmm... I'm out of ideas!
** '''Gilbert:''' I thought you said you were good at coming up with ideas?
** '''Player:''' I may have overestimated my idea-creating ability!
** '''Player:''' It's a shame we can't dye all the flowers in this field into a sunburst of colour.
** '''Gilbert:''' Actually, that was my idea! And why I'm here! I'm just not sure I can do it.
** '''Player:''' Oh, really? Why not, that would be great!
** '''Gilbert:''' I have the magic spell for it, but I need a flower seed of each colour to power the spell.
** '''Player:''' Can't we go and get a seed for each colour?
** '''Gilbert:''' I know there are two flower traders currently visiting the local area who may have the seeds we need.
** '''Gilbert:''' I would have gone to them myself but I don't really know where to go and I don't want someone to come and use this meadow for their own idea!
** '''Gilbert:''' So I've been waiting here, trying to think of another idea!
** '''Player:''' Well, I'm here now! Maybe I can go and get the seeds for you?
** '''Gilbert:''' Really? You'd do that for me?
** '''Player:''' Of course! I'm always happy to help out.
** '''Gilbert:''' Do you know what seeds to look for?
** '''Player:''' Ooh, no I don't, you better tell me!
** '''Gilbert:''' Okay, so we want six colours. Red, orange, yellow, green, indigo and violet. I've already got some {{Colour|#208542|Green Carnation}} seeds here that I found earlier.
** '''Player:''' Makes sense with all the green!
** '''Gilbert:''' Indeed! But for the other colours we need...
** '''Gilbert:''' Seeds for a {{Colour|#e11a1a|Legendary Red Rose}}, a {{Colour|#ff5f00|Gorgeous Orange Lily}}, a {{Colour|#edf419|Beautiful Yellow Pansy}}, a {{Colour|#3a06b3|Tenacious Indigo Iris}}, and a {{Colour|#9240db|Quality Violet Tulip}}.
** '''Player:''' Okay, got those noted down.
** '''Gilbert:''' Excellent! Well, the first flower trader is apparently 'At the place where you turn essence into the power of the body', whatever that means.
** '''Player:''' Why in Gielinor did they explain their location like that?! Just saying something like 'Lumbridge Castle courtyard' would have been easier.
** '''Gilbert:''' I heard of their location from a friend, who heard from his friend, who heard from her friend, who told him what they'd heard from their sister who heard from a passerby.
** '''Gilbert:''' So it may not be an entirely accurate recount of the original explanation.
** '''Player:''' I see, and the second trader?
** '''Gilbert:''' The second flower trader is... hmm, I can't remember actually. I'll remember by the time you're back from the first one!
** '''Player:''' Okay, well, I think I have enough to go on anyway! I shall go and look for these seeds.
** '''Gilbert:''' Thank you. Good luck!
** {{mes|color=#9240db|The first trader can be found 'At the place where you turn essence into the power of the body'.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Actually, I'm a bit busy right now.}}
** '''Player:''' Actually, I'm a bit busy right now.
** '''Gilbert:''' Oh, that's a shame. Come back if you can free up some time. I'd still welcome some help!
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Gilbert again if the player said they were busy===
* '''Gilbert:''' Hi, [player name]!
* '''Gilbert:''' Are you free to help me now?
* {{tselect|Start the 2022 Pride event?}}
* {{topt|Yes, I'm free to help now!}}
** '''Player:''' Yes, I'm free to help now!
** '''Gilbert:''' Amazing news!
** {{tact|above}}
* {{topt|I'm still a bit busy right now.}}
** '''Player:''' I'm still a bit busy right now.
** '''Gilbert:''' Oh, okay. Well as before, come back if you can free up some time. I'd still welcome some help!
** {{tact|end}}

* '''Player:''' I haven't found any yet!
* '''Gilbert:''' Oh, well, keep looking! Remember that the first flower trader is 'At the place where you turn essence into the power of the body'.
* '''Gilbert:''' We need seeds for a {{colour|#e11a1a|Legendary Red Rose}}, a {{colour|#ff5f00|Gorgeous Orange Lily}}, a {{colour|#edf419|Beautiful Yellow Pansy}}, a {{colour|#3a06b3|Tenacious Indigo Iris}}, and a {{colour|#9240db|Quality Violet Tulip}}.
* '''Player:''' Thank you, I'll go and get them now!
* {{tact|end}}

==Red and Orange==
===Talking to Aven===
* '''Player:''' Hello!
* '''Aven:''' Hello there, [player name].
* '''Player:''' Are you the flower trader?
* '''Aven:''' I am a flower trader, but not the only one! Are you looking for any flowers in particular?
* '''Player:''' I am! Well, flower seeds. Do you sell seeds?
* '''Aven:''' Of course! I mostly sell seeds as they tend to make it back home in one piece. Flowers themselves are quite delicate.
* '''Aven:''' What seeds are you after?
* '''Player:''' Quite a few actually! I'm looking for seeds for a {{Colour|#e11a1a|Legendary Red Rose}}, a {{Colour|#ff5f00|Gorgeous Orange Lily}}, a {{Colour|#edf419|Beautiful Yellow Pansy}}, a {{Colour|#3a06b3|Tenacious Indigo Iris}}, and a {{Colour|#9240db|Quality Violet Tulip}}.
* '''Aven:''' Oh my, that is a lot! If you don't mind me asking, what are they all for?
* '''Player:''' I'm trying to help bring some more colour to Misthalin!
* '''Aven:''' That sounds like a wonderful idea!
* '''Aven:''' I sadly don't have all of the seeds you're after, as my stocks are running quite low, but I do have seeds for a {{Colour|#e11a1a|Legendary Red Rose}} and a {{Colour|#ff5f00|Gorgeous Orange Lily}}.
* '''Aven:''' Is that okay?
* '''Player:''' That's great. It's a good start!
* '''Aven:''' I am glad to hear it. Well, here you go!
* {{tcond|If the player does not have enough inventory space:}}
** '''Aven:''' Oh dear, you don't have enough space to carry the seeds. Come back when you have two spaces free.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tbox|pic=Legendary red rose seed detail.png|pic2=Gorgeous orange lily seed detail.png|Aven gives you both a {{Colour|#e11a1a|Legendary Red Rose}} seed and a {{Colour|#ff5f00|Gorgeous Orange Lily}} seed.}}
* '''Player:''' For free?
* '''Aven:''' Yes! You said you're trying to bring some more colour to Misthalin. That is a cause I can get behind.
* '''Player:''' Thank you very much!
* '''Player:''' Where do you find all these rare seeds? Are they gifts from all your suitors?
* '''Aven:''' No! I forage for and grow them all myself! I would never accept such gifts, giving people hope of things that could never be...
* '''Aven:''' I'm much more of a plant person than a people person!
* '''Aven:''' As for the remaining seeds, maybe you could visit another trader. I know there was one by a bank, but I can't remember where that bank was.
* '''Player:''' Hmm, I will have a look around. Again, thank you very much!
* {{tbox|Aven turns away and starts looking for more flower seeds.}}
* '''Player:''' I should return to Gilbert and show him what I've found.
* {{mes|color=#9240db|I should return to Gilbert and show him what I've found.}}
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Aven again before getting the seeds====
* '''Player:''' Hello!
* '''Aven:''' Hello there, [player name].

* {{tcond|If the player does not have space:}}
** '''Player:''' Not yet.
** '''Aven:''' Oh okay, come back when you have two spaces free.
** {{tact|end}}
* '''Player:''' I do!
* '''Aven:''' Here you go.
* {{tbox|pic=Legendary red rose seed detail.png|pic2=Gorgeous orange lily seed detail.png|Aven gives you both a {{colour|#e11a1a|Legendary Red Rose}} seed and a {{colour|#ff5f00|Gorgeous Orange Lily}} seed.}}

*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tbox|pic=Legendary red rose seed detail.png|pic2=Gorgeous orange lily seed detail.png|Aven hands you another {{colour|#e11a1a|Legendary Red Rose}} seed and another {{colour|#ff5f00|Gorgeous Orange Lily}} seed.}}
** '''Aven:''' Try not to lose these ones!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player lost one seed:}}
** '''Player:''' I've lost one of the seeds you gave me!
** '''Aven:''' Oh dear! Well luckily for you I have some spares. Here you go.
** {{tcond|If the player does not have space for the seed:}}
*** '''Aven:''' Oh, you don't have enough space to hold it. Come back to me when you have a space free.

content:
{{No official name}}
{{Postbag|issue=39|date=27 February 2026|url=https://youtu.be/D4WYQo96z_0?t=6947|osrs=yes}}
{{Transcript list|Romeo|Romily Weaklax|Cow31337Killer|Drunken Dwarf|Bank of Gielinor|Chaos Elemental|noplayer}}

''This Postbag from the Hedge was read out loud on livestream ([https://youtu.be/D4WYQo96z_0?t=6947 recording here]), and manually transcribed. It may not be 100% accurate.''

==To Romeo==
{{Letter|Dear Romeo, I hope you are doing well. I would like to have an update on your exciting love life.

Yours truly, 

Chill N Kill}}

I'm sorry, but I don't think I know any Kill N Chill. I'm guessing you must be one of my admirers. Well, I'm afraid to say that I am now taken. Phillipa and I are very much in love. She's an absolute fox, and I'm saving up to buy her the finest third-hand jewellery in all of Varrock.

In fact, I was recently asked to help set up a venue for a thrilling upcoming musical performance. The money I get from that will buy all the jewellery Phillipa could ever want. We were hoping to use the party room in Falador, but apparently it was already booked by the Acheron Apes. 

Anyway, I don't think it's going to be a problem. The good man who I intend to buy the third-hand jewellery from has offered to let me use his POH. His name is... I think, Mug Ger. It's an odd name, but he seems an all around lovely fellow, combat level 6 I believe. 

Anyways, I hope you find your own love soon, Kill N Chill. Although... Phillipa has said something about one of her family dying abruptly, I was just thinking if anything happens to Phillipa herself, I'll um, certainly write back to you.

Yours sincerely, 

Romeo

==To Romily Weaklax==
{{Letter|Hello fellow pie lover, I have recently taken a shipment of your wonderful pies up to Rellekka for some of your friends and I was just wondering something: How do you get your pies to last such a long journey without spoiling?

The harsh sea air and all manner of elements surely would turn a lesser pie stale and soggy. But by the time we landed, they seemed as pristine as when I loaded them. The fine gentleman who collected the pies from me seemed to be sure they'd be even fine on the second trip even further north.

You must tell me your secrets so I can protect all the summer pies I'll be making in the near future.

Your friend in pie-hood, 

Burnt Imp}}

Oh, Burnt Imp, it's so good to hear from a fellow pie connoisseur. I'm glad to hear that you've noticed how good my pies are. As you say, any lesser pie would go stale long before they ever make it up that far north. 

Indeed, I do believe I am the only pie salesman capable of having pies delivered that far. As for the secret, well, I'm afraid it's a closely guarded one, passed down over generations of the Weaklax family. 

Truth be told, I can't even be sure if the origin's a secret anymore. However, it is said that the great Durant Weaklax discovered the secret back when our family still lived in colder climes up north. 

Anyway, while I'm afraid I can't share my secrets, I still very much wish you all the best in your pie making endeavors.

All the best, 

Romily Weaklax

==To Cow31337Killer==
{{Letter|Hi mate, hope you're doing well. I haven't seen you since I was helping Ava out. Heard there was a new cow boss coming to Lumbridge.

Have you got any good ideas on how you can take down this boss? I remember you distinctly had a thing for killing cows. So how bad is the cow boss hard mode?

Cheers,

Timmy McFly}}

Hullo Timmy McFly. The news of a cow boss was a surprise to me. I thought they were too disorganized for a leadership structure. Still, it remains my mission to be a beacon of security in this cow-infested world. So I intend to tackle this problem head-on. If I had to guess, it would still be a cow at heart, which means with my elite talents, it shall fall quite comfortably to my axe. 

Catch you on the flipside. 

Cow31337Killer

==To the Drunken Dwarf==
{{Letter|Hello Mr. Drunken Dwarf, my favorite chum. I never tire of your cheeky pint and early dinner, but I've been wondering, where do you source it all from? Me and the lads have been making a bit of a game you see, and we want to settle this once and for all.

Seal Neko
}}

Ey, Seal Neko, me good matey! 

It's all went and started when I went off on Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl, it was a great day out for me and me mateys. Anyway, while we were having a cheeky Fire Brandy over at the Dragon Inn in Yanille, I went and got myself a bit lost! I accidentally wandered into some house of some magic man, or something, and he had this door, um, but it wasn't a door, it wasn't like a door, it wasn't a window either, it was—magic! Something magic, yes, so I put me hand in it cause you do, right, right, and what did I pull out? A kebab! 

So the weird thing is though, ever since then, I just keep finding kebabs everywhere. It's a lot of good fun but it's also a bit of a nightmare—only way to get rid of them is to keep finding more mateys to share them with! As for the beer, I just buy that over at The Laughing Miner.

All the best matey.

==To the Bank of Gielinor==
{{Letter|Hello, I'm concerned for the well-being of bank employees throughout Gielinor. Are the bankers paid living wages? Do the bankers in remote or dangerous areas, like Gundai, in the wildy Mage Arena bank, get hazard pay? And why haven't the Port Phasmatys bankers chosen to move on? Surely they cannot be so keen to wile away their ghostly days from behind a bank booth.

Zulrah Mamdani
}}

Good day Zulrah Mamdani. Your concern for the welfare of our employees is admirable. We would like to reaffirm that yes, all employees working for the Bank of Gielinor are paid at a fair and appropriate rate for the work they do. 

We are unfortunately unable to reveal any details of individual arrangements for our employees, however we can confirm that they have access to any and all appropriate protection that they may request, especially for those operating in high risk areas. 

As for our "vitally challenged" employees, it is entirely their own choice as to whether if they decide to move on as you suggest, and we are not in a position to encourage them in any direction. If they are unhappy, they are welcome to raise their concerns. 

Kind regards and happy banking. 

Management for the Bank of Gielinor

==To the Chaos Elemental== 
{{Letter|Dear Chaos Elemental, what would you do if your name was Grumby Stumbaloo?}}
<!--The response to this letter is verbatim provided by Mod Ash-->
GMars,

Verily, I didst make sojourn unto the local Graveyard in the yestereve, yet did I espy a knave upon the strand, for whom a bath was sorely the necessity. The waters were as gelid as snow, yet an eternal brazier wouldst set aright the perturbance of mine host. Alas, he didst not possess one thereof, yet mayhaps his child didst.

In any matter, doth it not pose a great endeavour to lose thine own loved ones? Indeed, I didst leave one in a casket for many a year, though be not in fear, for she didst appear unharmed. Yet, 'tis a thing that stirs the mind, doth it not? For in sooth, we are such stuff as dreams are made on.

But lo, I do find myself entwined in mine own cogitations. For, let us not forget, the cause of our assembly hither. 'Tis, if it pleases thee, the moon. All seem to be besotted with wonder of it in the present, but, haply, they do forget the aspect of most import. But, be not dismayed, for I deem they shall recall in season soon.

Ah, but hearken well, fair companion, for the time of departure draweth nigh. I shall impart unto thee certain words of wit, ere I take mine leave. Have naught to do with yonder alt oaks, but rather beware of what lieth hid within their ancient hearts.

Yours,

Stumby Grumbaloo
