content:
{{Transcript}}

[[File:Have a listen to our anniversary vinyls! (1).jpg]]

Hi [player name]

Listen up!

We're releasing two new RuneScape albums, and both are available to pre-order on CD and vinyl from our friends at Laced Records. You can also listen to both of them right now on all leading streaming services!

Both albums, whether pre-ordered on CD or Vinyl, come with an MP3 digital download - so you can listen on the go!

RuneScape: Old School Combat Classics

Relive your earliest glory days with this 18-track album filled with Old School's most iconic combat themes.

The collection includes music from the Wilderness, dungeons, quests, minigames and all manner of beasts 'n' bosses, as composed by Ian Taylor and Mod Ash.

The vinyl edition contains 2 x 180g vinyl in orange and red. The deluxe gatefold sleeve features all-new artwork of Jad on the inside – and the front and back covers feature iconic items from the game and Barrows equipment arranged in the Combat Triangle.

[[File:Have a listen to our anniversary vinyls! (2).jpg]]

RuneScape: God Wars Dungeons

War is coming... to your music library! This 11-track album features iconic tunes from the two God Wars Dungeons.

The vinyl edition contains two 180g vinyls in turquoise blue and purple, one for each dungeon. The deluxe gatefold sleeve features art of Nex and the other God Wars Dungeon generals as they face off in battle. Epic!

[[File:Have a listen to our anniversary vinyls! (3).jpg]]

title: Transcript:Have great ideas? Looking to share it? Here is the opportunity
content:
{{Transcript}}

Hi [player name],

Recently we invited Old School RuneScape players to participate in the 2018 Content Survey. Thousands of you answered our call and provided the Old School team with a wealth of information which will be used to guide our content for the next year.

As part of our commitment to being as community-driven as we possibly can be, we’d like to host a workshop for Old School RuneScape players. To be considered for attendance, you’ll be asked some questions about yourself and your Old School playing habits. You’ll need to provide some personal information, such as your phone number, with which you may be contacted on for a follow-up phone call.

Should you attend the workshop you'll receive remunerations, alongside food and drink, as thanks for giving up your time.

We’d like to thank you for your dedication and continued efforts in helping guide the future of Old School RuneScape.

Mods Archie, Ash, Ayiza, Curse, Ed, Ghost, Jed, John C, Kieren, Mat K, Maz, Roq, Ry, Stone, Sween, Weath, West & Wolf

The Old School RuneScape Team

title: Transcript:Have you seen our latest announcements?
content:

[[File:Have you seen our latest announcements (1).png]]

EXCITING TIMES AHEAD, [PLAYER NAME]

GET READY FOR NEW CONTENT COMING YOUR WAY SOON

It's an exciting week for Old School RuneScape, with not one, but two brand new launch dates being announced! Whether you want to experience Old School's first ever new skill like never before, or want to get your hands on some epic new content, carry on reading for all of the details...

[[File:Have you seen our latest announcements (2).png]]

SAILING BETA: EXPERIENCE THE SKILL

Following a successful Alpha back in March, we've been reviewing your feedback and making improvements to our first ever new skill. We're now thrilled to let you know that the Sailing Beta will launch on Thursday 26th June 2025 at 11:30 BST and will run until Thursday 3rd July 2025 - and will be fully playable on mobile!

You'll be able to check out Ship Combat and Bounty Tasks, Crew Management and even experience random events at sea.

VARLAMORE: THE FINAL DAWN

The third and final major content addition to Varlamore, our latest region, will be launching on Wednesday 23rd July 2025! 

Get ready for new quests, a new boss, Fletching skilling opportunities, a new dungeon, and even more that we're keeping a secret for now. Keep your eyes peeled for more information soon, and we'll see you in Varlamore on the 23rd!

title: Transcript:Hazeel Cult
content:
{{External|rs}}
{{Transcript|quest}}
{{Transcript list|Ceril Carnillean|Guard (Carnillean)|Philipe Carnillean|Butler Jones|Claus the Chef|Henryeta Carnillean|Clivet|Alomone|Hazeel Cultist|Hazeel}}

==Starting off==
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Blooming, thieving cultists! Why don't they leave me alone? String them all up, that's what I say!
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|What's wrong?}}
** '''Player:''' What's wrong?
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' It's those blooming cultists from the south! They keep breaking into my house!
** '''Player:''' Have they taken much?
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Well... no. They stole a suit of armour when they first broke in months ago, but they've been back four more times since then and taken nothing.
** '''Player:''' I see. And you are?
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' You don't know me? Why, I am Sir Ceril Carnillean! Mine is quite a famous bloodline, you know. We've played a vital role in the politics of Ardougne for many generations.
** '''Player:''' Well I'm [player name]. Maybe I can help you with these cultists?
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Interesting... I suppose the authorities haven't been much help so far. Yes, very well. If you return the stolen armour, I will provide you with a modest cash reward!
** {{tact|If the player is below level 10 combat:}}
*** {{tbox|Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 10.}}
** {{tselect|Start the Hazeel Cult quest?}}
** {{topt|Yes.}}
*** '''Player:''' Yes, of course, I'd be happy to help.
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' That's very noble of you! Keep that attitude up and one day you might have the honour of working full-time for someone like me.
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Now, I caught a glimpse of the thieves leaving, but due to... uh... my cold, I was unable to give chase.
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' What I do know is that they belong to some sort of cult. They seem to be based in a cave just south of the city, near the Clock Tower.
*** '''Player:''' How do you know that?
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' My old butler, Higson, once followed them there. Unfortunately, the next night he died in his sleep.
*** '''Player:''' That's awful! <!-- VarPlayer 223 goes from 0 to 2 -->
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' No, it's okay. Jones, a replacement from the Servants' Guild, arrived the next day. He's been great - makes an excellent broth!
*** '''Player:''' Right... I'll see if I can find this cave.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|No.}}
*** '''Player:''' No thanks. I've got other plans.
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Well no wonder I'm the one with the big house and you're the one on the streets.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|You probably deserve it.}}
** '''Player:''' You probably deserve it.
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' And who are you to judge me? You look like a peasant anyway. I'm wasting my time talking to you.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|You seem uptight, I'll leave you alone.}}
** '''Player:''' You seem uptight. I'll leave you alone.
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Yes, I doubt you could help anyway.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Ceril again===
* '''Player:''' Hello, Ceril.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' That's Sir Ceril to you, you impudent scamp. Show a bit of respect to your betters. Now, shouldn't you be recovering my armour?
* '''Player:''' Yeah yeah, I'm on it.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Good. I suggest you start with that cave south of the city, near the Clock Tower. That is where the cult is based.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the guard===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Guard:''' Hello there. I hear you're after that cult who broke in the other night. It always gladdens me when civilians assist the law like this.
* '''Player:''' I'm just happy to be of help.

===Talking to Butler Jones===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Hello. How are you today?
* '''Player:''' Good thank you, and yourself?
* '''Butler Jones:''' Very well, thank you.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Henryeta===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' Oh, hello. I'm afraid I'm not very presentable at the moment. I've been under incredible stress of late! It's ruining my complexion!
* '''Player:''' Why? What's wrong?
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' It's those awful cultists! I just don't feel safe here anymore!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Philipe===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Player:''' Hello.{{Sic|The player says hello after saying hello there}}
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' Mommy said you're here to kill all the nasty people that keep breaking in.
* '''Player:''' Something like that.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' Can I watch?
* '''Player:''' No!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Claus===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Claus the Chef:''' Sorry, can't stop to chat! You would be amazed at how many meals this family gets through daily!
* {{tact|end}}

====Inspecting the range====
* {{tbox|A pot of soup is bubbling away on the range.}}

====Using any item on Claus' range====
* '''Claus the Chef:''' Oi - I don't want people messing around with my range!
* {{tact|end}}

===Trying to use the raft===
* '''Clivet:''' Hey! I don't remember saying you could use that raft!
* {{tact|end}}

==Confronting the Hazeel Cult==
* '''Player:''' Hello there. Who are you?
* '''Clivet:''' You can call me Clivet. What do you want, adventurer?
* '''Player:''' Do you know the Carnilleans?
* '''Clivet:''' Carnilleans? Don't think I've ever heard of them.
* '''Player:''' Look, I know you're lying. I know all about your cult.
* '''Clivet:''' Is that so? In that case, I'd say you'd be wise to leave now.
* '''Player:''' Unfortunately, I have a job to do. I'm not leaving until it's done.
* '''Clivet:''' Ah, I see. That two-faced snob has made you fall for his propaganda, eh?
* '''Player:''' What's that supposed to mean?
* '''Clivet:''' The Carnillean home does not belong to them. It was built long ago by the great Lord Hazeel, who once ruled over this entire region.
* '''Clivet:''' Many years ago, the Carnilleans led a rebellion against Lord Hazeel and all who followed him. Under the cover of darkness, they stormed his home in an angry mob, torturing and butchering everyone they found.
* '''Clivet:''' The following morning, the Carnillean forefathers moved into the empty household and claimed it as their own. They have grown fat on the hard work of Lord Hazeel ever since.
* '''Player:''' Right... And what happened to this Hazeel?
* '''Clivet:''' The foolish Carnilleans believed him dead. Unluckily for them, being an all-powerful Mahjarrat gave him access to powers and enchantments they knew nothing of.
* '''Clivet:''' As they stormed his home, Lord Hazeel made preparations for his eventual return. We, his faithful followers, have been working to bring that about ever since.
* '''Player:''' What makes you think I care about the politics and histories of Ardougne?
* '''Clivet:''' I could kill you right now and be done with it, but I don't think you're the fool that the Carnilleans believe you to be. Instead, I offer you a chance to join us.<!--VarPlayer 223 2 to 3-->
* '''Clivet:''' Help us bring about the return of Lord Hazeel, and you will be well rewarded. However, should you continue to try and prevent his return, you will suffer the wrath of Zamorak.
* '''Player:''' Hmm...
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Before I decide, I have some questions for you.}}
** '''Player:''' Before I decide, I have some questions for you.
** '''Clivet:''' Very well.
** {{tselect|Select an Option}}
** {{topt|Tell me more about Hazeel.}}
*** '''Player:''' Tell me more about Hazeel.
*** '''Clivet:''' Lord Hazeel is one of the great Mahjarrat who once fought alongside Zamorak himself. He ruled this region for many years, until the cowardly Carnilleans rebelled against him.
*** '''Player:''' But he survived?
*** '''Clivet:''' Of course! The Mahjarrat know magic that others can only dream of. Lord Hazeel used his abilities to ensure that one day he'd eventually return. That day will soon be upon us.
*** {{tact|other}}
** {{topt|Why did the Carnilleans rebel against Hazeel?}}
*** '''Player:''' Why did the Carnilleans rebel against Hazeel?
*** '''Clivet:''' The Carnilleans served the pathetic Saradomin. They considered it their duty to overthrow Hazeel due to his loyalties to Zamorak. They were fools, blinded by Saradominist propaganda!
*** '''Player:''' Saradominist propaganda?
*** '''Clivet:''' Yes! Something even more prevalent today. Too many people now are fooled into believing that Saradomin is a god of good, while Zamorak is evil. Those lies couldn't be further from the truth!
*** {{tact|other}}
** {{topt|Why do you keep breaking into the Carnillean Mansion?}}
*** '''Player:''' Why do you keep breaking into the Carnillean Mansion?
*** '''Clivet:''' There is something we need inside. I will say no more unless you agree to join us.
*** {{tact|other}}
** {{topt|What can you tell me about the Mahjarrat?}}
*** '''Player:''' What can you tell me about the Mahjarrat?
*** '''Clivet:''' Surely you have heard of the Mahjarrat? Their race is the ultimate example of power! Each of them wields the strength of an entire army. To oppose any one of them, is to face your doom!
*** '''Player:''' And Hazeel is one of them?
*** '''Clivet:''' More than that! Hazeel is one of the greatest Mahjarrat to have ever lived!
*** '''Player:''' I see.
*** {{tact|other}}
** {{topt|Actually, I have no questions.}}
*** '''Player:''' I have no more questions.
*** '''Clivet:''' Then we have nothing more to discuss until you've made your choice.
*** {{tact|previous}}
* {{topt|Alright, I've made my decision.}}
** '''Player:''' Alright, I've made my decision.
** '''Clivet:''' And?
** {{tselect|Select an Option}}
** {{topt|I'll help you.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'll help you.
*** '''Clivet:''' Good. Now, we are not the monsters that the Carnilleans would claim we are, so we were hoping to do this without violence. However, the fact they sent you here makes it clear that won't work now.
*** '''Player:''' Meaning?
*** '''Clivet:''' You must prove your loyalty to our cause, and Ceril Carnillean must die. Kill him for us, and we will know you are truly dedicated to Lord Hazeel.
*** {{tselect|Select an Option}}
*** {{topt|Alright, how do I do it?}}
**** '''Player:''' Alright, how do I do it?
**** '''Clivet:''' I can already tell I was right about you. I can see you are of exactly the right character to join the followers of Hazeel.<!--varplayer 223 to 4-->
**** '''Clivet:''' Here, take this poison and pour it into Ceril Carnillean's food. Once the deed is done, return here and speak to me once more.
**** {{tact|If the player has a full inventory:}}
***** {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|Clivet tries to give you some poison, but you don't have enough room to take it.}}
***** {{tact|end}}
**** {{tact|If the player inventory space:}}
***** {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|Clivet gives you some poison.}}
***** {{tact|end}}
*** {{topt|I need some time to think on this.}}
**** '''Player:''' I need some time to think on this.
**** '''Clivet:''' Don't take too long.
**** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|I won't help you.}}
*** '''Player:''' I won't help you.
*** '''Clivet:''' Then you are a fool. Go back to your small-minded little life. You will never know the glories you could have tasted as one of us!
*** '''Player:''' You know I'm going to stop you, right?
*** '''Clivet:''' You'll try, but you'll never find us.
*** {{tbox|Clivet jumps onto the nearby raft and pushes off into the sewer system.}}
** {{topt|Actually, I need more time to think on this.}}
*** '''Player:''' Actually, I need more time to think on this.
*** '''Clivet:''' Don't take too long.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|I need some time to think on this.}}
** '''Player:''' I need some time to think on this.
** '''Clivet:''' Don't take too long.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Clivet again before joining===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Clivet:''' So, you've returned. I hope you're here because you've recognised the folly in serving the Carnilleans. Think about what you could achieve if you join us instead.
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Before I decide, I have some questions for you.}}
** {{tact|above}}
* {{topt|Alright, I've made my decision.}}
** {{tact|above}}
* {{topt|I need some time to think on this.}}
** {{tact|above}}

==Joining the Carnillean side==
===Talking to Alomone===
* '''Alomone:''' How did you get in here?
* '''Player:''' I've come for the Carnillean family armour. Hand it over, or face the consequences.
* '''Alomone:''' I thought I made it clear to Jones that you could not be allowed to interfere with our mission. The incompetent fool must be going soft.
* '''Player:''' So the butler's part of your little cult? Why is it always the butler? I should have known...
* '''Alomone:''' Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! Die!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Clivet===
* '''Clivet:''' You! Leave this place at once, before we're forced to make you!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Hazeel Cultist===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Hazeel Cultist:''' You have no place here! Leave now, before someone makes you!
* {{tact|end}}

===Retrieving the Carnillean armour from the chest===
===If Alomone is alive===
* '''Alomone:''' Get away from that chest!
* {{tact|end}}

===If Alomone is killed first===
* {{tcond|If the player has a full inventory:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Carnillean armour detail.png|You find some armour in the chest, but you don't have enough room to take it.}}
* {{tcond|If the player has enough space:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Carnillean armour detail.png|You find some armour in the chest.}}

===Talking to Butler Jones===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Hello, adventurer. How are you doing with your quest?
* '''Player:''' Drop the act, Jones. I know you're in league with the cultists.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Have you hit your head? That's a preposterous accusation!
* '''Player:''' Really? So you won't mind me telling Ceril then?
* '''Butler Jones:''' Oh, you think he'll take your word over mine? He trusts me completely!
* '''Player:''' We'll see about that.
* {{tact|end}}

===Returning the armour===
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' You're back. Have you had any luck yet?
* '''Player:''' Look! I've recovered your armour!
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Well done! I must say I am very impressed! Come on, hand it over.
* {{tbox|pic=Carnillean armour detail.png|You give the armour to Ceril.}}
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Before we send you on your way with your payment, I'll just get Jones to whip you up a batch of his special broth.
* '''Player:''' I'd rather not if it's all the same to you. Apparently Jones is in league with the cultists.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' What? Right! You! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now, once and for all!
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Jones! This commoner says you had something to do with the cultists that stole my armour. What do you have to say for yourself?
* '''Butler Jones:''' Nothing to do with me, sir. I am, as you know, a loyal servant.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Humph. Quite right too. I cannot fathom why this scoundrel would accuse you of such a crime without evidence to back up the accusations.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Right, I have made a decision. I have given my word as a nobleman to reward you for your efforts in retrieving my armour, but I must also compensate Jones for this terrible slander.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Now take this and leave! And don't darken my doorstep again!
* '''Butler Jones:''' Don't worry, sir, he won't be bothering us any more.
* {{tbox|Jones smirks at you. You are going to need more than words to prove his treachery.}}
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Cecil====
* '''Player:''' Hey! You owe me money.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' I owe you nothing you scoundrel! Now get out or I'll have Jones throw you out!
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Henryeta====
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' You! Don't think you can go around insulting our trusted staff and then waltz up to me as though nothing has happened!
* '''Player:''' Everything I said was the truth.
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' Ha! Don't be so ridiculous! Next you'll be trying to tell me that Jones murdered our old butler!
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Philipe====
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' Daddy says you don't like Mr Jones. Mr Jones is nice. He brings me toys and sweets.
* '''Player:''' Jones is a bad man.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' Well if you think that, I don't like you!
* '''Player:''' Well I'll do my best to console myself over your feelings towards me.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Butler Jones====
* '''Butler Jones:''' I believe you've been asked to leave, adventurer.
* '''Player:''' You won't get away with this, Jones! I know who you really are!
* '''Butler Jones:''' That's quite enough of that. All of us here are starting to tire of your theatrics.
* '''Player:''' This isn't over! I will find proof!
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Claus the Chef====
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Claus the Chef:''' Hello. How are you today?
* '''Player:''' Not bad, thanks.
* '''Claus the Chef:''' Good good.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to the Guard====
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Guard:''' Hello, adventurer. I hear you accused Jones of being part of that cult. Is that true?
* '''Player:''' It is, but nobody believes me.
* '''Guard:''' You have my utter faith, adventurer. I can't openly defy Sir Ceril, but I'd like you to know that I think you're on the right track with this.
* '''Guard:''' I always found it suspicious that Jones would just show up on the doorstep the very day after the old butler died. Good luck in clearing your name
* {{tact|end}}.

===Accusing the butler===
* {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|pic2=Hazeel's mark detail.png|You search the cupboard and find a bottle of poison along with a mysterious amulet.}}
* '''Player:''' And what do we have here...
* '''Player:''' Ceril!
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' What do you want now you scoundrel?
* '''Player:''' Take a look at what I've found.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' What's this... Poison?
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Jones?
* '''Butler Jones:''' Just for killing rats, sir.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Right... but this amulet... I recognise this! Those cultists wore amulets like this!
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Jones! We trusted you! We took you into our home!
* '''Butler Jones:''' You senile old fool... it was all too easy! I should have killed you and your pathetic family weeks ago!
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Guard!
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' This man is one of those cultists! Take him away!
* '''Butler Jones:''' Don't think this is over, Ceril! You will die at the hands of the Hazeel Cult! I promise you that!
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Well... It looks like I am indebted to you!
* '''Player:''' No problem. We all make mistakes.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' But if it weren't for you... my whole family... we could have been...
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' I apologise for my harshness before. The very least I can do is to reward you for your noble efforts, and to offer my sincerest apologies as a gentleman.
* '''Player:''' Thank you.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' No, no, thank you! Feel free to stop by anytime, adventurer!
* {{qact|Congratulations! Quest complete}}

==After quest completion==
===Talking to Ceril===
* '''Player:''' Hello, Ceril.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Hello again, adventurer! It's good to see you! If it wasn't for your quick thinking, the treacherous Jones would have probably poisoned my family and I by now! We are in your debt.
* '''Player:''' Don't worry about it! A good deed is its own reward. And that money didn't hurt either.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Guard===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Guard:''' Well look who it is! Good to see you managed to clear your name. I always had faith in you!
* '''Player:''' Thanks! So is everything all quiet around here now?
* '''Guard:''' Indeed! For now at least, everything is back to normal.

===Talking to Philipe===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' What have you brought me? I want some more toys!

===Talking to Henryeta===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' Hello again, adventurer. Since you dealt with those horrible cultists, things have vastly improved for us around here!
* '''Player:''' I'm happy to have helped.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Claus===
* '''Player:''' Hey.
* '''Claus the Chef:''' Well hello there, adventurer! Are we fit and well?
* '''Player:''' Absolutely.
* '''Claus the Chef:''' Glad to hear it.
* {{tact|end}}

==Joining the Hazeel side==
===Obtaining the poison after an initially full inventory===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Clivet:''' Here's that poison you need. Take it and pour it into Ceril Carnillean's food. Once the deed is done, return here and speak to me once more.
* {{tact|If the player has a full inventory:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|Clivet tries to give you some poison, but you don't have enough room to take it.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tact|If the player inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|Clivet gives you some poison.}}<!--varbit 14782 from 0 to 1-->

===Talking to Clivet again===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Clivet:''' You have a mission for us, adventurer. Go to the Carnilliean household and poison Ceril Carnillean's meal to prove your loyalty.
* {{tact|If the player has poison in their inventory:}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tact|If the player has no poison in their inventory:}}
** '''Player:''' I need some more poison.
** '''Clivet:''' Fool! Be more careful with it this time.
** {{tact|If the player has a full inventory:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|Clivet tries to give you some poison, but you don't have enough room to take it.}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tact|If the player inventory space:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|Clivet gives you some poison.}}
*** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the guard===

* '''Guard:''' Hello there. I hear you're after that cult who broke in the other night. It always gladdens me when civilians assist the law like this.
* '''Player:''' I'm just happy to be of help.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Butler Jones===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Hello, adventurer. I hear your quest is going well.
* '''Player:''' Really?
* '''Butler Jones:''' Oh yes. Do keep up the good work.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Ceril===
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' You're back. Have you had any luck yet?
* '''Player:''' I'm afraid not, Ceril.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' That's Sir Ceril you blooming scoundrel! Show respect when addressing someone of my rank! I must say, I am a bit disapointed you haven't made any progress. Maybe I was wrong about you.
* '''Player:''' Yeah, well, just unlucky I guess.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Henryeta===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' Oh, hello. I hope you've found those awful cultists! I simply cannot sleep at night knowing they're loose!
* '''Player:''' I'm afraid I haven't found them yet.
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' Well you really are useless, aren't you?
* '''Player:''' Yup, I guess I am.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Philipe===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' Mommy said you're here to kill all the nasty people that keep breaking in.
* '''Player:''' Something like that.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' Can I watch?
* '''Player:''' No!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Claus===
* '''Player:''' Hey.
* '''Claus the Chef:''' You're that adventurer the family asked to help deal with those weird cultists, right?

* {{tact|end}}

===Inspecting the range===
* {{tbox|A pot of soup is bubbling away on the range.}}

* {{topt|Yes.}}
** {{tbox|pic=Poison (item) detail.png|You pour the poison into the pot and it dissolves into the soup.}}<!--Varplayer 223 to 5, varbit 14779 to 1-->

===Using the poison on the range===

===Talking to Claus after the poisoning===

* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Henryeta after the poisoning===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Henryeta Carnillean:''' Those hooligans! They slaughtered my precious Scruffy! I shall never recover! I am emotionally scarred for life!
* '''Player:''' Yeah... Hopefully someone finds them soon.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Butler Jones after the poisoning===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Hello, adventurer. Such a terrible shame about Scruffy. I wonder if the family will ever fully recover.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Anyway, I hear your quest is going well.
* '''Player:''' Really?
* '''Butler Jones:''' Oh yes. Do keep up the good work.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Philipe again===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' Someone killed Scruffy. I liked Scruffy. He never told me off.
* '''Player:''' Yeah... it's a real shame.
* '''Philipe Carnillean:''' I want my mommy.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Ceril after the poisoning===
* '''Player:''' Hello again.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Oh the inhumanity... the cruelty... the misery... the pain...
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' My son is a good boy, really, but how could he give his dinner to Scruffy without having the servants test it for poison first? How? How could he be so thoughtless and careless? He knows we are all under threat!
* '''Player:''' Scruffy?
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' He's been with our family for twenty years... that's 140 in dog years! The poor dog... What did he ever do to deserve such a fate?
* '''Player:''' Your dog got poisoned? That's not right.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' I agree! I hope whichever evildoer is responsible gets the full weight of the law brought upon them!
* '''Player:''' Uh... yeah... me too. <!--varbit 14775 to 1-->
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Ceril again after the poisoning===
* '''Player:''' Hello again.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Oh the misery... How could someone do something like this?
* '''Player:''' Uh... I'm sure they won't get away with it...
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the guard again===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Guard:''' Today is a dark day. Those cultists have been back, and this time they've gone further than ever before! Murder! We can't afford to keep letting them get away with this.
* {{tact|end}}

==The scroll==
===Talking to Clivet===
* '''Player:''' I poisoned the food as requested, but it didn't quite go to plan.
* '''Clivet:''' Yes, we heard all about it from one of our sources. It's a shame that Ceril Carnillean survived, but that is no fault of yours. You have proven your loyalty to Hazeel.
* '''Player:''' So what now?
* '''Clivet:''' I would like you to meet with our leader, Alomone. You'll find him in our hideout, deeper in the sewers. You can use this raft to get there.
* '''Clivet:''' However, be warned that reaching the hideout is impossible unless the flow of water down here is set correctly. You'll need to use the sewer valves above to do that.
* '''Player:''' But how will I know how to set the valves? <!--varbit 14777 to 1-->
* '''Clivet:''' For that, you'll need this.
* {{tact|If the player has a full inventory:}}<!--varbit 14776 to 1-->
** {{tbox|pic=Hazeel's mark detail.png|Clivet tries to give you an amulet, but you don't have enough room to take it.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tact|If the player has inventory space:}}<!--varbit 14776 to 1-->
** {{tbox|pic=Hazeel's mark detail.png|Clivet gives you an amulet.}}
** '''Clivet:''' Going from left to right, turn each of the five sewer valves above so that they follow the design of the amulet. Once you've done that, you'll be able to use the raft here to enter our hideout.
** {{tact|end}}

====If the player did not have enough space for the amulet====
* '''Clivet:''' Here, you'll need this.<!--varbit 14776 to 1-->
* {{tbox|pic=Hazeel's mark detail.png|Clivet gives you an amulet.}}
* '''Clivet:''' Going from left to right, turn each of the five sewer valves above so that they follow the design of the amulet. Once you've done that, you'll be able to use the raft here to enter our hideout.
* {{tact|end}}

* {{tact|If the player has a full inventory:}}

* {{tact|If the player has inventory space:}}

* '''Clivet:''' Be warned, you'll need to ensure the flow of water down here is set correctly for you to be able to use the raft.

===Talking to a Hazeel cultist===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Hazeel Cultist:''' I cannot talk right now. Lord Hazeel will soon be back with us and I have many preparations to make.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Alomone===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Alomone:''' Well, well, well... we have a new recruit. Clivet told me of your desire to join us in our glorious task to resurrect the mighty Hazeel.
* '''Player:''' That's right.
* '''Alomone:''' Well if all goes well, you'll play a key role in just that. Before his defeat, Hazeel secured within his home a powerful magical scroll of restoration. It remains there still, hidden to even the foolish Carnilleans.
* '''Alomone:''' Up to now, our attempts to recover this scroll have been met with disappointment. However, I know you will not fail us.
* '''Player:''' So you want me to find this scroll?
* '''Alomone:''' That is correct. You must return to the Carnillean Mansion and find where it is hidden. We already have an agent in place to support you.
* '''Player:''' You do?
* '''Alomone:''' Indeed. Their Butler Jones is in fact a faithful follower of Hazeel. He has been unsuccessful in locating the scroll himself, but together the two of you will find it.<!--varplayer 223 to 6, varbit 14779 to 2-->

* {{tact|If the player has the scroll in their inventory:}}
** '''Player:''' Yes, I have it right here.<!--varbit 14780 to 1)-->
** '''Alomone:''' At long last! With the words contained within this scroll, our lord shall finally return to us!
*** '''Alomone:''' Watch adventurer, and witness the glorious rebirth of Hazeel!
** {{qact|Alomone begins to revive Hazeel.}}
** '''Alomone:''' Sentente sillaberi junque dithmento! Ia! Ia! Dextrimon encanto! Termando... Imcando... Solly enty rando... Sentente! Ia! Ia! Indenti zaggarati g'thxa!
** '''Alomone:''' Dintenta! Sententa! Retenta! Q'exjta! Ia! Sottottott! Ia! Dysmenta junque fammatio svelken! Sottey! Sentey! Soloment!
** {{qact|Hazeel awakens from the coffin.}}
** '''Hazeel:''' My loyal followers, I have pride in you all. You have achieved a feat many would have considered impossible and returned me to this land.
** '''Hazeel:''' Much time has passed and I have much to attend to, but first, I believe there is one here who deserves my gratitude.
** '''Hazeel:''' Adventurer, I know that your efforts were essential in bringing about my return. You have my thanks. Know that I consider you an ally.
** '''Hazeel:''' Now, I must leave you, loyal subjects, for time is short. My Mahjarrat kin will soon head northwards, and I have much to prepare.
** '''Hazeel:''' Rest assured, when my work is done, I will return to you. Before long, the world will know of Hazeel once more!
** {{qact|Quest complete}}<!--varbit 14781 to 1, varplayer 223 to 9-->
* {{tact|If the player does not have the scroll in their inventory:}}
** '''Player:''' Nope, sorry.
** '''Alomone:''' You must find it and bring it to me! Hazeel has already waited far too long for his return.
** {{tact|end}}

title: Transcript:Hazeel Cult/Historical
content:
{{Transcript|quest|link=Hazeel Cult}}

==Starting off==
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Blooming, thieving, weirdo cultists! Why don't they leave me alone? String 'em all up, that's what I say!
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|What's wrong?}}
** '''Player:''' What's wrong?
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' It's those blooming cultists from the forest! Those freaks keep breaking into my house!
** '''Player:''' Have they taken much?
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' They first broke in months ago and stole a suit of armour. The strange thing is that they've broken in four times since but taken nothing.
** '''Player:''' And you are...?
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Why, I am Sir Ceril Carnillean! We really are quite a famous bloodline... who've played a vital role in the politics of Ardougne for many generations.
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Perhaps you would be able to assist me in returning the stolen armour? For a modest cash reward of course!
** {{tselect|Select an Option}}
** {{topt|No thanks. I've got other plans.}}
*** '''Player:''' No thanks. I've got other plans.
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' No wonder I'm the one with the big house, and you're the one on the streets.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|Yes, of course, I'd be happy to help.}}
*** '''Player:''' Yes, of course, I'd be happy to help.
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' That's very noble of you sirrah! I caught a glimpse of the thieves leaving but due to... uh.. yeah, my cold I was unable to give chase.
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' They're some kind of crazy cult who dress all in black, and hang out near the cave entrance in the forest south of here.
*** '''Player:''' How do you know that?
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' My old butler, Higson, once followed them to their hideout there. Unfortunately the next night he died in his sleep.
*** '''Player:''' That's awful!
*** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' No, it's ok. A replacement arrived the next day. He's been great - cooks an excellent broth!
*** '''Player:''' Ok. I'll see what I can do.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|You probably deserve it.}}
** '''Player:''' You probably deserve it.
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' And who are YOU to judge ME? Hmmm. You look like a peasant anyway. I'm wasting my time talking to you.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|You seem uptight, I'll leave you alone.}}
** '''Player:''' You seem uptight. I'll leave you alone.
** '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Yes, I doubt you could help anyway.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Ceril again===
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' Have you had any luck yet?
* '''Player:''' I'm afraid not Ceril.
* '''Ceril Carnillean:''' That's SIR Ceril you blooming scoundrel! Show respect when addressing someone of my rank! It's strange you haven't recovered it yet though as Jones seemed quite sure of their location.
* '''Player:''' Yeah, well, just unlucky I guess.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Butler Jones===
* '''Player:''' Hello. What is this building?
* '''Butler Jones:''' This is the home of Sir Ceril Carnillean of the noble Carnillean family. You're welcome to look around, but I'm afraid I'll have to keep an eye on you.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Recently we've been having a real problem with thieves and strange cultists coming out of the forest for some reason.
* '''Player:''' That's a shame.
* '''Butler Jones:''' Yes, well, these things are bound to happen when you're as wealthy as the Carnilleans.
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Have you any more info on the Carnilleans?}}
** '''Player:''' Have you any more info on the Carnilleans?
** '''Butler Jones:''' There's a lot I could tell you about the Carnillean family history. However, I'm afraid if I did speak about such matters I would be at risk of losing my job.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|How long have you worked here?}}
** '''Player:''' How long have you worked here?
** '''Butler Jones:''' Long enough to know the Carnilleans are not as innocent or noble as they seem.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Ok then, take care.}}
** '''Player:''' Ok then, take care.
** '''Butler Jones:''' You too.
** {{tact|end}}

====Using any item on Claus' range====
* '''Claus Carnillean:''' Oi - I don't want people messing around with my range!
* {{tact|end}}

==Confronting the Hazeel Cult==
* '''Player:''' Do you know the Carnilleans?
* '''Clivet:''' You mind your business, I'll mind mine.
* '''Player:''' Look, I KNOW you're hiding something. I've heard theres a cult hideout down here.
* '''Clivet:''' If you want to stay healthy you'll leave now.
* '''Player:''' I have my orders.
* '''Clivet:''' So... that two faced cold hearted snob has made you fall for his propaganda eh?
* '''Player:''' Sir Ceril Carnillean is a man of honour!
* '''Clivet:''' Is he now? Is he REALLY? There is a lot more to the Carnilleans than meets the eye you fool...

** {{tbox|Hazeel turns to look at your directly.}}

** '''Hazeel:''' You may not be a follower of Zamorak directly but your cunning and treachery mark you as a friend to the Mahjarrat. Rest assured; I will call on your assistance again.
** '''Hazeel:''' Weak as I am now, my strength shall return, and my followers will be greatly rewarded when my powers peak once more. Join me in my cause as my servant, and all
** '''Hazeel:''' the riches of this plane shall be yours to share, in domination over all who oppose my kind. You would be wise to pledge yourself now while you still may.
** '''Player:''' I serve nobody but myself.
** '''Hazeel:''' Your insolence shall be overlooked this time for I am in truth in your debt. Come close: I shall reward you with wealth such as you deserve.
** '''Hazeel:''' Although your true reward will be later, when Zamorak and I, together, lay waste to this miserable planet, and you are spared as an ally to us.
** {{tbox|Hazeel gives you some coins. They seem to be extremely ancient.}}
** '''Hazeel:''' And now I must leave you loyal subjects for time is short, and I have many pressing matters to address before I may make my return. I must leave now, and head Northwards
** '''Hazeel:''' to join my fellow mahjarrat and regain my strength and powers. I shall return when I am ready to fight my enemies and much blood shall flow across these lands!
** {{tbox|The cultists let out a mighty cheer}}{{Sic|No period.}}
** {{qact|Quest complete}}
* {{tact|If the player does not have the scroll in their inventory:}}

title: Transcript:Help refine the new skill!
content:
{{Transcript}}

[[File:Help refine the new skill! (1).jpg]]

Ahoy there, [player name]!

We asked, you answered - in your hundreds of thousands - and a new skill has been chosen for Old School RuneScape!

Over 178,000 of you voted, and Sailing was crowned the community's favourite!

Now it's time for the all-important refinement stage...

This stage will cover four main topics: Core Gameplay, Navigation, Reward Space, and Overall Game Interaction. 

To understand exactly what you want from each area of Sailing, we'll be bringing you detailed blog posts, videos and more across each topic to give you as much insight as possible.

And of course, there'll be plenty of surveys for each topic to make sure we're collecting all of your feedback accurately as we go. 

Ok. Time to hit the high seas of refinement!

CORE GAMEPLAY

AND SYSTEM LOOPS

Sailing will be an open-world skill, allowing you to explore, engage in maritime activities,  and upgrade your ship.

However, we want the skill to be trainable across the entire game (not just at sea!) so how should that work?

We'll be looking to hear all your ideas for training methods and other nautical activities!

[[File:Help refine the new skill! (2).png]]

[[File:Help refine the new skill! (3).png]]

NAVIGATION

AND MAP/SEA SCALE

We're committed to ensuring navigation is smooth and enjoyable across all devices, and for all 'Scapers. Tell us your preferences for those all-important navigational mechanics so we can land at the perfect solution! 

We'll also be looking at the map. It needs to be large enough to harbour thousands of players in the vast open sea, so we'll be discussing how to deal with scale.

REWARD SPACE

WHAT WILL YOU GET?

Not only will there be tons of reward opportunities from exploring new destinations, Sailing will also have many utility benefits for your account! And of course, you'll get to upgrade your very own vessel...

We'll consider how rewards may enhance existing skills and gameplay, ensuring that Sailing has a meaningful impact on the broader game and not just when you're out at sea.

[[File:Help refine the new skill! (4).png]]

[[File:Help refine the new skill! (5).png]]

OVERALL GAME INTERACTION

AND LORE

Sailing will be deeply rooted in the history of Gielinor. This means lots of opportunities for world-building and storytelling, allowing players to uncover new aspects of the game's rich lore via the high seas.

As we develop Sailing, we'll aim to integrate it deeply with other skills and activities, creating an interconnected and immersive experience!

BUT WAIT...

WHAT ABOUT SHAMANISM?

If you were following the polls closely, you'll have noticed that Shamanism came in a very close second! So close, in fact, that we've committed to revisiting Shamanism once we've fully explored Sailing.

LET'S GET STARTED

TAKE OUR FIRST REFINEMENT SURVEY!

We are committed to working closely with you, the community, to ensure that Sailing is a skill that everyone can enjoy.

So, we're kicking things off with an initial refinement launch survey - with more information about each of the four topics above to follow!

Please take the time to share your initial impressions - any information you share will help us to ensure smooth sailing towards a skill that we all really love!

title: Transcript:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective
content:
{{Transcript}}

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (1).jpg]]

EVENT RECAP

All Stars: PVP Championship

On November 24th egos were shattered in the All Stars: PVP Championship. Manked took 1st place and the $15,000 top prize, having won each of his matches without suffering a single loss. Notably, Mika lost 2-0 to Ironman Mr Mammal, PureSpam beat Skill Specs 2-0 in the groups, and MMORPG beat Purpp 2-1. However, Raikesy was the viewers' favourite and managed a 4th place finish with victories over Torvesta, DitterBitter, and Faux.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2).gif]]

Kebos Lowlands
and more coming soon

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (3).jpg]]

Kebos Lowlands

The fearsome Hydra dominates Mount Karuulm, and with a slayer requirement of 95 you can see why.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (4).jpg]]

Deadman Spring Finals

The Deadman Spring Season starts on December 15th. There's $30,000 up for grabs for the next champion!

Constantly Evolving

Monthly updates

There have been plenty of improvements to Old School over the last month – here are some of the changes you might have missed.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (5).jpg]]

Portal Nexus

The Nexus in your player-owned house allows you more teleport locations than ever before. Tele away!

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (6).jpg]]

PvP changes

We're making some improvements to how PVP operates, including the much-loved bounty-hunter.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (7).jpg]]

Premier Club

Our best-value yearly membership is now on sale! Get ready for the Kebos Lowlands and more in 2019.

Upcoming events

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (8).jpg]]

December 13th

It's about to get Christmassy

in Gielinor. Ho ho ho!

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (9).jpg]]

December 15th

Deadman Winter Finals: Permadeath

Soundtrack Vinyl and CDs now on sale

The Orchestral Collection and Original Soundtrack Classics can now be found at specialist and major music retailers globally! Save on shipping by seeking them out in person this Christmas.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (10).jpg]]

Don’t forget that both albums are also available to buy on the official merch store and to stream/buy on all major digital streaming and retail platforms

It's players like you that make Old School RuneScape the incredible game it is today. We thank you for your continued passion and support for the game we all love. We wish you, your friends, and your family all the best this holiday season.

The Old School RuneScape Team

title: Transcript:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2)
content:
{{Transcript}}

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (1).jpg]]

[player name],

Welcome to the April edition of the Old School Monthly Retrospective.

In this issue we'll recap everything you may have missed last month, including a new quest, Poll 75, and your first look at the rewards for A Kingdom Divided!

Amazing April
We've had a real April shower of content this month. Here are some of the highlights:

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (2).jpg]]

A kingdom Divided spellbook beta

Your first look at the rewards for completing A Kingdom Divided, a new quest coming this summer.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (3).jpg]]

Below Ice Mountain Launch

Assemble a crack team of adventurers in this all-new quest to discover Ice Mountain's secrets.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (4).jpg]]

Collection Log Changes

We've added loads of stuff to the Collection Log, along with a handy counter to keep track of your unique loot.

WHAT'S NEW?

Don't forget to cast your vote!

Coming out of April we've got two polls, ready and waiting for you to decide what content you want to see in the game!

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (5).gif]]

Poll 75

In this absolute chonker of a poll you can expect questions on everything from Slayer Helmets to raids, plus a variety of Quality of Life improvements.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (6).jpg]]

A night at the Theatre

The Theatre of Blood could be revamped with an introductory quest and new difficulty modes for both newbies and veterans.

May and beyond

Coming soon!

But that's not all - there's even more great content coming your way this summer. Here's a preview...

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (7).jpg]]

Clans

We're launching official support for Old School RuneScape Clans! Whether you and your mates are into Skilling or Slaying, you'll be able to team up and explore Gielinor together.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (8).jpg]]

A night at the Theatre

Should this quest pass the poll you'll get a fascinating and exciting lore-driven introduction to Theatre of Blood, plus new difficulty modes to try!

In other news

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (9).jpg]]

Phosani's Nightmare

We'll be giving you the chance to vote on whether or not you want to see her return, this time to stay! Take on this extra-scary version of The Nightmare of Ashihama for a chance at improved rewards, and a horrifying new pet metamorphosis.

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (10).jpg]]

Wilderness Changes

More than 30,000 of you replied to the Wilderness Survey - thank you! - and we're gearing up to start talking about what content changes we want to make. Keep your eyes peeled for more news incoming!

[[File:Here's your Old School Monthly Retrospective (2) (11).jpg]]

Improving

Quality of Life

February is all about listening to YOU! There will be be four themed polls for you to vote on throughout the month, each focusing on areas of the game that players want improved.

title: Transcript:Herman's book
content:
{{Transcript|item}}

This world of Gielinor has always had its share of heroes throughout its history. Tales of the daring exploits of legendary figures such as Arrav, Camorra, Robert and Wally have held children spellbound for generations. But even in these modern times, the world still needs heroes. One such figure, standing protectively between civilisation and the forces of chaos, is that of Dionysius. The young Dionysius was educated in Varrock, where records tell us that he regularly attended the local Saradominist chapel. Local tradition has it that Dionysius led a band of young men to graffiti the Zamorakian temple in the south of the city, although doubtless such things have happened often in the busy city that is Varrock. It was expected that Dionysius would become a priest, but he seems to have had other plans..

At the age of 15, the age at which children of that era completed their education, Dionysius is reported to have turned down a prestigious invitation to study on the holy island of Entrana. Instead he declared a wish to travel the world before settling to a permanent career.

The path trodden by the young Dionysius is a winding one. The older dwarves living near Keldagrim remember a youth of that name travelling through their mines at that time. They claim that he gave them great assistance in defending the mines from a rogue tribe of trolls, eventually driving the trolls out of those mines completely.

It is believed that the young Dionysius travelled amongst the mountain tribes after he left the dwarves. One tribe, now disbanded, used to tell of a strange mystical warrior named 'Deesus' - surely a corruption of 'Dionysius' - who helped defend their camp from the monsters that roam the northern lands. 'Deesus' was said to be an invincible warrior who wielded a powerful staff.

Dionysius subsequently travelled across the seas to the tropical island of Karamja, where some of the oldest natives tell of how he brought with him strange herbs that increased their powers in combat. He is also remembered for venturing into the deep caves underneath that island, where very few dare to tread. One Karamjan family claims that a pale-skinned 'shaman' visited their village a few generations ago and told them to build a hut over the entrance to the caves and demand money from anyone wishing to enter; this 'shaman' may have been Dionysius.

Even in the depths of the Kharidian desert, some still remember a stranger who lived with the tent-dwelling Bedabin tribe for a while, studying the great mysterious pyramid of the desert. No-one could make him speak of what he discovered about the pyramid or the desert bandits who live near it.

By now an adult, Dionysius returned to the civilised lands and finally travelled to Entrana. Always a tough youth, he had now learnt great magical powers, and many on Entrana recall that they were in awe of his abilities, venturing fearlessly into the cave under that

{{Colour|#800000|The rest of the pages seem to be missing.}}

title: Transcript:Het's capture
content:
{{Transcript|item}}

Osmumten's monument to Het is a sight to behold. I could spend days theorising about the symbolism behind every detail, but time is not on my side.

In this great chamber dedicated to his glory, Het himself is now imprisoned, guarded by an entity unlike any I have encountered: Akkha.

It is said that long ago, the Devourer was cursed never to gain followers. If this curse ever existed is hard to say, but if it did, its effectiveness seems to have diminished over the years. While few in number, there are those who truly pledge themselves to the Devourer and all her destructive ways.

To be a follower of the Devourer is to be an outcast at best. It's therefore no surprise that these outcasts have often banded together in solidarity. One mostly forgotten but still notable grouping was the Children of Rebirth.

The Children of Rebirth was a cult of former warriors dedicated to the Devourer's original form, Amascut - the goddess of rebirth. They were firm in their belief that they must achieve a perfect death, so that Amascut would allow them to be reborn in perfected form.

When the day of their supposed rebirth came, they performed a ritual to Amascut and poisoned themselves in her name. Of course, it was long assumed that their ritual achieved nothing, but it seems that assumption wasn't quite correct.

With Amascut long gone, the ritual instead called out to the Devourer and she arrived to find Akkha as the sole survivor among the many dead. His poison had failed, but he was on the verge of death.

The Devourer took Akkha and sealed him in a sarcophagus, trapping him between life and death. She then performed a ritual of her own, calling out to Het.

While Het almost certainly realised it was a trap, he was unable to ignore the call. Like many of his fellow cultists, Akkha's life prior to the cult was as a soldier dedicated to Het, and so the god felt he had a duty to help his former acolyte.

Het arrived expecting to face the Devourer, but was faced with a manifestation of Akkha himself. Fueled by vengeance against the god who had abandoned him, this manifestation gave the Devourer the distraction she needed to capture Het.

Now, all these years later, Akkha remains a slave to the Devourer. While still trapped in his sarcophagus, powerful manifestations of his emotions make for perfect guardians, ensuring that none will be able to free his former god.

==Before completion of [[Tale of the Righteous]]==
* '''Player:''' Hello. What are you doing here?
* '''Historian Duffy:''' Duffy's the name. I'm a natural historian from Varrock Museum. My team and I are here to explore this mountain.
* '''Player:''' It's just an old mountain isn't it? What natural history are you hoping to find here?
* '''Historian Duffy:''' Bahaha, you adventurers are all the same, never seeing past the fights and treasure...
* '''Historian Duffy:''' This Mountain is steeped in natural history, but our main focus is to study the lizard creatures that surround this area.
* '''Player:''' You're studying lizardmen?
* '''Historian Duffy:''' Indeed, they're a fascinating species! We're hoping to learn about their origins and how they've evolved.
* '''Historian Duffy:''' However, we're not very familiar with this region so we've enlisted the help of the Kourend Grand Library to aid us in our research.
* '''Player:''' What have you learned so far?
* '''Historian Duffy:''' Well, we have a theory that lizard creatures aren't natural at all, but were created by dark magical experiments.
* '''Historian Duffy:''' Right now we're looking for evidence to prove this theory, but's it's proving somewhat difficult.
* '''Player:''' Can I help at all?
* '''Historian Duffy:''' No thanks adventurer, natural history studies are delicate and precise... but if we ever need something haphazardly destroyed we'll let you know.

title: Transcript:Historian Minas
content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
* '''Player:''' Hello!
* '''Historian Minas:''' Hello there, welcome to Varrock Museum! Can I help you?
* {{topt|Tell me about the Museum.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about the Museum.
** '''Historian Minas:''' Well, as you can see we have recently expanded a great deal to cope with the influx of finds from the Dig Site. Also, of course, to prepare for the new dig we're opening soon.
** {{topt|Tell me about the new dig.}}
*** '''Player:''' Tell me about the new dig.
*** '''Historian Minas:''' Well, we recently had a large chunk of funds donated to us, so we sent out all sorts of explorers - I'm sure you'll meet them as you go around the world. People like Simon down in the desert near the pyramid as well
*** '''Historian Minas:''' as Aristarchus in Pollnivneach, Varmen and, of course, Anna Jones. Anyway, we think we have discovered an island that has massive archaeological significance. We can't say much beyond that at this point, as we haven't
*** '''Historian Minas:''' researched it. If you have the qualifications and help us out around the museum, I'm sure we could offer you a place on the dig when we're ready to go.
*** '''Player:''' That would be very nice.
*** {{tact|previous}}
** {{topt|I have some information which might be of use in your displays.}}
*** {{tact|below}}
** {{topt|Tell me about other sections of the Museum.}}
*** {{tact|below}}
* {{topt|I have some information which might be of use in your displays.}}
** '''Player:''' I have some information that might be of use in your displays.
** '''Historian Minas:''' That's grand! We're always glad to have more facts. Now, tell me what you know...
** {{tcond|If the player has Demon Slayer completed:}}
*** '''Player:''' Well, I recently defeated Delrith, a demon! I did it by using a sword called Silverlight, which is apparently the only sword that could do it. I can give you a description if you want?

*** '''Historian Minas:''' Only half?
*** '''Player:''' Yes. The gangs had a bit of a tiff, you see. A friend helped me get the other half and I returned it here to get my reward.

*** '''Historian Minas:''' Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around...and since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.
*** '''Player:''' Oh, random bits of tat, thank you very much.
*** '''Historian Minas:''' You're welcome!

** {{tcond|If the player has Rune Mysteries completed:}}
