content:
{{External|rs}}
{{Transcript|quest}}
{{Transcript list|King's Messenger|King Lathas|Idris|Morvran|Essyllt|Lord Iorwerth|Elf Tracker|Chemist|Tyras guard|Tyras guard (Catapult)|General Hining|Arianwyn}}

==Starting off==
===Message from the King===
* '''King's Messenger:''' I take it you are [player name]? King Lathas sent this message for you. He's not a man you'd want to keep waiting.
* {{tbox|<!--id: 3206-->pic=King's message detail.png|The messenger gives you a scroll.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Message===
{{Hastranscript|King's message|transclude=yes}}

===Talking to King Lathas===
* '''Player:''' I received your message my liege. How may I serve the kingdom?
* '''King Lathas:''' Ahh... adventurer. The repair work on the Well of Voyage has been completed. We're finally ready to move against my brother.
* {{topt|I assume you have a plan?}}
** '''Player:''' I assume you have a plan?
** '''King Lathas:''' I do indeed. I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.
** '''Player:''' Elves? I've never seen an elf before.
** '''King Lathas:''' Well that may well change soon. Apparently, my brother has been causing them quite a bit of trouble. As such, they've agreed to help us get rid of him once and for all.
** '''Player:''' So what do I need to do?
** '''King Lathas:''' You are to head into the Underground Pass and through the Well of Voyage. Lord Iorwerth, the leader of the elves, will send some representatives to meet you on the other side.
** '''King Lathas:''' With their help, you are to find my brother and kill him. Once that's done, return to me.
** {{tselect|Start the Regicide quest?}}
** {{topt|Yes.}}
*** '''Player:''' Very well. Anything else I should know?
*** '''King Lathas:''' My brother may not be the only threat you face. I hear the elves are currently dealing with a rebellion. The rebels likely won't take kindly to you working with their enemy so be on the look out.
*** '''Player:''' I see. I'll be careful.
*** '''King Lathas:''' Good luck adventurer.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|No.}}
*** '''Player:''' Actually, I don't think I'm ready for this yet.
*** '''King Lathas:''' As you wish. Return to me when you are ready and we will begin.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|What's the deal with your brother again?}}
** '''Player:''' What's the deal with your brother again?
** '''King Lathas:''' My brother, King Tyras, was always a bit of an explorer. He went on numerous expeditions to the lands west of here. On one of these expeditions, he was captured by the forces of the Dark Lord.
** '''King Lathas:''' The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity. The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil...
** '''King Lathas:''' As a result, I had a wall built around West Ardougne to act as a barrier between him and the rest of the world. Tyras is king of West Ardougne, sealing off the city was the only way to stop him and the Dark Lord.
** '''King Lathas:''' I knew people would never believe the truth, so I had the plague made up as an excuse for the cordon. I'm not proud of it, but it was the only way to keep people safe.
** '''Player:''' But now we're ready to stop him.
** '''King Lathas:''' Indeed we are. My brother has been gathering strength in the west, preparing to move against us. But now that we have a way through, we can move against him first.
** {{topt|Excellent. Do you have a plan in place?}}
*** '''Player:''' Excellent. Do you have a plan in place?
*** '''King Lathas:''' I do indeed. I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.
*** {{tact|above}}
** {{topt|Sounds good. See you later.}}
*** '''Player:''' Sounds good. See you later.
*** '''King Lathas:''' Farewell adventurer. Return to me once you are ready to begin.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Sounds good. See you later.}}
** {{tact|above}}

===Talking to Lathas again===
* '''Player:''' My liege. What must I do again?
* '''King Lathas:''' You are to head into the Underground Pass and through the Well of Voyage. Lord Iorwerth, the leader of the elves, will send some representatives to meet you on the other side.
* '''King Lathas:''' With their help, you are to find my brother and kill him. Once that's done, return to me.
* {{tact|end}}

==Entering Isafdar==
===Encountering Idris, Morvran, and Essyllt===
* '''Idris:''' Halt human! What are you doing here?
* '''Idris:''' Wait! What was that? What the...
* {{Qact|Morvran and Essyllt appear and kill Idris, then head towards the player.}}
* '''Morvran:''' Are you the human by the name of [player name]?
* '''Player:''' Yes that's me.
* '''Essyllt:''' Good... We've been expecting you. King Lathas sent word of your coming.
* '''Essyllt:''' You should speak with Lord Iorwerth. He will help you track down that brigand Tyras. You'll find his camp in the north west of the forest.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Elf Tracker before Iorwerth===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' Human! You must be one of Tyras's men. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to the Elf Tracker again====
* '''Elf Tracker:''' Leave me be. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with Lord Iorwerth===
* '''Player:''' Hello there, I'm [player name]. Your scouts said that I should come and see you.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Ahh... [player name]. Welcome to Tirannwn. I understand you've been sent here to rid us of that criminal Tyras. I offer my full support.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Unfortunately, most of my troops are currently dealing with a group of renegade elves. That does mean we're a bit more limited than we otherwise would be.
* '''Player:''' I see. I'll need to play this smart then.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Indeed. Now, Tyras and his forces moved camp recently so your first step will be to find their new camp. I have a tracker currently working in that area. I suggest you join up with him.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' You'll find him at Tyras's old camp. It's south east of here, just north of that poisoned lake. Once you've found the camp, come and let me know.
* '''Player:''' Thank you. I shall return when my task is complete.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Iorwerth again===
* '''Player:''' Where can I find that tracker again?
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' He should be at Tyras's old camp. It's south east of here, just north of that poisoned lake. Once you've found the camp, come and let me know.
* {{tact|end}}

==Tracking Tyras' Camp==
===Speaking with the Elf Tracker===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...
* '''Player:''' No I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' And you have something to prove this?
* '''Player:''' Well... Err... No.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' As I was saying... I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with Lord Iorwerth again===
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Good day [player name]. How may I help you now?
* '''Player:''' Your scout refused to help. He asked for proof that you sent me.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Bless his loyalty but curse his suspicion. Here he will recognise this.
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have enough inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|<!--id: 3208-->pic=Crystal pendant detail.png|Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a crystal pendant but you don't have enough room for it.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has enough inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Crystal pendant detail.png|Lord Iorwerth gives you a crystal pendant.}}
** {{tact|end}}

===Returning to the Elf Tracker===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...
* '''Player:''' No I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' And you have something to prove this?
* {{tbox|pic=Crystal pendant detail.png|You show the tracker the crystal pendant.}}
* '''Elf Tracker:''' That's Lord Iorwerth's pendant. He must have a lot of faith in you. Now, what is it I can help you with?
* '''Player:''' I need to find Tyras and kill him. Do you know where his camp is?
* '''Elf Tracker:''' Well this was his old camp. After the battle a few days ago they moved. We're yet to find them again.
* '''Player:''' Can I help at all?
* '''Elf Tracker:''' As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethren instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.
* '''Player:''' What is?
* '''Elf Tracker:''' Ahh I guess you can't see it with those human eyes.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' I tell you what. Now that you're here I may as well give you a hand. I'll search here on the east side. You check out the west end of the camp. Come and tell me if you find anything.
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with Lord Iorwerth again===
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' [player name], how goes your search? Any luck hunting down that brigand?
* '''Player:''' I've found no trace of him as yet.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' I'm sure you will find something at his old camp that can help you.
* '''Player:''' I'll take a look and see what I can find.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Good. Come find me when you've located the camp.
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with the Elf Tracker again before finding the tracks===
* '''Player:''' What should I be doing again?
* '''Elf Tracker:''' Check out the west end of the camp and see if you can find anything. I'll keep looking here. Let me know if you find anything.
* {{tact|end}}

===Finding the tracks===
* {{tbox|You try to follow the footprints but they lead into impassable woodland.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with the Elf Tracker again after finding the tracks===
* '''Player:''' I've found tracks leading off to the west. But they trail off into the trees. Beyond that I am unable to follow.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' These forests aren't always as dense as you'd think. If you look closer, you might see ways that you can get through. With that in mind, why don't you give it another go?
* '''Player:''' Thanks... I'll see what I can find.
* {{tact|end}}

===Returning to the Elf Tracker after finding the camp===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' How goes the hunt for that bandit camp?
* '''Player:''' I found it a short distance west of here.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' I'm sure Lord Iorwerth will be pleased to hear that. You should let him know.
* {{tact|end}}

===Fighting the Tyras Guard===
* '''Tyras Guard:''' {{overhead|I see you making friends with that elf, traitor!}}

===Talking to General Hining===
* '''General Hining:''' Yes, is there anything I can help with? I'm General of what's left of this army and I'm rather busy.
* '''Player:''' If you're a General can you help me meet the king?
* '''General Hining:''' The king will see no one. He can trust no one!
* '''Player:''' Is there no way I can see him?
* '''General Hining:''' In the coming battle he will stand between us and the end. Then you will see him.
* '''Player:''' Not quite what I had in mind.
* {{tact|end}}

==Making a Bomb==
===Speaking with Lord Iorwerth===
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' [player name] how goes your search... Any luck hunting down that brigand?
* '''Player:''' I've finally tracked the brute down. His camp is in a secluded bit of forest, almost directly south of here.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Good job. As we don't have the troops available to take on his forces directly, I suggest we try some alternative tactics.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' I have this book here which details an explosive reaction. We should be able to use it to create a bomb.
* '''Player:''' Well that should make short work of Tyras.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Indeed. Have a read through and see what you think. Once you have, let me know if you have any questions.
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have any inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|<!--id: 3230-->pic=Big Book of Bangs detail.png|Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room for it.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Big Book of Bangs detail.png|Lord Iorwerth gives you a book.}}
** {{tact|end}}

===Losing the book===
* '''Player:''' I lost my copy of The Big Book of Bangs.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Its{{sic}} lucky I had a scribe make a few copies then, is it not?
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have any inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|<!--id: 3230-->pic=Big Book of Bangs detail.png|Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room for it.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Big Book of Bangs detail.png|Lord Iorwerth gives you a book.}}
** '''Player:''' Thank you.
** {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with Lord Iorwerth about ingredients===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Good day [player name]. Have you had any luck with that book?
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|I need some quicklime.}}
** '''Player:''' I need some quicklime.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Quicklime?
** '''Player:''' Apparently it's made by heating limestone.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Ah, I see. There's a mine directly east of here where you can mine limestone.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Is there anything else I can help with?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I need some sulphur.}}
** '''Player:''' I need some sulphur.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Check the shore south of the old camp you were at earlier. I've seen sulphur there in the past, it comes from that poisoned lake.
** '''Player:''' Sounds good, thanks.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Is there anything else I can help with?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I need some naphtha.}}
** '''Player:''' I need some naphtha.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Naphtha?
** '''Player:''' According to the book, you get it through the fractional distillation of coal tar.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Well you should be able to get some coal tar from that poisoned lake to the south. As for the rest, I'm afraid I don't have the chemistry knowledge to understand it.
** '''Player:''' Hmm... I know someone from Ardougne who might be able to help. She knows a thing or two about chemistry.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Perfect! Take the book to her and see if she can help. Just don't tell her what it's for. Even if she's trustworthy, we can't take any risks.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Anyway, is there anything else I can help with?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I need a barrel.}}
** '''Player:''' I need a barrel.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Have a look around the camp, there should be some empty barrels lying around.
** '''Player:''' Will do, thanks.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Is there anything else I can help with?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I need a fuse.}}
** '''Player:''' I need a fuse.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Some sort of fabric should work. You can use the loom here if needed.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Is there anything else I can help with?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|That's all thanks.}}
** '''Player:''' That's all thanks.
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Let me know if you need anything else.
** {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with the Chemist===
* {{tselect|What do you want to talk about?}}
* {{topt|quest=No|Lamps.}}
* {{topt|Your quest.}}
** '''Player:''' Good day. I was hoping you could help me with something. I have a book which mentions the fractional distillation of coal tar. I don't know how to do that though.
** '''Chemist:''' Ah, you'll be wanting to use the still then. It's just outside.
** '''Player:''' How do I use it?
** '''Chemist:''' It's quite simple really. You have to get the still heat up very high for it to work. However, if it gets too hot it will burn out and you will have to start over.
** '''Chemist:''' You must also watch the pressure, if it gets too high you will also have to start over. There are valves to control pressure and tar flow. These will also affect the heat of the still.
** '''Player:''' Is that all?
** '''Chemist:''' You'll also need plenty of coal to keep the still hot.
** '''Player:''' I see, thanks for the information.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|quest=No|Impling jars.}}

==Committing Regicide==
===Returning to Lord Iorwerth before using the bomb===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Good day [player.] Have you had any luck with that book?
* '''Player:''' I have finished the bomb.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Excellent work. Now we can finally deal with Tyras.
* '''Player:''' So what should I do? Plant it in his camp?
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' No, you'll be spotted by the guards if you try that. You'll need to get it in from outside.
* '''Player:''' Any suggestions?
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Tyras and his men have used catapults against us in the past. Maybe you can turn one of them against him.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Now you'd better get going. Don't forget, you'll need a tinderbox to light that fuse. Return to me once the deed is done.
* {{tact|end}}

===Trying to use the catapult before distracting the guard===
* '''Tyras guard:''' Oi! Don't mess with that.
* {{tact|end}}

===Bribing the Guard===
* '''Player:''' Good day.
* '''Tyras guard:''' Yeah, what ya want?
* '''Player:''' I was wondering what you were doing out here?
* '''Tyras guard:''' I was just wondering what I was doing here too. I'm meant to be looking after this catapult but I can't keep my mind on the job. We've been living off field rations for almost a year now.
* '''Tyras guard:''' I keep seeing rabbits in this forest. What I wouldn't give to eat one, but I'm not quick enough to kill any and I'm no good with a bow.
* {{tcond|Without a cooked rabbit:}}
** '''Player:''' I can see how that would be distracting.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|With a cooked rabbit:}}
** '''Player:''' Well I have one here for you.
** '''Tyras guard:''' You cooked me a rabbit! Thanks a lot. You don't mind watching things while I take five to eat it, do you?
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Tyras' forces after killing him===
====Talking to the catapult guard====
* '''Player:''' All right.
* '''Tyras guard:''' They say the king died from a flying fire ball. Are you certain no one messed with the catapult while I was eating?
* '''Player:''' I was the only one here. I was watching the whole time.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to a Tyras Guard in the camp====
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Tyras guard:''' These are dark times, I must prepare for the coming darkness.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to General Hining====
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''General Hining:''' This is not a good place to be, go and prepare for the coming darkness.
* '''Player:''' What do you mean?
* '''General Hining:''' There is no great hero left to fight back the forces that face us now... Go, leave, prepare for the darkness. While you still have time!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Elf Tracker===
* '''Player:''' Hello.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' I take it that the huge explosion I just heard was you?
* '''Player:''' Yes, I've finally dealt with Tyras, he should cause you no more problems.
* '''Elf Tracker:''' This is good news indeed. Lord Iorwerth will be very happy. You should go and let him know.
* {{tact|end}}

===Reporting to Lord Iorwerth===
* '''Player:''' Lord Iorwerth, it is done.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Good good... One of my scouts reported that they saw his tent in a ball of flames. You have done well.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' I'm sure you will want to get back to your king and tell him. He will undoubtedly want some proof. He should trust me enough in this matter, Give{{sic}} him this letter, it verifies that the job is done.
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have any inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|<!--id: 3207-->pic=Iorwerth's message detail.png|Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a scroll but you don't have enough room for it.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Iorwerth's message detail.png|Lord Iorwerth gives you a scroll.}}
** '''Lord Iorwerth:''' As a token of my own thanks, I give you access to the pass through Arandar. You'll find the start of the trail in the far north east of the woods.
** '''Player:''' Thank you my lord.
** {{tact|end}}

===Losing the scroll===
* '''Player:''' Lord Iorwerth, I have lost the message for King Lathas.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Here have another copy, but don't let it fall into the wrong hands.
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have any inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|<!--id: 3207-->pic=Iorwerth's message detail.png|Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a scroll but you don't have enough room for it.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has inventory space:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Iorwerth's message detail.png|Lord Iorwerth gives you a scroll.}}
** '''Player:''' Thank you my lord.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Lord Iorwerth again===
* '''Player:''' Good day Lord Iorwerth.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' Have you delivered the message to King Lathas yet?
* '''Player:''' Not yet my lord.
* '''Lord Iorwerth:''' There is no time for delay, he'll need to see it.
* {{tact|end}}

==Reporting to King Lathas==
===Meeting Arianwyn===
* '''Arianwyn:''' Are you the human by the name [player name]?
* '''Player:''' Yes, that's me?
* '''Arianwyn:''' Thank Seren, maybe all is not yet lost.
* '''Player:''' What do you mean?
* '''Arianwyn:''' I am Arianwyn, leader of the Elven Resistance. We've been watching you since you arrived in Tirannwn. We know it was you that{{sic|should be who, not that}} murdered King Tyras.
* '''Arianwyn:''' There is much to explain and little time. You carry a message from Lord Iorwerth, do you not?
* '''Player:''' Well you seem to know everything else so I'll not lie. Yes.
* '''Arianwyn:''' Good, we understand each other well. Now hand it here and find the truth of who your real employer is.
* {{tbox|pic=Iorwerth's message detail.png|You show the message to the elf, he moves his lips silently and the seal on the message is parted.}}
* {{tact|(Opens [[Transcript:Iorwerth's message|Iorwerth's message]].)}}
* '''Player:''' I had no idea! Why would the king do this?
* '''Arianwyn:''' I have a few ideas, now is not the time to discuss them though. For now, you should go to King Lathas as normal. Give him the message and act like nothing unusual has happened.
* '''Arianwyn:''' Once you are done, return to Tirannwn and seek out Islwyn and Eluned. You'll find them roaming the Isafdar forest. They will bring you to me.
* '''Player:''' You want me to help you? Okay, what's in it for me?
* '''Arianwyn:''' The chance for redemption after all you've done? If that doesn't take your fancy, consider this...
* '''Arianwyn:''' This isn't a struggle for land or title. It is a war for life, all life. If Iorwerth and Lathas manage to summon Zamorak, we all die.
* '''Arianwyn:''' Deliver your message, act normal. We'll meet again soon.
* {{tact|end}}

===Speaking with King Lathas===
* '''Player:''' My lord, Tyras is dead!
* '''King Lathas:''' This is grand news indeed! You'll forgive me if I'm a little apprehensive about this, but I take it you do have proof?
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have the scroll with them:}}
** '''Player:''' No, I have nothing to corroborate this.
** '''King Lathas:''' I am sure you have done as you say, but on this matter I can afford no doubts. You must find something to confirm your story.
** '''Player:''' I'll see what I can do.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has the scroll with them:}}
** '''Player:''' Yes, I have a letter sent by Lord Iorwerth.
** {{tbox|pic=Iorwerth's message detail.png|You hand the king the message. He looks at the seal then opens it.}}

title: Transcript:Relobo Blinyo (logs)
Transcript:Remnant
content:
{{Transcript|scenery}}
{{Transcript list|Sliske|The Whisperer}}

==Palace==
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' What are you saying?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' The initial incident may not have been contained as well as we'd hoped.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' You assured me that all appropriate measures were taken!
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' We're talking about an unprecedented event here! All experts on the totem were lost. We had to make assumptions!
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' How bad are we talking?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' A pair of civilians.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Just the two?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' That we know of.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Then make sure it stays that way. From this point on, there can be no more mistakes.
* {{tact|end}}

==Residential District==
===Pub (upper floor)===
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Are you ready, my child?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' I... I think so.
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' He has doubts.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' No! It's just...
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Do not be afraid, my child, for you are not alone. Your voice will be one of thousands, singing an eternal silence.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' What do I need to do?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Seek out our divine order in the cistern below. They will guide you across the waves.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Go now, and keep our icon close, for it marks you as one of the chosen. Without it, you are forsaken.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Okay... I'll go right away!
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' And so another voice joins the Silent Choir.
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' He is afraid. He is not ready.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' It matters not. The day of ascension approaches. His fear will be washed away by the endless sea...
* {{tact|end}}

===East of Ketla's house===
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Do you think they'll ever let us leave?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Of course! Those foolish Saradominists think they've won. We'll wait until they let their guard down, then rise up and retake our fortress!
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' Ha! You are naive, child. The Empire is done. At best, we will live out our lives in secret down here. At worst, the Saradominists will find us and slaughter us all.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' You're lying! The Empty Lord will protect us!
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' The Empty Lord is gone! He will not answer your prayers!
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' You speak the words of a traitor!
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' I speak reason. Someone around here needs to!
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Hey! Where are you going?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' I have to get out! I can't live my life down here! I have to find a way out!
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' No! Wait!
* {{tact|end}}

==Science District==
===East side of furnace building===
''Mysterious Voice 4 has the silhouette of [[the Whisperer]].''
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' What is it? What's happening?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' The undercity is being sealed. They say the fortress has fallen.
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' Sealed? On whose orders?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Well... yours.
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' I gave no such order. Round up the centurions! We have a traitor among us.
* '''Mysterious Voice 4:''' No.
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' You! This was your doing!
* '''Mysterious Voice 4:''' You have served your Empire well, High Magister, but that servitude is at an end. Now it is time for a new one to begin.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' By the Empty Lord!
* {{tact|end}}

===Furnace building===
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' ...The requested ores. Fourty{{sic}} rune and adamant.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Thank you. Do you have a moment? An extra set of hands would be of great help.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Of course, though I have no knowledge of the process.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' A learning opportunity then. Chromium is one of our most significant discoveries. With it we have elevated the empire. It behoves us all to know how it is made.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' What do I need to do?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' I will insert the ores. That device, there, allows the air that flows into the furnace to be regulated. Pull it gently.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:'''  Watch where the adamant and the rune meet. We are looking for a silvery sheen.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' ...
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Is that it?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Yes. Half-way down now.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' The ores are... mixing?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Not quite. Melting rune and adamant would normally result in a simple blend. Now, pull it all the way down.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' But with the right amount of heat, pressure and air... There. Chromium. Alloyed rune and adamant.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Fascinating... That felt quite easy.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Chromium lies at the heart of Lassar. It is in our golems, our lights, even our walls. We have invested a lot to make producing it 'easy'. It was not always this way...
* '''Player:''' Rune, adamant and a furnace that can regulate air intake... The Blast Furnace in Keldagrim could work...
* {{tact|end}}

===South-west building===
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Did you see it? That thing in the science district?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' I did. What do you think it was?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' I don't know, but it was... beautiful, don't you think?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Beautiful? Not sure I'd describe a pillar as beautiful.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' That was no pillar. It was something far more. I need to get a closer look.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Are you okay? You're acting very odd.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' I'm fine. I just... I just need to see it again.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Right... Maybe it's best if I just leave you to it.
* {{tact|end}}

==Sealed remnants==
''The sealed remnants are always initially shown to the player in the following order, regardless of which one is initially viewed. Mysterious Voice 2 has the silhouette of [[Sliske]].''

===First===
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' What am I looking at here?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' An answer.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' To what question?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' What lies beyond?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' You don't mean...?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Yes.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Where was it found?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' The dwarves of Acheron uncovered it. They lost their home as a result.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' They fled south, but some remained under its control. They brought it with them.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' What became of these dwarves?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' They succumbed. It had no further use for them.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Could it do the same to us?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' I have shielded it. It will do you no harm.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Then we'd better not waste time. There are resources that can be diverted, though there will be pushback.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' It will be dealt with. My companion will remain to oversee your research. She will ensure that you face no barriers.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' I see... I'll ensure work begins at once.
* {{tact|end}}

===Second===
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' You've returned. I was starting to think you never would.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Your work does not require my presence.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Of course, it's just that your expertise would greatly benefit our research.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' You have been provided with expertise.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Forgive me, it's just...
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' You take issue with her?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' She makes the scientists uncomfortable.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Yes... I can imagine. Their discomfort will drive their work.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Well... As you wish.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Now, what do you have?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' The totem seems to act as a conduit between our world and the Shadow Realm. In theory, it could be used to harvest energy from there.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' In theory?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Well we've not tried it, of course. The risks...
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Will be managed.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' I... Of course. We'll make preparations.
* {{tact|end}}

===Third===
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' There has been a development.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Good. Then you are making progress?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Well... In a way, but the move to direct tests has come with... complications.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Explain.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Some of the volunteers needed... neutralising.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Progress requires sacrifice.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Yes, but... after doing so, they came back. It's like the totem reanimated them, but this was no normal necromancy.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' They weren't just mindless husks... It's like... they were still in there.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Their souls remained?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' It would seem so. They spoke as well.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' What did they speak of?
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Seas, curses and something called blackstone. It didn't really make much sense.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Curious... Explore this area further.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' But if news gets out...
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Ensure it does not.
* {{tact|end}}

===Fourth===
''Mysterious Voice 3 has the silhouette of [[the Whisperer]].''
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Is it true?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' The enemy marches on Lassar.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Are they after the totem?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' It destroyed their home. Perhaps they wish to destroy it in return.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' We should relocate it.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' No. The work will continue.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' But...
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' You have preparations to make. I would speak to my companion. Alone.
* '''Mysterious Voice 1:''' Of course.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' The dwarves have allied with Saradomin. Their strength is too great. Lassar will fall.
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Have the undercity sealed, then remove the protections on the totem. We require a more thorough test.
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' And the researchers?
* '''Mysterious Voice 2:''' Their work is complete. Do with them as you wish.
* '''Mysterious Voice 3:''' It will be done.
* {{tact|end}}

content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Without a ghostspeak amulet==
* {{tcond|When spoken to without a ghostspeak amulet:}}
* {{trandom}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 1}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
** '''Player:''' You don't say?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' You don't say!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' Well, I guess you didn't say.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 2}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
** '''Player:''' Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
** '''Player:''' Wow. I am soooooo rich.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
** '''Player:''' See ya around ghosty!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 3}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
** '''Player:''' Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 4}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
** '''Player:''' Why, thank you very much!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' I know, but what are you going to do?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 5}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
** '''Player:''' Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
** '''Player:''' Man, I love pie!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 6}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
** '''Player:''' We get signal!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' Somebody set up us the bomb!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' You have no chance to survive make your time.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo?
** '''Player:''' All your base are belong to us.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 7}}
** '''Player:''' Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' Are you threatening me?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 8}}
** '''Player:''' No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
** '''Player:''' Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
** '''Player:''' money from their very pockets!
** '''Player:''' Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
** '''Player:''' Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
** {{tact|end}}

==After [[Curse of the Empty Lord]]==
* '''Player:''' Hello again Rennard.
* '''Mysterious ghost:''' Ah, it be you again! What can I do fer ya?
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Ask about Kharrim.}}
** '''Player:''' Can you tell me where I can find Kharrim again?
** {{tcond|If Kharrim is in the [[Chaos Temple (church)]]:}}
*** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Kharrim the messenger... Well, he was always a devoted follower of old General Zamorak, and if I remember rightly Zamorak set up a small base in an old temple near Dareeyak...
*** '''Mysterious ghost:''' You might want to check around there.
*** '''Player:''' Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If Kharrim is in the [[Graveyard of Shadows]]:}}
*** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Kharrim the messenger... Last I'd heard of him, he'd headed off to Carrallagar to seek his fortune. Ya might want to check around there somewhere.
*** '''Player:''' Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If Kharrim is in the [[Lava Maze]]:}}
*** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Kharrim the messenger... The last I'd heard of that weasel he was claiming he'd found some underground deposit of runite ore guarded by demons and dragons.
*** '''Mysterious ghost:''' I suspect he was pulling some scam or other, but if you know of such a place, that might be a good place to start checking.
*** '''Player:''' Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Ask for more ghostly robes.}}
** '''Player:''' Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
** {{tact|opens2=Ghostly robes reclaim interface}}
** {{tact|receives=the requested piece(s) of [[ghostly robes]]}}
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Here you go.
** {{tact|end}}

==Speaking to the wrong Rennard==
* {{tcond|When spoken to in a location not in the player's [[Curse of the Empty Lord]] sequence:}}
* {{trandom}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 1}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' The endless tragedy of fate... Why must you torment me so?
** '''Player:''' Alright, alright, calm down, calm down. All I said was 'hello'!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 3}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' You can see me?
** '''Player:''' Uh... yes?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' And you understand my words?
** '''Player:''' Well, most of them...
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' This is incredible! How can such a thing have come to pass?
** '''Player:''' What can I say? I'm a professional.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 4}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Hello back at you.
** '''Player:''' So what's a nice ghost like you doing in a place like this?

** '''Mysterious ghost:''' I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 5}}

** '''Mysterious ghost:'''

** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 6}}

** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Mortal... Take heed of my example, and waste not your life, lest you may suffer the same fate as myself...
** '''Player:''' Huh? You mean someone did this to you?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' You have ascertained the truth in my words...
** '''Player:''' So who did it to you? And why?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Events of moons past, I remember not clearly...
** '''Player:''' Fine help you are then.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 7}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Hello stranger.
** '''Player:''' So.... Invisible ghost haunting the same place for thousands of years, huh?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' You have no idea...
** '''Player:''' Well, bad luck and all that. See ya around!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 8}} 
** '''Player:''' Hello there.
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Hello.
** '''Player:''' So you're a ghost, huh?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' Apparently.
** '''Player:''' In which case I only have one thing to say to you:
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' ...what?
** '''Player:''' Guess you don't have the amulet of humanspeak, huh?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' ...huh?
** '''Player:''' Yeah, that's right. WOO! WOOOWOOO WOO WOOOOWOO! Got no comeback for that, have you?
** '''Mysterious ghost:''' You are very strange...

That stone... It all comes back to that stone. Could it be THE stone? Unlikely, but we should make no mistake, a power like this wasn't made by men.

Transcript:Ricktor's diary (7)
content:
{{Transcript|item}}

==={{Colour|#7f0000|1st}}===
A grim morn as the frosts landed early this year; a surprise as it has been late these last three years. I met with Magister Sattayas who in discourse conveyed my request to Lord Arceuus to investigate the Dark Altar further.

I retired to Madam Turner's on the great concourse for mutton pie and drank to the health of the new King.

With Messrs. Stalae and Frayn I planned the first visit to the Dark Altar; due to take place on the morrow, with the utmost care due to the reputation it had received.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|2nd}}===
A fair day in regards to the content rather than the weather. The rain did beat down heavily and seemed to only increase as we approached the Dark Altar. Unperturbed we continued and felt the better for our persistence the closer we got to the altar.

Messrs. Stalae and Frayn proceeded to survey the site as I studied the ancient text found around the Altar itself. I feel that even though the text is ancient I will be able to make progress on understanding it.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|3rd}}===
This morning the rain had turned to snow and seemed to beat down more fiercely than I have known in these past 42 years. I have never known it so treacherous. Nevertheless we arrived; although weather beaten for our troubles; at the Dark Altar.

As Messrs. Stalae and Frayn continued the survey I turned my attention to the ancient text carefully ensuring I was making notes accurately. Some of the forms of the text suggest ideas and thoughts to me which make me believe I shall be able to read this text before long.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|4th}}===
Travlyn Stalae was taken with a fever the last night. Mr Frayn and I continued to the Dark Altar. The weather was no better than the previous day, but mercifully it was no worse.

Without Mr Stalae to help Mr Frayn do the survey we both concentrated on ancient text. I found Mr Frayn's lack of imagination and understanding of ancient language intolerable. How he ever came to work for Magister Sattayas I will never know. I will have to raise his suitability for this task when I next speak to him.

Progress was slow and I feel I am no further to understanding the ancient text than I was yesterday.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|5th}}===
Yet again I must bear the company of Mr Frayn as Mr Stalae has worsened this night. I declare that the progress of this day did not surpass yester'; I will have to find other means of engagement for Mr Frayn. I spent much of the day in conversation with Mr Frayn about the meaning of one symbol in particular. His lack of understand{{sic}} of such matters still astounds me and does naught to inspire me with regard to his ability.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|6th}}===
I met upon the mid noon with Magister Sattayas; leaving Mr Frayn at the Dark Altar; with the purpose to find alternative engagement for Mr Frayn. The audience did not go well as Magister Sattayas disagreed with my assessment and I must tolerate Mr Frayn further.

Upon returning to the Dark Altar in the mid afternoon I discovered Mr Frayn studying the base. There was much temptation; some might call it provocation, to resolve the issue permanently. I did not.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|7th}}===
The wind continues to blow such a force tainted with biting snow these last seven days. I have not known such a tumultuous condition in all my memory. Nevertheless I was determined to continue my work at the Dark Altar however the King has shut the gates in order to have a day of thanks for our good health. The fool.

I could not do anything, let alone give thanks, as my mind was consumed with my work. If others would, or should I say could, understand the importance of my work they would let me pass and continue.

Instead I must console myself with quiet contemplation as I review my work.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|8th}}===
It is with relief that I awoke to the news that both Messrs. Frayn and Stalae both have a fever. Thus, my study of the Dark Altar can continue undisturbed by the nonsensical murmurings of others.

The progress was swift today as the symbols unravelled themselves in my mind. When I present my findings to the Magister he and his peers will see the true message that I bring them. They will see that I was always right and am far superior to them in intellect.

I was sore tempted to work through all the night as I feel so close to an epiphany which will uncover the final parts of this endeavour.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|9th}}===
The weather only seems to worsen; that means I should be interrupted less. I continue to grasp the basics of the language I am seeing but the message still alludes me. One word keeps appearing in all of the text I read, sacrifice. I do not yet know under what terms the word should be used, I must study further to understand more.

I arrived back at my lodgings to the news that Mr Stalae's condition is improved. I hope he has more intellectual capacity than the Magister and Mr Frayn.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|10th}}===
What a fool I was to think Mr Stalae would be any different to the Magister and Mr Frayn. The complete ignorance and uneducated manner was apparent as soon as I saw him again. His understanding of the language is beyond laughable and his translation of the symbol as 'death' rather than 'sacrifice, is simply absurd.

I do not doubt the Magister has no great understanding of the complication Mr Stalaen{{sic}} will bring to my studies, I shall have to find another use for him.

My work slows. Considerably.

==={{Colour|#7f0000|11th}}===
Today I may have stepped too far over the boundary of what is acceptable. As Mr Stalae and myself were at the Dark Altar I realised that to unlock the rest of the language a sacrifice was needed. It seemed obvious.

As the weather worsened through the day visibility dropped which gave me the opportunity to test my theory. At last I have found a purpose for Mr Stalae and Mr Frayn.

I do not regret my actions, there is always a cost to progress.

**** '''Roavar:''' our village. He could probably kill us all if he wanted us gone, so keeping on his good side is worth the sacrifice to us. Lucky we're not human really!

*** '''Roavar:''' Well, I'm not old enough to remember the full story behind it, but it was a terrible day for these lands when it was built there.
*** '''Roavar:''' Apparently, Morytania was once a strong and mighty kingdom, with lands spreading far further west than they do today, and south into the desert as well.
*** '''Roavar:''' That was all until the day when a sneak attack by the hated human forces who worship Saradomin burned our villages and slaughtered our peoples in mass. To rub salt into the wound, they then cursed the river as well!
*** '''Roavar:''' Luckily they seem to have calmed down somewhat recently, and tend to stay on their side of the river... but the wrong they have done my people will never be forgotten, and will never be forgiven!
*** '''Player:''' So you hate humans?
*** '''Roavar:''' Absolutely! If I ever met one I would gobble him up where he stands! And then chew the bones for dessert!
*** '''Player:''' Um, okay, thanks, bye.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Can I hear a story?}}
** '''Player:''' Can I hear a story?
** '''Roavar:''' A story??? Heh, well the only one I can think of right now is one my dear old mammy told me as a pup...
** '''Roavar:''' Now how did it go... Ah yes!
** '''Roavar:''' Once upon a time a brave young wolf was walking through a forest, when he came upon a human dressed all in red. 'Aha!' he thought to himself, 'Here's a nice easy meal!' But the human talked to him, and as he was
** '''Roavar:''' always taught to be a polite wolf, he spoke back to it.
** '''Roavar:''' Well, this cunning human told him that there was a better meal that would not run away in a house in the woods. As the brave young wolf could see that this human was not fully grown, he figured maybe he'd
** '''Roavar:''' better get a better meal at this house, so he ran as fast as his paws could carry him to the house the human told him about... inside he found an old human lying in bed, and although the meat was a little tough, as the
** '''Roavar:''' human was older than he thought, he had a good meal and decided to sleep it off in the house for awhile. He had not been asleep long though, when he was woken by a knocking at the door. The human in red had followed
** '''Roavar:''' him to the house! Suspecting a human trap, the brave young wolf put on the old humans clothes and jumped into the bed, so that he could pretend to be human and escape from this terrible trap! Well now, this human
** '''Roavar:''' dressed in red came into the house, and pretended to believe the brave wolf was really a human, and began to talk to him. But then the human started asking strange questions of the wolf, because the human knew that it
** '''Roavar:''' was not a human at all! The brave young wolf decided to try and escape, for it was only a young human, and not very strong, so the brave young wolf said he would eat the human if they did not let him escape! As he said
** '''Roavar:''' this however, the human in red shouted out at him: 'Aha! You are a wolf!' and as the human shouted this another bigger human ran into the room from outside! This bigger human was much stronger and was
** '''Roavar:''' carrying an axe, and the poor young wolf died in this terrible trap made for him by the humans.
** '''Roavar:''' And do you know what the moral of this story is?
** '''Player:''' Um... no, not really.
** '''Roavar:''' It's 'Never trust humans' of course! My dear old mammy told me that story when I was a pup, and I'm still alive and well to tell it to you today!
** '''Roavar:''' Pretty good story huh?
** '''Player:''' Um... yeah. It was great. Really.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Nothing thanks.}}
** '''Player:''' Nothing thanks.
** '''Roavar:''' ...I don't know why you talked to me if you don't want anything then...
** {{tact|end}}

==Standard dialogue==
===Normal variant===
* '''Player:''' So you're made entirely of rocks?
* '''Rock Golem:''' Not quite, my body is formed mostly of minerals.
* '''Player:''' Aren't minerals just rocks?
* '''Rock Golem:''' No, rocks are rocks, minerals are minerals. I am formed from minerals.
* '''Player:''' But you're a Rock Golem...
* '''Rock Golem:''' Yes, I am. This conversation seems to be confusing you; perhaps you should stop.
* {{tact|end}}

===Tin variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I feel strangely emotionless and empty. Maybe I should feel sad about it, but I can't.
* '''Player:''' You can't feel sad?
* '''Rock Golem:''' Correct. Now, if I only had a heart...
* '''Player:''' I'm not sure it works like that around here.
* {{tact|end}}

===Copper variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I have an idea for a song.
* '''Player:''' Oh?
* '''Rock Golem:''' Copper-copper-copper Cophelia - you come and go, you come and go...
* '''Player:''' Mmmhmm.
* {{tact|end}}

===Iron variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' Truth is, I am Iron Golem.
* '''Player:''' I can see that.
* {{tact|end}}

===Blurite variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I have an idea for a song.
* '''Player:''' Oh?
* '''Rock Golem:''' I'm blue, da-ba-dee da-ba-da.
* '''Player:''' I can see that.
* {{tact|end}}

===Silver variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' Oh dear, I've gone all pale.
* '''Player:''' Are you okay?
* '''Rock Golem:''' It must be something I ate.
* {{tact|end}}

===Daeyalt variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' Did you ever hear the tragedy of Queen Efaritay the Fair?
* '''Player:''' No?
* '''Rock Golem:''' I thought not.
* '''Rock Golem:''' It's not a story the Myreque would tell you.
* {{tact|end}}

===Coal variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' So near and yet so far... if my atoms were arranged a little differently, I could be diamond.
* '''Player:''' Would you enjoy being a diamond?
* '''Rock Golem:''' I expect I would, until someone tried chipping bits off me with a chisel. I'm probably safer as coal.
* {{tact|end}}

===Elemental variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I am so in my element right now.
* '''Player:''' Sigh...
* {{tact|end}}

===Gold variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I'm totally showing the bling today.
* '''Player:''' That's nice for you.
* '''Rock Golem:''' A little. Though sometimes I just feel like I'm being used as a status symbol, and no-one appreciates me for me.
* '''Player:''' Oh dear.
* '''Rock Golem:''' Don't worry. At least I look good.
* {{tact|end}}

===Granite variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' No-one appreciates granite.
* '''Player:''' Why do you say that?
* '''Rock Golem:''' I know how it works. No-one actually wants granite. They just chop us up and throw our pieces on the floor.
* '''Player:''' Oh, I can see that must be upsetting for you.
* '''Rock Golem:''' When you've seen your relatives cut into pieces, with their severed limbs cast aside like junk, THEN you will understand how I feel.
* '''Player:''' I'll bear it in mind.
* {{tact|end}}

===Mithril variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I feel sad today. Very blue.
* '''Player:''' Oh dear.
* '''Rock Golem:''' No-one understands me.
* '''Player:''' Why not?
* '''Rock Golem:''' Because argle gargle gooble goop.
* '''Player:''' ... I don't understand you either.
* '''Rock Golem:''' *sigh*
* {{tact|end}}

===Lovakite variant===
* '''Player:''' So how do you pronounce Lovakengj?
* '''Rock Golem:''' Silly human, it's pronounced Lova-Kane.
* '''Rock Golem:''' How did you not know that?
* '''Player:''' You know, it really isn't that obvious.
* {{tact|end}}

===Adamantite variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I may be green, but I'm not an environmentalist.
* '''Player:''' Why not?
* '''Rock Golem:''' There's no need. Whatever you may have read, even coal is a renewable energy source - just wait a minute and the rocks respawn.
* '''Rock Golem:''' You can burn as much as you like, too, without needing to worry about it affecting the climate - we don't have a lot of weather here.
* '''Player:''' That's handy.
* '''Rock Golem:''' Yes, I pity anyone whose world doesn't work like this one. I don't know how they can possibly cope.
* {{tact|end}}

===Runite variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I'm confused. It takes incredible skill to smith anything from my ore, yet the items you'd get are terribly mediocre.
* '''Player:''' Is that something that worries you?
* '''Rock Golem:''' It just feels like my world doesn't make sense, sometimes. But I suppose it's always been like this, and I've got used to it.
* {{tact|end}}

===Amethyst variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' Your world is amazing. I truly am in awe.
* '''Player:''' Did you just make an ore joke?
* '''Rock Golem:''' Maybe...
* '''Player:''' Well it was awful.
* '''Rock Golem:''' Ha! Now you're making them as well.
* '''Player:''' Are we really doing this? Amethyst isn't an ore anyway.
* '''Rock Golem:''' I can dream, [player name]!
* {{tact|end}}

===Lead variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' Why am I the one always following you?
* '''Player:''' What?
* '''Rock Golem:''' Well I'm the lead golem, so surely I should take the lead!
* '''Player:''' That joke doesn't even make sense... Those words aren't pronounced the same!
* '''Rock Golem:''' Well, blame whoever decided they should have the same spelling then.
* {{tact|end}}

===Nickel variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' I reckon I'd make a good thief.
* '''Player:''' There are probably better ambitions.
* '''Rock Golem:''' Maybe, but if I was one, I'd be able to nickel they have!
* '''Player:''' ...
* {{tact|end}}

===Rubium variant===
* '''Rock Golem:''' AAAAAAARRRRGGGGHHHH!
* '''Player:''' What's wrong? Are you doing a barbarian impression?
* '''Rock Golem:''' I FEEL SO ALIVE, SO CHARGED UP! I'M BRIMMING WITH POTENTIAL ENERGY! LET'S RUN, GO FASTER!
* '''Player:''' Maybe you should cool off? How about a swim?
* '''Rock Golem:''' THAT SOUNDS... bad.
* {{tact|end}}

===Battling another pet in the arena in the [[Menagerie]]===

* '''Rock Golem:''' {{overhead|Grrr!}}
* '''Rock Golem:''' {{overhead|Grrrr!}}
* '''Rock Golem:''' {{overhead|Grarrr!}}

content:
{{Transcript|item}}
<nowiki>*</nowiki>A lot of the diary is too caked in mould to be legible, but the last entry can still be made out.*

I found an unusual creature in the forest by the name of Crabidor Rank. He seemed tasty enough at first, but we've all fallen sick since eating him. To make matters worse, all of our blood stores have begun to rot into a sickly mush.

Perhaps this is another of House Drakan's plots. They call us savages, but wage biological warfare on us from afar. Lowerniel proved his might once before, but has retired to a life of cowardice.

It will not last. The glint in his eyes as he slaughtered his fellows cannot be left behind. House Drakan is built on the back of a slumbering, rabid, venator. One day that venator will wake with centuries of hunger repressed and the so called civilised Houses of Vampyrium will tremble. He would always have made a better Ghrazi.

content:
{{Transcript|item}}

==Reading==
Know that before the Council of Elders, for the health of our soul and those of our ancestors and heirs, and the better ordering of our kingdom, at the advice of Ethrain Hosidius, Seabry Shayzien, Ret Piscarilius, Solange Lovakengj and Bourath Arceuus all Royal Lords of our Kingdom.

First, that of this day the Council of Elders shall cease to exercise authority over any action, collection of revenues, mobilisation of armies, distribution of revenues, seizure of goods or chattels belonging to any free man of the kingdom or any other thing as may be considered in the interest of the kingdom; within the Kingdom of Great Kourend in perpetuity.

Second, that of this day the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus take complete responsibility for the kingdom in perpetuity.

Third, that of this day one member from the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus shall be chosen to be the Grand Lord of Kourend for a period of no more than ten years and be able to exercise authority over any action, collection of revenues, mobilisation of armies, distribution of revenues, seizure of goods or chattels belonging to any free man of the kingdom or any other thing as may be considered in the interest of the kingdom; within the Kingdom of Great Kourend.

Fourth, that of this day the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Hosidius, will have ten years in the role of Grand Lord. Upon the expiry of these ten years he will willingly pass the title of Grand Lord to the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Lovakengj for a period of no more than ten years. And so it shall continue for the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Shayzien, then for the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Piscarilius and finally for the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Arceuus. Henceforth this is known as the Right of Succession to the Office of Grand Lord.

Fifth, upon the expiry of the title of Grand Lord of the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Arceuus, the title of Grand Lord is passed willingly to the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Hosidius and henceforth continues as the fourth statement of this Accord.

Sixth, that if a suitable male lord of the any of the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus cannot be found at the start of their period as Grand Lord, whether due to infirmity of mind or body or of questionable morality, the Right of Succession to the Office of the Grand Lord is annulled and passed to the next Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus in line.

We, the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus have sworn that all this shall be observed in good faith and without deceit.

==Inspecting==
* {{tbox|pic=Royal Accord of Twill detail.png|Despite its age, the scroll is in near perfect condition. It's likely that some sort of magic was used to ensure it remained preserved.}}
* {{tact|end}}

** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Good day.|quest=no}}

* {{topt|What are you doing down here?}}

** '''Thorodin:''' We're extending the cave so more people can live in it.
** '''Thorodin:''' These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.
** '''Player:''' ...such as?
** '''Thorodin:''' You don't get rained on, for example.
** '''Thorodin:''' Of course, there are some problems, like the monsters Donal saw...
** '''Player:''' Someone saw a monster?
** '''Player:''' Could you tell me more? The King asked me to investigate.
** '''Thorodin:''' One of the other dwarves who was working with us saw it. His name's Donal.
** '''Thorodin:''' He went further into the caves to plan our excavations, and a while later he came out shaking.
** '''Thorodin:''' He's been in the inn ever since.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Good day.}}
** '''Player:''' Good day.
** {{tact|end}}

====Before talking to Donal====
* '''Thorodin:''' [Good day, sir/Good day, madam/Good day].
* {{topt|What are you doing down here?}}
** '''Player:''' What are you doing down here?
** '''Thorodin:''' We're extending the cave so more people can live in it.
** '''Thorodin:''' These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.
** '''Player:''' ...such as?
** '''Thorodin:''' You don't get rained on, for example.
** '''Thorodin:''' Have you spoken to Donal?
** '''Player:''' Not yet, no.
** '''Thorodin:''' Well, if you want to hear stories about monsters, he's the best one to ask.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Good day.}}

====After talking to Donal about the Giant Sea Snake====
* '''Thorodin:''' [Good day, sir/Good day, madam/Good day].
* {{topt|What are you doing down here?}}
** '''Player:''' What are you doing down here?

* {{topt|Good day.}}
** {{tact|above}}

===Talking to Donal===
* '''Donal:''' What do you want?
* '''Player:''' What are you doing down in these caves?
* '''Donal:''' I'm waiting to work on the excavations...
* '''Donal:''' ...though I don't really want to start digging again.
* '''Player:''' Why not? I thought digging was something dwarves were good at.
* '''Donal:''' Not with monsters like that one in those caves.
* '''Donal:''' It had huge teeth and flaming red eyes, and was almost the size of the tunnel!
* '''Donal:''' If it attacks the town...
* '''Donal:''' Are you an adventurer, by any chance?
* '''Player:''' Adventurer and Regent of Miscellania.
* '''Donal:''' In that case, could you go and deal with that monster?
* '''Donal:''' I don't want to have to face it again if it attacks the town.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!}}
** '''Player:''' Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
** '''Donal:''' You'll need to get into the other caves first, of course.
** '''Donal:''' There's a crack in the wall where the others are digging, but the rocks are loose, and can fall on you if you're not careful.
** '''Donal:''' I can give you a mining prop to keep them from falling, if you give me a minute to find it...
** '''Player:''' Okay, so all I have to do is get through that wall?
** '''Donal:''' No, after that the only way you can get further is climbing up onto a high ledge, then crawling through a tunnel.
** '''Donal:''' But the walls are slippery...
** '''Donal:''' ...and I think I might have broken the lift when I fell off it on my way back.
** '''Donal:''' You'll probably need to fix the lift - I doubt you'd be able to climb.
** '''Player:''' And the monster's behind that tunnel?
** '''Donal:''' Somewhere behind it. I couldn't get very far, what with the flooding in the tunnel.
** '''Donal:''' There's some rope and some planks near the broken lift - those would probably come in handy.
** '''Donal:''' Ah, here's that mining prop. I knew I had it somewhere.
** '''Donal:''' Here you go. Good luck with fighting that monster.
** {{tact|receives=[[mining prop]]}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.}}
** '''Player:''' Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
** '''Donal:''' That's what I thought, until I saw the sheer size of it. This thing probably MADE the tunnels!
** '''Player:''' And you're sending me in to deal with it alone?
** '''Donal:''' I've heard stories from the Miscellanians. If you're the Regent, you must be quite a strong hero.
** '''Donal:''' So what are you worried about? You probably eat monsters like that for breakfast!
** '''Player:''' I wouldn't put it quite like that...
** '''Player:''' But I'll help you after all. Now, how do I find this monster?
** {{tact|Continues above at "You'll need to get into the other caves first, of course."}}

===Talking to Donal again===
* '''Donal:''' What do you want?
* '''Player:''' Just wondering if you were still here.
* '''Donal:''' Of course I'm still here.
* '''Donal:''' I'm not going near that crack in the wall again.
* '''Donal:''' Rock falls and so on are fine, but sea monsters in caves - never!
* {{tcond|If the player lost the mining prop:}}
** '''Player:''' I've lost that mining prop you gave me...
** '''Donal:''' Lucky I have a spare, isn't it?
** '''Donal:''' Here you go. Good luck with fighting that monster.
* {{tact|end}}
