* '''Ictus:''' Not often someone comes out to speak to me. What do you want?
* '''Player:''' I'm investigating the missing people. Do you know anything about them?
* '''Ictus:''' Oh, yes! Yes indeed! They were taken by the night people!
* '''Player:''' The night people?
* '''Ictus:''' Yes! I hear them in the dark. They think they're quiet, but not to me! I can hear them scrape against the wooden walls!
* '''Player:''' Could that not just be a dog scratching at the post?
* '''Ictus:''' Does a dog walk on two legs?
* '''Player:''' One of the ents then?
* '''Ictus:''' An ent wouldn't go around scraping against things? They're far too careful for that!
* '''Player:''' I don't think-
* '''Ictus:''' Oh, I see what you're doing! You're just another who wants to laugh at me! You'll all see soon enough!
* '''Player:''' Okay... I think I'll leave you to it.
* '''Ictus:''' That's right! Be gone with you!
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Ictus again====
* '''Ictus:''' You again? Come to laugh at me once more? I know the night people are real! You'll find out soon enough!
* '''Player:''' Okay...
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the shopkeeper===
* '''Shopkeeper:''' Nilsal. What can I do for you?
* {{tselect|Select an option:}}
* {{topt|quest=No|What do you have for sale?}}
* {{topt|About the missing people...}}
** '''Player:''' About the missing people...
** {{tcond|First conversation:}}
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' Ah, yes... It's a sad day when a town doesn't worry about its missing children...
*** '''Player:''' People aren't worried about it?
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' They were at first, but with how long it's been happening, I think everyone's run out of energy to keep searching.
*** '''Player:''' But people have searched the? Are there any theories as to where they're going?
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' Well, that depends on who you ask... Some try to rationalise it away as some accident in the forest, the river, or the mountains.
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' Others just assume they up and left overnight. Took only the essentials to go and start a new life.
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' Then of course, some think they're getting taken in the night...
*** '''Player:''' And what do you think?
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' I think we could be doing more. Something is happening and it doesn't feel right. I know I'm not the only one who feels this way.
*** '''Player:''' Well, I'm here to have a look around. I'll see what I can find out about them.
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' Thank you, traveller.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|Repeat conversations:}}
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' Did you manage to find out anything?
*** '''Player:''' Not yet.
*** '''Shopkeeper:''' That's a shame... Hopefully you have some luck soon.
* {{topt|quest=No|Nothing, thanks?}}

====Talking to the shopkeeper again====
* '''Shopkeeper:''' Nilsal. What can I do for you?
* {{tselect|Select an option:}}
* {{topt|quest=No|What do you have for sale?}}
* {{topt|About the missing people...}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|quest=No|Nothing, thanks?}}

===Talking to Captain Ariadna===
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Good day, traveller.
* '''Player:''' Hello there. I was wondering if you could tell me anything about the missing people.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Not really. We put a lot of effort into finding them, but nothing came of it.
* '''Player:''' Where do you think they went?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Well, some say they got lost in the mountains. Others say they decided to go and live somewhere like Fortis instead of here. I'm not too sure myself. It is a large number of people who've vanished...
* '''Player:''' But you stopped looking?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' It was taking up a lot of resources. We don't have a huge number of guards here, so I need to use my people wisely.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' If we get a new lead, I'm happy to send them out again, but right now it's like looking for a needle in a haystack.
* '''Player:''' I see. Thanks for the information.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Ariadna again====
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Good day, traveller.
* '''Player:''' Hello there. I was wondering if you had any more thoughts on the missing people?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' No. As I said, we tried looking, but found nothing. Without a new lead, things are at a dead end.
* '''Player:''' I see. Thanks for the information.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Aemilia or Francis===
* '''Player:''' Excuse me. I'm looking into the-
* '''Aemilia:''' Turn around. Walk out.
* '''Player:''' Wait, I-
* '''Francis:''' Please... Nobody's looking into anything. Just leave us.
* '''Player:''' But I'm trying to find the missing people!
* '''Aemilia:''' Prove it! What do you know?
* {{tcond|The player has not talked to Ictus:}}
** '''Player:''' Er...
** '''Aemilia:''' Exactly! Now, go!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|The player has talked to Ictus:}}
** '''Player:''' Well, I know most of the town has given up on finding them. Most are just dismissing the disappearances, assuming them to have run away or had an accident.
** '''Player:''' However, there are some who think something more sinister is going on. If that's the case, I intend to find out. I'm [player name] and I promise I"m here to help.
** '''Francis:''' You... You'll find our sons?
** '''Player:''' I'm going to try.
** '''Aemilia:''' Well... I suppose you do at least seem to somewhat care.
** '''Francis:''' What do you need from us, [player name]?
** '''Player:''' First up, what can you tell me about the disappearnce of your sons?
** '''Aemilia:''' That's the thing... They just seemed to vanish! One moment they were playing upstairs, but the next they'd gone.
** '''Player:''' And you didn't notice anything unusual at all?
** '''Francis:''' Nothing really. The only thing that was a bit odd was the ents...
** '''Player:''' The ents?
** '''Francis:''' Yes. Their normal path takes them right past our house, but the night the boys disappeared, they took a different route. It's like they were avoiding something...
** '''Player:''' I see. Can I look around the house a little and see if there's any clues as to where your sons went?
** '''Aemilia:''' If you think it will help, then of course.
** '''Player:''' Thank you.
** {{tact|end}}

====Talking to them again before talking to Ictus====
* '''Aemilia:''' You again? We already told you to go away!
* '''Player:''' But I want to help!
* '''Aemilia:''' Prove it! What do you know?
* {{tact|above}}

====Talking to them again after talking to Ictus====
* '''Francis:''' Have you found anything yet?
* '''Player:''' I'm still looking.
* '''Aemilia:''' Please, help us find our sons.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to them again after finding the scratches/puddles====
* '''Francis:''' Have you found anything yet?
* '''Player:''' There are a few scratches on the wall outside along with this strange red substance.
* '''Francis:''' Yes, I saw that, but I thought it was from the ents. Do you think something else left it?
* '''Player:''' Possibly. It looks like there are puddles of the stuff leading away from your house. I'm going to follow them and see where they lead.
* '''Aemilia:''' Thank you, [player name]. Please, help us find our sons.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Ariadna again after inspecting puddles====
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Good day, traveller. Can I help you?
* '''Player:''' Potentially. I was wondering if you have any clue what left these weird puddles through here?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Hmm... I hadn't noticed them before. I don't think the ents leave that sort of thing. My guess would be one of the woodland creatures.
* '''Player:''' I see. Thank you for your help.
* {{tact|end}}

===Finding the fabric===
====Inspecting the wall====
* '''Player:''' That's odd... There are some scratches going up the wall, along with a strange stick red substance. It's not blood... What is it?
* {{tact|end}}

====Inspecting a puddle====
* '''Player:''' What do we have here? More of that strange substance. I wonder where it leads...
* {{tact|end}}

====Inspecting the plank====
* {{tbox|pic=Wet fabric scrap detail.png|It looks like there's some sort of fabric caught on the plank, but it's too far away for you to reach.}}
* '''Player:''' Hmm... A fishing rod might work...
* {{tact|end}}

====Using a fishing rod on the plank====
* {{tbox|pic=Wet fabric scrap detail.png|It looks like there's some sort of fabric caught on the plank. You might be able to reach it with your fishing rod...}}
* {{mes|You cast out your line...}}
* {{tbox|pic=Wet fabric scrap detail.png|You use your fishing rod to hook a bit of fabric off the plank.}}
* '''Player:''' Interesting... I should see if this is from one of our missing people!
* {{tact|end}}

====Reinspecting the plank====
* '''Player:''' I don't think this plank can offer me anything else. I should go and see if that fabric is from one of the missing people.
* {{tact|end}}

====Inspecting the wet fabric scrap====
* '''Player:''' Could this be from one of the missing people?
* {{tact|end}}

====Destroying the wet fabric scrap====
* '''Player:''' Should I destroy this?
* '''Player:''' It could be evidence of something happening here... Surely it wouldn't be ethical to do this?
* '''Player:''' Then again, I wouldn't want to give false hope to those parents if it's actually nothing.
* '''Player:''' Yet I could still ask them about it, even if I don't have it to hand...
* {{qact|Regular destroy options are displayed.}}

===Talking to Aemilia or Francis after finding the fabric===
* '''Francis:''' Have you found anything yet?
* {{tcond|The player has not found anything:}}
** '''Player:''' I'm still looking.
** '''Aemilia:''' Please, help us find our sons.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|The player has found the wet fabric scrap and kept it.}}
** '''Player:''' Yes. Do you recognise this scrap of fabric? I followed a trail of... well, I'm not sure what it is. It led from your home to the river, and this was caught on a plank there.
** {{tbox|pic=Wet fabric scrap detail.png|You show them the scrap of fabric you found.}}
** '''Aemilia:''' One of our sons, Etz, often wears brown, and that looks like... Does that mean...
** '''Player:''' It means I have a lead.
** '''Francis:''' What direction was this trail going in?
** '''Player:''' Up towards the mountains north west of here. It might be dangerous, but I think I can explore further.
** '''Aemilia:''' If you're willing to, it would mean everything to us. You're the only one who's actually cared enough to find anything!
** '''Player:''' It's the least I can do. I'll be back once I've discovered more.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|The player has found the wet fabric scrap and destroyed it:}}
** '''Player:''' Yes. I followed a trail of... well, I'm not sure what it is. It led from your home to the river, and I found a scrap of fabric. Does one of your sons often wear brown clothes?
** '''Aemilia:''' Yes, Etz does... What does it mean?
** '''Player:''' It means I may have a lead.
** '''Francis:''' What direction was this trail going?
** '''Player:''' Up towards the mountains north west of here. It might be dangerous, but I think I can explore further.
** '''Aemilia:''' If you're willing to, it would mean everything to us. You're the only one who's actually cared enough to find anything!
** '''Player:''' It's the least I can do. I'll be back once I've discovered more.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Aemilia or Francis again===
* '''Aemilia:''' You're back! Did you find anything in the mountains?
* '''Player:''' I'm still looking.
* '''Francis:''' Thank you for helping us. No one else seems to care...
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Etz===
* '''Player:''' Are you okay? Can you walk?
* '''Injured boy:''' I think so... I'm not sure if Etz can though...
* '''Player:''' That's okay. I should be able to carry him. Now, let's get out of here...
* {{tbox|You take the two boys back to Auburnvale.}}
* '''Aemilia:''' I can't believe you found them!
* '''Player:''' I was very fortunate. They were in a cave in the mountains, but they weren't particularly far inside.
* '''Francis:''' Probably using the survival skills I taught them! That's my boys!
* '''Player:''' How are they doing now?
* '''Aemilia:''' They're upstairs recovering. They need some rest, but they'll be okay.
* '''Player:''' That's good to hear, though I am still worried as to how they ended up there. It's not really the kind of place someone visits, not to mention that strange substance I found...
* '''Francis:''' You think they were taken by something?
* '''Player:''' I don't think we can rule it out.
* '''Aemilia:''' Well, they weren't the only ones to disappear. What if you're right? What if there are more people up there? And what if whatever took them comes back?
* '''Player:''' First things first, I need to find out exactly what happened to your sons. Do you think I could ask them about it?
* '''Aemilia:''' Not yet. They need some rest first.
* '''Francis:''' In the meantime, you should go see Ariadna, the guard captain. People can't ignore this now. If something did take our boys, she needs to know about it. You'll find her by the main entrance into town.
* '''Player:''' I'll go and see her. Is there anything else I can be doing to help as well?
* '''Aemilia:''' The boys were upstairs when they disappeared. What if whatever took them climbed our wall and came through the window? If that's the case, we need to stop it from happening again!
* '''Player:''' Let's see... I suppose I could take a look at the wall and see if it can be reinforced in some way?
* '''Francis:''' If it's not too much trouble, that would mean a lot to us.
* '''Player:''' I'm sure it won't be too much to sort. Right, I'll be back once I've spoken to Captain Ariadna and sorted your wall out.
* {{tact|end}}

==Helping Around Town==
===Talking to Aemilia or Francis===
* '''Francis:''' You're back. How's it going?
* {{tcond|If the player has reinforced the wall:}}
** {{tcond|The player has not talked to Captain Ariadna:}}
*** '''Player:''' I've got your wall all sorted. Now I need to go and see Captain Ariadna.
*** '''Aemilia:''' She should be by the main entrance into town. Thank you so much for doing all this, iknami. It means everything to us.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has not reinforced the wall:}}
** {{tcond|The player has not talked to Captain Ariadna:}}
*** '''Player:''' I still need to get your wall sorted. I haven't spoken to Captain Ariadna yet either.
*** '''Aemilia:''' She should be by the main entrance into town. Thank you so much for doing all of this, iknami. It means everything to us.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If the player has agreed to get some longbows:}}
*** '''Player:''' I've got your wall all sorted. Now I'm helping Captain Ariadna source some new bows to equip the guards a bit better.
*** '''Aemilia:''' Thank you so much for doing all this, iknami. It means everything to us.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player hasn't reinforced the wall:}}
** {{tcond|If the player hasn't talked to Captain Ariadna:}}
*** '''Player:''' I still need your wall sorted. I haven't spoken to Captain Ariadna either.
*** '''Aemilia:''' She should be by the main entrance into town. Thank you so much for doing all this, iknami. It means everything to us.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If the player has agreed to get some longbows:}}
*** {{tmissing}}
* {{tcond|The player has finished all of the tasks:}}
** '''Player:''' I've helped Captain Ariadna source some new bows to equip the guards a bit better, and your wall is all sorted as well.
** '''Aemilia:''' Thank you, iknami. You'll be pleased to hear the boys are feeling a bit better.
** '''Player:''' So I can speak to them now?
** '''Francis:''' Yes, but do be patient with them. They still have quite a bit of recovering to do.
** {{tact|end}}

===Attempting to climb the ladder===
* '''Aemilia:''' The boys are resting at the moment. You'll have to come back later if you want to speak to them.
* {{tact|end}}

===Reinforcing the wall===
* '''Player:''' Now then... How do we reinforce you? Perhaps some maple logs will do the trick!
* '''Player:''' There we go!
* {{tact|end}}

====Without a hammer (even with logs)====
* '''Player:''' Now then... How do we reinforce you? Perhaps some maple logs will do the trick! I reckon I'll need four sets in total, and a hammer of course.
* {{tact|end}}

====Without enough logs====
* ''' Player:''' Now then... How do we reinforce you? Perhaps some maple logs will do the trick! I reckon I'll need four sets in total.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Captain Ariadna===
* '''Player:''' Good day! I'm here about those missing people.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Yes, I saw you bringing those boys back to town. Where did you find them?
* '''Player:''' In a cave up in the mountains.
* '''Ariadna:''' Did you see any sign of other missing people?
* '''Player:''' I'm afraid not, but I intend to ask the boys about them once they've had some time to rest. I'm worried they didn't go up there on their own. There's a chance something might have taken them.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Ah, wonderful. This is just what we need.
* '''Player:''' Yes, I must admit, the town doesn't seem very well equipped to deal with this sort of thing. Is there anything I can do to help?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Well, one of the people who went missing was the local fletcher. In his absence, our already light supply of longbows has become even lighter.
* '''Player:''' I'm sure I can step in as your fletcher! New bows, was it?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' That's right. We typically use willow longbows. We've lost a few experienced archers over the years so we've tried to make things more approachable... and cheaper.
* '''Player:''' Willow... Approachable... Got it! How many did you need?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Four would keep us comfortable for the time being.
* {{tcond|If the player does not have enough longbows:}}
** '''Player:''' Alright, I'll be back soon.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player happens to have enough longbows:}}
** '''Player:''' I just so happen to have those on hand!
** '''Captain Ariadna:''' Making the most of the woodlands around here, were you?
** '''Player:''' Absolutely.
** {{tbox|pic=Willow longbow detail.png|pic2=Willow longbow detail.png|You give Captain Ariadna four willow longbows.}}
** '''Captain Ariadna:''' Thank you, traveller.
** '''Player:''' So you've got the bows. What now?
** {{tact|below}}

====Talking to her again====
* '''Player:''' I have those bows you asked for!
* {{tbox|pic=Willow_longbow detail.png|You give Captain Ariadna four willow longbows.}}
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Thank you, traveller.
* '''Player:''' So you've got the bows. Now what?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Well, not a lot really. We'll increase the number of guards posted at the entrances into town, but without knowing what we're looking for, we can't do much else.
* '''Player:''' Right... Not quite the solution I was after, but it's a start. I guess I'd better go check in with those boys and see if I can find out more about how they ended up in that cave.
* {{tact|end}}

====Without all four longbows====
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' You're back. Have you sourced those willow longbows yet?
* '''Player:''' Not quite. How many did you need?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Just the four of them.
* '''Player:''' Alright, I'll be back soon.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Marcus===
* '''Marcus:''' Ah, it's you. I hear you're still looking into the case of those missing people. Must say, you're the first person in a while to actually stick to it.
* '''Player:''' Well, I don't like leaving a mystery unsolved.
* '''Marcus:''' Clearly. Anyway, good luck with it.
* {{tact|end}}

==Rescuing Antos==
===Talking to Etz or Shas===
* '''Shas:''' You're the one that saved us. Thank you.
* '''Player:''' It's not a problem. I'm just glad you're both okay. If it's alright, I wanted to ask you how you ended up in that cave. I'm hoping it might help me track down the others who are missing.
* '''Etz:''' We didn't see any others... It was just us and Antos...
* '''Player:''' Antos?
* '''Etz:''' Yes! He makes bows for the guards. We'd see him sometimes when dad would go with him to the pub, but he wasn't in the pub! He was in the cave!
* '''Player:''' Where?
* '''Shas:''' He was deeper inside. Those... things... they dragged him away!
* '''Player:''' This isn't good. I need to get back there!
* '''Etz:''' Please... find Antos.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to them again====
* '''Etz:''' Please... find Antos.
* '''Shas:''' He was deeper inside that cave. Those... things... they dragged him away!
* '''Player:''' I'm going to head back there right now!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Aemilia or Francis===
* '''Aemilia:''' Have you spoken to the boys yet?
* {{tcond|The player hasn't talked to the boys:}}
** '''Player:''' Not yet.
** '''Francis:''' They're just upstairs, but do be patient with them. They still have quite a bit of recovering to do.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|The player has talked to the boys:}}
** '''Player:''' Yes, but I need to get back to the cave. Apparently someone called Antos is still in there!
** '''Francis:''' Antos is up there? You'd better go and find him, iknami!
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Captain Ariadna===
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Traveller. Did you find out more about what happened to those boys?
* {{tcond|The player has not talked to the boys:}}
** '''Player:''' Not yet.
** '''Captain Ariadna:''' Well, without knowing what we're looking for, there's not much we can do.
* {{tcond|The player has talked to the boys:}}
** '''Player:''' Yes, but I also found out someone called Antos is still in that cave! I need to go and find him!
** '''Captain Ariadna:''' Antos? I'll get the guards ready, but that will take some time.
** '''Player:''' We don't have time! I'm heading up there now!
** '''Captain Ariadna:''' You're going alone?
** '''Player:''' It's that or he dies!
** '''Captain Ariadna:''' You're mad, traveller! Good luck up there.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Antos===
* '''Player:''' Antos? Are you okay?
* '''Antos:''' Behind... you...
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Antos after killing the strange creatures===
* '''Antos:''' Have they gone?
* '''Player:''' For now, but there could be more. We should get out of here.
* '''Antos:''' Thank you, iknami. I thought I could find out where people were going... No one else seemed to care... I managed to track those boys here, but then those things...
* '''Player:''' It's okay, Antos. The boys are safe.
* '''Antos:''' That's good... but everyone else... Look what they did to them...
* '''Player:''' I'm sorry, Antos. We can't help them now, but at least you and the boys are safe. Come on, let's get you home, before more of those things arrive...
* {{tbox|You take Antos back to Auburnvale.}}
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' You found Antos! I never thought we'd see him again. What happened?
* '''Player:''' That cave up in the mountains is full of some strange creatures. They were the ones responsible for the disappearances.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' I see... Did you find anyone else up there?
* '''Player:''' No. At least, no one alive, that is.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' That's... unfortunate. Still, from what you've said, I suppose we should be thankful that you found anyone still breathing.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Right, time to get to work I guess. Now that we know about these creatures and where they're coming from, we can hopefully ensure they don't take anyone else.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' I suspect it's going to require us to establish a constant watch. Not ideal, but doable, especially with those new bows.
* '''Player:''' Anything I can do to help?
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Well, if you ever fancy heading up there and killing more of those creatures, you won't find me complaining. Apart from that though, I think you've done all you can.
* '''Player:''' In that case, good luck with it all.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Thank you. All the best, traveller.
* {{tact|end}}

==Post-quest dialogue==
===Talking to Captain Ariadna===
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Hello again, traveller. We've been keeping an eye on the mountain pass to make sure those creatures don't come back. We haven't had any more disappearances, so it seems to be working.
* '''Player:''' That's good to hear.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Still, we can't be too careful. If you ever fancy going up to that cave and killing a few of them for us, that would be appreciated.
* '''Player:''' I might just do that.
* '''Captain Ariadna:''' Thank you, traveller. All the best.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Aemilia or Francis===
* '''Aemilia:''' Thank you for finding our sons, iknami.
* '''Player:''' It's not a problem.
* '''Francis:''' Tetamo! You are too humble, friend. Without you, our boys would be dead. What you did means everything to us.
* '''Player:''' Thank you!
* '''Aemilia:''' No, thank you, iknami!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Shas or Etz===
* '''Shas:''' Thank you for saving us.
* '''Player:''' Don't mention it.
* '''Etz:''' And thank you for saving Antos as well!
* '''Player:''' It's really not a problem.
* '''Etz:''' You're our hero!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Marcus===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Marcus:''' Ah, it's you. I hear you've become a bit of a hero around here. Not a bad job.
* '''Player:''' Thanks!
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Ictus===
* '''Ictus:''' You found those people who went missing! Did you see them? Did you see the night people?
* '''Player:''' Sort of. I wouldn't call them people though.
* '''Ictus:''' But they're real! They're actually real! No one believed me, but I knew they were real!
* '''Player:''' Well, congratulations I guess...
* {{tact|end}}

title: Transcript:Shayzia military orders
content:
{{Transcript|item}}

To Captain Tebell of Shayzia,

It is with a heavy heart that I must inform you of a great tragedy to befall our house. Lord Shayzien is dead. Murdered by a cowardly alliance between Lord Lovakengj and Lady Piscarilius. In all the chaos, the circumstances are still unclear. From what we do know, it seems that while all five of the leaders had agreed to the plan to depose the gluttonous King Agata IV, those two had an alternate idea on who would rule next. With our army being by far the largest in the kingdom, we were their first target.

While we all wish to mourn for our beloved leader, we do not have that luxury. We must move immediately to protect the young Maria Shayzien, for she is now our new ruler. Therefore, your orders are to recall every soldier available to Shayzia and prepare for a siege. Enemy forces are already on the move, and she must be protected no matter the cost. Once the castle gates have closed, you must not open them for anyone. Even if Shayzien itself falls, the castle of Shayzia must stand.

I'm afraid I have little intelligence to share regarding the foes you will soon be facing. From what we can tell, the Lovakengj army will be the first to arrive. One good piece of news is that they have already been weakened somewhat. The Lovakengj alliance with Lady Piscarilius was thankfully short lived, and there has been significant fighting between the two armies. The Piscarilius soldiers came off worse and have retreated to regroup. Meanwhile, Lady Hosidius has already rallied her forces as well, though it is unclear where her allegiances lie at this point. Finally, Lord Arceuus has returned to Arceuus and reinforced the city. It seems he has no desire to participate in this conflict, but I suspect he will soon be given no choice.

There is one final matter that I urge you to attend to. While not public knowledge, I'm sure you are aware of Lord Shayzien's unorthodox beliefs. I ask that you attempt to preserve his religious materials if you can. That said, if it seems they are likely to fall into enemy hands, you must ensure that they are destroyed.

To you and everyone else at Shayzia, I pray for good fortune. You are our last hope now. Good luck.

General Lern

title: Transcript:Shura
content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
* '''Shura:''' Human.
* {{topt|Tell me about the Nightmare.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about the Nightmare.
** '''Shura:''' From the moment I was born, all I ever knew was the Nightmare. Every night she would feast upon us, filling our minds with horrors beyond comprehension.
** '''Shura:''' By day, our warriors would enter her lair in the caves beneath the island. We could not hope to defeat her, we knew that, but our survival was dependent on ensuring she didn't grow too strong.
** '''Shura:''' Here's the thing though. Even now, we know little about her. Before she claimed them, my parents would sometimes tell me a story of her origin.
** '''Shura:''' They told me of a group of shamans who performed an unknown ritual in the hope of gaining great power. The ritual went wrong, though, and instead, they unleashed the Nightmare on this world.
** '''Player:''' Do you believe the story?
** '''Shura:''' I'm not sure to be honest. I suppose it doesn't matter though. We'll likely never know her true origin. But as long as we can defeat her, we don't need to.
** '''Player:''' Defeat her? Using the totems?
** '''Shura:''' Exactly. Thanks to the Nightmare, the caves beneath our home are mostly unexplored. There's all sorts of things down there, provided you're brave enough to enter.
** '''Shura:''' I found the totems deep within the caves. Someone far smarter than you or I had worked out how to make them. But they perished before they could use them against her.
** '''Shura:''' I managed to recover them, and with them, we finally drove her off the island.
** '''Player:''' But she came here.
** '''Shura:''' Yes. And thanks to the Sleeper Plague, she's far stronger than ever before.
** '''Player:''' Do you know where the Sleeper Plague came from?
** '''Shura:''' No. It was here long before the Nightmare apparently. It resurfaced shortly before she arrived. Probably the work of the vampyres.
** '''Shura:''' Is there anything else you need?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Tell me about yourself.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about yourself.
** '''Shura:''' The name's Shura. I come from an island called Ashihama, in the Pincers.
** '''Player:''' The Pincers?
** '''Shura:''' It's a group of islands within the Wushanko Isles, a large archipelago to the far east. Over here I think the area is more commonly known as the Eastern Lands.
** '''Player:''' And you're a siren, right?
** '''Shura:''' That's right. We rarely come this far to the west, the climate is too cold for our tastes. Although while the Nightmare lives, the climate is the least of my worries.
** '''Shura:''' Back home on the other hand, our numbers equal the humans. Sirens live on pretty much every island in the archipelago.
** '''Player:''' So why were you the only one to come here?
** '''Shura:''' We took up arms against the Nightmare because we had to, not because we wanted to. We are a peaceful race, and most were all too eager to lay down their weapons once the Nightmare was gone.
** '''Player:''' So why didn't you?
** '''Shura:''' My kind believe in something called Mo Kal. It means that anything bad that could happen, will happen. The others may have forgotten this, but I have not.
** '''Shura:''' The Nightmare may have left my home, but I won't rest until I know for sure that she can never return.
** '''Shura:''' Is there anything else you need?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Do you have any of my items?}}
** '''Player:''' Do you have any of my items?
** {{tcond|If the player has no items in Shura's collection:}}
*** '''Shura:''' Doesn't look like it. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If the player has items in Shura's collection:}}
*** '''Shura:''' I do. Try to be more careful with them next time.
*** {{tact|opens2=Shura's Item Retrieval Service}}
* {{topt|I'd better get going.}}
** '''Player:''' I'd better get going.
** '''Shura:''' Good luck.
** {{tact|end}}

===When trying to interact with [[The Nightmare]] before talking to her===
* '''Shura:''' Hey! Don't just go poking her without knowing what you're up against. Come talk to me first.
* {{tact|The player walks to Shura.}}
* {{tact|continue}}

===First time talking to her===
* '''Player:''' What's going on here?
* '''Shura:''' Nothing good. This dungeon is tainted and has become the new home of the Nightmare.
* '''Player:''' The Nightmare?
* '''Shura:''' A being of pure darkness. No living creature is safe from her hunger. She feasts upon her victims while they sleep, draining their energy without even needing to touch them.
* '''Shura:''' Those that she feeds upon experience horrifying nightmares, unlike anything you could possibly imagine. Eventually, they become too weak to even wake. Death claims them soon after.
* '''Player:''' Nightmares? Hence the name?
* '''Shura:''' Indeed. Our kind are not always the most creative.
* '''Player:''' So how did she end up here?
* '''Shura:''' For generations, she terrorised the island of Ashihama, my home. I lost a lot of good friends to her. Sometimes, I even thought I would lose myself. For some, the nightmares become too much to bear.
* '''Shura:''' Some of us refused to give in though. Everything has a weakness, including the Nightmare, and eventually we found it. We drove her off the island, but she managed to endure.
* '''Shura:''' The people here are ill, suffering from a deep sleep from which few wake. They call it the Sleeper Plague. The illness made these people easy prey for the Nightmare, so she made this place her new home.
* '''Player:''' And you followed her here?
* '''Shura:''' While she still exists, my home will never be truly safe. Thanks to the Sleeper Plague, her power has grown faster than it ever did on Ashihama. If she is allowed to grow too strong, there won't be any way to stop her.
* '''Shura:''' I've managed to contain her within this section of the dungeon. She has no desire to leave for the moment. She has no need to, after all.
* '''Shura:''' But make no mistake, I won't be able to stop her if she decides to move on.
* '''Player:''' She doesn't look too dangerous at the moment.
* '''Shura:''' Looks can be deceiving. The battle with the Nightmare is a mental one, not a physical one. If you try to take her on, she will pull you into her dream - one where she makes the rules.
* '''Player:''' But if it's a dream, how can it be dangerous?
* '''Shura:''' It's her dream, not yours. Dying in her dream will destroy your mind, killing you in this world as well.
* '''Player:''' Sounds lovely. So how can we stop her?
* '''Shura:''' If you're willing to help, enter her dream and fight to keep her at bay. Our only hope is to prevent her from growing too strong.
* '''Shura:''' You can go in alone, but I wouldn't recommend it. The more support you have, the better your chances.
* '''Player:''' How do I keep her at bay?
* '''Shura:''' There are four totems in the area that can be used to harm her. First, you'll need to take down her shield for the totems to have an effect. Once her shield is down, use your energy to charge up the totems.
* '''Shura:''' She won't sit about while you do this though, so you'll need to take care if you want to survive.
* '''Player:''' And what's in it for me if I do survive?
* '''Shura:''' You mean apart from saving the world? She's claimed many victims over the years. I'm sure she's claimed many items as well. Maybe some of them will be of value to you.
* '''Player:''' Works for me. I'd better get started then.
* '''Shura:''' Good luck. Return to me if you need more information.
* {{tact|end}}

===Right-click Collect===
* {{tcond|If the player has no items in Shura's collection:}}
** '''Shura:''' Sorry, but I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has items in Shura's collection:}}
** '''Shura:''' I do. Try to be more careful with them next time.
** {{tact|opens2=Shura's Item Retrieval Service}}
* {{tcond|If Sister Senga has items in their collection and Shura doesn't:}}
** '''Shura:''' I think Sister Senga has your possessions instead, actually.
** {{tact|end}}

==Interacting with the Nightmare with items in Shura's Item Retrieval Service==
* '''Shura:''' Hey! I have some of your things. You should come get them before fighting the Nightmare.
* {{tselect|Shura has some of your items. Are you sure you wish to begin?}}
* {{topt|Yes.}}
** {{tbox|The Nightmare pulls you into her dream as you approach her.}}
** {{tact|The player is pulled into the Nightmare's dream.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|No.}}
** {{tact|end}}

content:
{{Transcript|item}}

==='...2nd Pentember, Fifth Age, 70===
We have worked for days. It is a weary and tiring journey that my brothers and I must take, but we are close to success! Elder Dag'eth has led us well and he has told us that Zamorak will reward us greatly for our service to Him. The priests of Saradomin haunt our very steps and I fear our discovery. Yet, soon will be the hour of our glory. The Dagon'hai will prevail and the city will be ours! We will throw down the vile yoke of Saradomin and the Dagon'hai will be victorious!

===9th Pentember, Fifth Age, 70===
Today we donned the filthy robes of the Saradomin priests. It was a foul deed and distasteful to my very soul, yet it had to be done. Without the disguise, we would surely have been found out and ruined. We erected a statue of Saradomin himself just outside the city to the east. Our Lord Zamorak must be laughing in the faces of our enemies at such a deception, for this statue holds the key to our success. Beneath the arrogant caricature of this worthless deity lies the entrance to our most sacred work yet: the Tunnel of Chaos. With this tunnel, we are able to traverse to the very source of our power, the Chaos Temple itself. Those foolish followers of Saradomin do not even sense what we have achieved. They have filled the statue with their accursed holy magic, covering even the merest traces of our work beneath. They have granted us the most perfect of disguises. Zamorak be praised!

===11th Pentember, Fifth Age 70===
Excellent news! I have been chosen by Elder Dag'eth to be the next Hyeraph. I, Sin'keth Magis, will lead our people in the incantation of Zamorak's Will. Surely this means I will become High Elder! I must prove worthy to Lord Zamorak. He will not find me wanting. There is much to do in preparation for the ceremony and I do not have long.

===24th Septober, Fifth Age, 70===
Disaster! The incantation of Zamorak's Will was discovered by a loathsome watchman, of all people. Zamorak's Blood! The fates are cruel! We could not finish the final rites of the spell. Our work has been undone and we have no time to gather our forces together and hide. We are being followed by the guards and the Priests of Filth are at our heels. We must flee the city! Elder La'nou and Elder Kree'nag were slain whilst protecting the sanctum. Elder Dag'eth will not leave with us. Zamorak take him, he will stand against the hordes that follow us! I am the last of the Elders. The order looks to me now.

===27th Septober, Fifth Age, 70===
Today, the last of our order entered the Tunnel of Chaos. We will journey to the Chaos Temple and let Zamorak Himself decide our fate. What happened to Elder Dag'eth, I know not. As the city guards closed upon us, I cast an Earth Bolt spell to collapse the entrance of the tunnel in an avalanche of earth and stone, saving us and dooming us in one breath. There is only one place for us to go now...

==Slepe's Sleeper Plague==
===Talking to Veliaf===
* '''Player:''' Veliaf? What are you doing here?
* '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Well met friend. I'm here on an investigation. There's something strange going on in this town, and I suspect the vampyres are involved.
* '''Player:''' Anything I can help with?
* {{tcond|If the player does not have the requirements to start the quest:}}
** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Not at the moment. Keep checking in though, I may have need of you soon.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has the requirements to start the quest:}}
** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Well an extra pair of hands is always beneficial. If you have the time of course?
** {{tcond|If the player has a lower combat level than recommended:}}
*** {{tbox|Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 95.}}
*** {{tselect|Start the Sins of the Father quest?}}
**** {{topt|Yes.}}
***** {{tact|continue}}
**** {{topt|No.}}
***** '''Player:''' Actually, I'm a bit busy right now. Maybe later.
***** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Very well, friend. Myreque prevail.
***** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|Yes.}}
*** '''Player:''' Of course. What do you need?
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' This town has recently become home to an illness known as the Sleeper Plague. It's a nasty affliction. Those infected fall into a deep sleep, never to wake.
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Now, Morytania is no stranger to odd afflictions. However, I've been doing some digging. Apparently, this isn't the first time this illness has beset Slepe. In fact, they say it's how the town was named.
*** '''Player:''' And now the illness is back. You said you suspect the vampyres are involved?
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' I do. The first victim of the new Sleeper Plague was none other than Lady Crombwick. She rules over this town from Crombwick Manor, along with her husband.
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' He's not been seen since she fell ill, and their manor has been locked down.
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Here's the interesting part though. Vampyres have been seen around the manor. Apparently they showed up around the time when the Sleeper Plague returned.
*** '''Player:''' I see where this is going. You think the vampyres are the reason the plague is back.
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' I do. The question is, why?
*** '''Player:''' I guess that's for us to work out. Where do we start?
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' We'll split up. I'm going to try and learn more about these vampyres at the manor. While I do that, I want you to try and find the source of the illness.
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' They're looking after the victims in this church here. I'd recommend you make that your starting point.
*** '''Player:''' Sounds like a plan. Good luck.
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' And to you. Myreque prevail.
*** {{topt|How have things been for you recently?}}
**** '''Player:''' How have things been for you recently?
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' We haven't been doing too bad. Even out in Mort Myre, the impact of Ranis' death can be seen.
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' People have a little bit more hope now, and it has become easier for us to gather support.
**** '''Player:''' That's good to know.
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Of course, there are downsides. The vampyres are hunting us with ever greater determination. But this is the life we chose.
**** {{tact|other}}
*** {{topt|What do you know about this place?}}
**** '''Player:''' What do you know about this place?
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Slepe? It's wretched. The people of this town follow the teachings of Zamorak. Some are no better than the vampyres themselves.
**** '''Player:''' Do they get on with the vampyres?
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' As well as any humans can. All settlements in Morytania must pay the vampyres in blood tithes, but the people of Slepe do so willingly.
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' They see the vampyres as fellow servants of Zamorak. Of course, the vampyres only really serve themselves.
**** '''Player:''' So why do these people follow Zamorak?
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Apparently this place was founded by a group called the Sisterhood, former healers of Saradomin that turned to Zamorak.
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Their order still exists to this day. You'll probably see a few of them around the town.
**** {{tact|other}}
*** {{topt|Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?}}
**** '''Player:''' Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' What I told you is pretty much what I know. The illness causes people to fall to sleep, never to wake again.
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' There's a rumour that the infected are also granted immortality, though I don't know if there's any truth in this.
**** '''Player:''' To be honest, immortality doesn't seem very useful if you're unable to wake up.
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Indeed. If history is to be believed, this is the second time the Sleeper Plague has hit Slepe. The first occurrence was many years ago and is supposedly what gave the town its name.
**** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' That's all I know. That said, I suspect you might be able to learn more if you do some digging around town.
**** {{tact|other}}
*** {{topt|I'd better get going.}}
**** '''Player:''' I'd better get going.
**** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|No.}}
*** '''Player:''' Actually, I'm a bit busy right now. Maybe later.
*** '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Very well friend. Myreque prevail.
*** {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Veliaf again====

* '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' You need to try and find the source of the Sleeper Plague. I'd start in the church. That's where they're looking after the victims.
* '''Player:''' Sounds like a plan.

* {{topt|Do you know how he fell ill?}}
** '''Player:''' Do you know how he fell ill?
** '''Hameln the Jester:''' I've no idea. We'd just been to the pub for a quick drink. On our way back, he started to act all odd, then he just collapsed.
** '''Player:''' Pub?
** '''Hameln the Jester:''' Yes. The Rat & Bat just south east of here. I'm not a drinker myself but Hanchen's always loved a good tipple.
** '''Player:''' Wait... you mean to say you weren't drinking?

====Report back to Veliaf====

* '''Player:''' Apparently the latest victim of the Sleeper Plague was at the pub shortly before falling ill.
* '''Veliaf Hurtz:''' Interesting. Might be worth a look.

==Plague's End==
===Talking to Carl===
* '''Player:''' What ales are you serving?
* '''Carl:''' We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.
* '''Player:''' Sounds rough, how much?
* '''Carl:''' 99 of your finest coins.
* {{topt|quest=No|Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.}}
* {{topt|Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?}}
** '''Player:''' Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?
** '''Carl:''' It's an old recipe of the Crombwick family.
** '''Player:''' Okay. But the actual Bloody Bracers you sell, where do they come from?
** '''Carl:''' Who's asking?
** '''Player:''' Well... me of course.
** '''Carl:''' Yes, but what I mean is, why do you want to know?
** '''Player:''' Does it matter?
** '''Carl:''' My supplier is a private individual. He doesn't like others meddling in his affairs. So yes, it does matter.
** '''Player:''' I represent... health?
** '''Carl:''' Health? What are you on about?
** '''Player:''' Err... Health and safety of course, here on a routine inspection.
** '''Player:''' Part of my work requires me to inspect the source of your Bloody Bracers. I was hoping you'd put me in touch with your supplier.
** '''Carl:''' I don't know what you're on about. There're no routine inspections here. Now clear off, I have customers to serve!
** '''Player:''' Well I might just have a look around anyway.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|quest=No|99 coins? That's ridiculous!}}
* {{topt|quest=No|What can you tell me about this town?}}
* {{topt|quest=No|Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.}}

====Talking to Carl again====
* '''Player:''' What ales are you serving?
* '''Carl:''' We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.
* '''Player:''' Sounds rough, how much?
* '''Carl:''' 99 of your finest coins.
* {{topt|quest=No|Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.}}
* {{topt|Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?}}
** '''Player:''' Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?
** '''Carl:''' You don't give up do you. I'm not telling you anything so clear off.
** '''Player:''' Well I might just have a look around anyway.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|quest=No|99 coins? That's ridiculous!}}
* {{topt|quest=No|What can you tell me about this town?}}
* {{topt|quest=No|Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.}}

===Barrel investigation===
* {{tbox|The barrel is almost empty. It has the words 'Bloody Bracer' written on the side.}}
* '''Player:''' Hmmm. Looks like Carl is pretty much out of Bloody Bracer. He'll need to collect more from his supplier soon.
* {{qact|Carl exits the Rat & Bat and checks the barrel.}}
* '''Carl:''' Huh. Looks like we're all out of Bloody Bracer again.
* '''Player:''' Alright then Carl. Let's see what you're hiding...
* {{qact|The player begins following Carl.}}

===If caught by Carl===
* '''Carl:''' {{overhead|shadow=yes|colour=yellow|Hey! I see you there!}}
* {{tbox|You failed to stay hidden from Carl.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===If the player falls too far behind Carl===
* {{tbox|You failed to stay close enough to Carl.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Eavesdropping on Carl===
* {{qact|Carl heads into the Sisterhood Sanctuary.}}
* '''Player:''' The dungeon Carl? What are you hiding down there?
* {{qact|Carl enters Kroy's lab.}}
* '''Kroy:''' Carl? What do you want?
* '''Carl:''' Kroy. We've run out of Bloody Bracer again.
* '''Kroy:''' Did you really need to come here to tell me that?
* '''Carl:''' There's something else as well. Someone's been poking around, asking about Bloody Bracer.
* '''Kroy:''' Who?
* '''Carl:''' I don't know. They don't look to be from around here.
* '''Kroy:''' So someone's been snooping around asking questions, and you decided to come here? What if they followed you?
* '''Carl:''' I... I thought you'd want to know.
* '''Kroy:''' You're a fool Carl. If you're not careful, you'll jeopardise everything.
* '''Carl:''' Hey! I don't need to help you!
* '''Kroy:''' No, you don't. Your predecessor didn't want to help us. Perhaps you remember what came of him?
* '''Carl:''' I...
* '''Kroy:''' Go back to your pub Carl. I'll have more Bloody Bracer sent over soon. In the meantime, try to be a bit smarter.
* '''Carl:''' Fine.
* {{qact|Carl leaves the lab, failing to notice the player eavesdropping. Afterwards, Damien Leucurte enters the lab, followed by Vanstrom Klause.}}
* '''Vanstrom Klause:''' Alright then, Damien. What is it that you're so keen to show me?
* '''Damien Leucurte:''' Vanstrom, I'd like you to meet Kroy.
* '''Kroy:''' Greetings, my lord.
* '''Vanstrom Klause:''' Don't tell me you had me come all the way down here for this? Look at the wretched thing, Damien. It's barely even a proper juvenile.
* '''Damien Leucurte:''' Well just hang on there, Vanstrom. Kroy may not look like much, but I've never met a vampyre with a better knowledge of herblore.
* '''Damien Leucurte:''' Kroy, tell him what you found.
* '''Kroy:''' Of course, my lord.
* '''Kroy:''' It was hidden deep within the sanctuary here. A recipe, for an elixir.
* '''Vanstrom Klause:''' An elixir?
* '''Kroy:''' Yes! The ones that built the place, the Sisterhood, they called it the Elixir of Everlasting.
* '''Vanstrom Klause:''' And just what is this Elixir of Everlasting?
* '''Damien Leucurte:''' Those who drink it find their lives heavily extended, but at a cost. They are put into a deep sleep, never to wake.
* '''Vanstrom Klause:''' So the Sleeper Plague? That was your doing?
* '''Damien Leucurte:''' Indeed. Using the recipe, Kroy was easily able to recreate the elixir. After a quick test on Lady Crombwick, we started giving it to the citizens.

Transcript:Sister Aseret
content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
* '''Player:''' Hello!
* '''Sister Aseret:''' Greetings, traveller.
* {{topt|What's with all these Oathbreakers?}}
** '''Player:''' What's with all these Oathbreakers?
** '''Sister Aseret:''' Gah! A bunch of fanatical cultists. Nothing more.
** {{tcond|If the player has not yet defeated The Nightmare:}}
*** '''Player:''' You don't sound impressed?
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' No! Well I wouldn't be, would I? I've spent my whole life dedicated to my sect. I dreamed of one day entering the Sanctuary and finally meeting Mother!
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' Yet instead I'm greeted by this condescending 'Lord' who feels I could try being 'a little more chaotic' for once.
*** '''Player:''' I see...
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' And to top it all off, Mother hasn't awoken at all. I fear she is probably being held captive by this Nightmare, or worse.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' The only things these oafs are breaking is my head with their silent stares and furious hand-talk.
*** '''Player:''' I'm sorry your day hasn't been going well.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' Ah... Thank you, traveller. Are you here to fight the Nightmare?
*** '''Player:''' We'll see. Sounds pretty tough.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' I'll pray for you.
*** {{tact|other}}
** {{tcond|If the player has previously defeated The Nightmare, there is a chance the following branch will be displayed:}}
*** '''Player:''' They seem to be carrying dangerous weapons.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' Indeed. Speaking of weapons, I assume you have heard of the immensely powerful orbs the Nightmare is protecting?
*** '''Player:''' Yes I have. In fact, I've managed to beat the Nightmare myself.
*** '''Player:''' Anyway, as you've heard of the orbs I assume you've also heard of the even stronger Bashyhammer of Ashihama?
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' The what?
*** '''Player:''' The Smashyhammer of Ashihama.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' But you just said...
*** '''Player:''' ...Trashyhammer of Ashihama. Yes, I know what I said.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' Wha-
*** '''Player:''' Slashyhammer?
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' That doesn't even make sense.
*** '''Player:''' Dashyhammer? Mashyhammer?
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' ...
*** '''Player:''' Flashyhammer?
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' Too far. I'm done.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|What's with the mask?}}
** '''Player:''' What's with the mask?
** '''Sister Aseret:''' These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
** '''Player:''' Oh really? What like?
** '''Sister Aseret:''' Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
** '''Player:''' That sounds handy. Can I have one?
** '''Sister Aseret:''' You ask too many questions.
** '''Player:''' Is that a yes?
** '''Sister Aseret:''' It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
** '''Player:''' What is the Sisterhood?
** '''Sister Aseret:''' An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
** '''Player:''' Well sign me up!
** '''Sister Aseret:''' You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
** {{topt|Tell me more about the Sisterhood.}}
*** '''Player:''' Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' Phosani embraced the glory of Zamorak and most of our order did the same. After that, she became known as the Inquisitor, though our order refers to her as 'Mother'.
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
*** '''Player:''' What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
*** '''Sister Aseret:''' They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
*** '''Player:''' How wonderful.
*** {{tact|other}}
** {{topt|What's with all these Oathbreakers?}}
*** {{tact|above}}
** {{topt|Bye!}}
*** {{tact|below}}
* {{topt|Bye!}}
** '''Player:''' Bye!
** '''Sister Aseret:''' Be safe, traveller.
** {{tact|end}}

* {{topt|cond=If the player has not completed [[Sins of the Father]]:|What's wrong with that old man?}}

** '''Player:''' Sleeper Plague?

title: Transcript:Sithik Ints
content:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
===Before starting Zogre Flesh Eaters===
* '''Sithik Ints:''' Hey...who gave you permission to come in here! Get out, get out I say.
* '''Player:''' Alright, alright...keep your night cap on.
* {{tact|end}}

===Attempting to take his cup of tea===
* '''Sithik Ints:''' Hey! What do you think you're doing? Leave my tea alone!
* {{tact|end}}

===Attempting to use Telekinetic Grab on his tea===
* '''Sithik Ints:''' Hey! What do you think you're doing? Don't go casting that kind of spell anywhere near my tea!  Leave my tea alone you telegrabbing fiend!
* {{tact|end}}

===After completion of [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]]===
* '''Sithik Ints:''' Oh, so you're back then, come to gloat have you?
* '''Player:''' Nope, I've just come to ask you a couple of questions.
* {{topt|How do I get rid of the undead ogres?}}
** '''Player:''' How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
** '''Sithik Ints:''' Haven't I already explained this to you once before?
** '''Player:''' Humour me!
** '''Sithik Ints:''' Ok, similar spells have been cast before and the only way to deal with the resulting creatures is to cordon off the area and not go in there again. The undead creatures usually manifest some sort of disease so it's
** '''Sithik Ints:''' best to attack them from a distance with a ranged weapon.
** '''Sithik Ints:''' Normal missiles like arrows and darts do very little damage to them because they're designed to destroy internal organs. This is a waste of time with undead creatures like undead ogres.
** '''Player:''' Yeah, clearly so what should we use?
** '''Sithik Ints:''' From my research it looks like a flat ended arrow was designed called a 'Brutal arrow'. This does large amounts of crushing damage to the creature.
** '''Sithik Ints:''' You can make them by using larger arrows, I think some Ogre hunters make them. But instead of adding an arrow tip, you hammer a large nail into the end of the shaft.
** {{tact|previous}}
* {{topt|How do I get rid of the disease?}}
** '''Player:''' How do I get rid of the disease?
** '''Sithik Ints:''' Haven't I already explained this disease thing to you once before?
** '''Player:''' Just tell me again or else I'll turn you back into an ogre!
** '''Sithik Ints:''' No...noo...please, I'll tell you.
** '''Sithik Ints:''' My research shows that two jungle based herbs can be used, one is found near river tributaries and looks like a vine, the other is found in caves and grows on the wall.
** '''Sithik Ints:''' It's quite well camouflaged so it's unlikely that you'll find it.
** '''Player:''' We'll see about that!
** {{tact|previous}}
* {{topt|Sorry, I have to go.}}
** '''Player:''' Sorry, I have to go.
** {{tact|end}}

* '''Player:''' No real reason. I just thought I would check up on you is all.
* '''Skippy:''' Well, I'm still wet, still cold and still waiting on that nettle tea.
* {{tact|end}}

==Giving Skippy nettle tea==
* '''Player:''' Hey, Skippy!
* '''Skippy:''' Gaah! Don't drench me again!
* '''Player:''' Hey! I only did that once! Try not to be such a big baby!
* '''Skippy:''' So what are you here for then?
* '''Player:''' I've come to give you your tea.
* '''Skippy:''' Excellent! I was thinking I was going to freeze out here!
* {{tbox|pic=Nettle tea detail.png|Skippy drinks the tea and clutches his forehead in pain.}}
* '''Skippy:''' Ohhhhh...
* '''Player:''' What? What's wrong?
* '''Skippy:''' Not so loud...I think I have a hangover...
* '''Player:''' Great...Well, I doubt you can remember anything through a hangover. What a waste of nettle tea...
* '''Skippy:''' Hey! A little sympathy here?
* '''Skippy:''' Owwowwoww... must remember not to shout...
* '''Skippy:''' Look, I do know a hangover cure. If you can get me a bucket of the stuff I think I'll be ok.
* {{tact|If the player has learned the hangover cure recipe during [[Plague City]]:}}
** '''Player:''' Wait... is this cure a bucket of chocolate milk and snape grass?
** '''Skippy:''' Yes! That's the stuff!
** '''Player:''' Ahhh. Yes, I've made some of that stuff before. I should be able to get you some, no problem.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tact|If the player has not learned the hangover cure recipe:}}
** '''Player:''' So what is it you need?
** '''Skippy:''' A bucket of milk with chocolate ground into it, with a handful of snape grass thrown in on top.
** '''Player:''' What? Run that past me again?
** '''Skippy:''' Take a bucket of milk, a bar of chocolate and some snape grass.
** '''Skippy:''' Grind the chocolate with a mortar and pestle.
** '''Skippy:''' Add the chocolate powder to the milk, then add the snape grass.
** '''Skippy:''' Then bring it here and I will drink it.
** '''Skippy:''' The end, and we all live happily ever after. Got it?
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to him before obtaining hangover cure===
* '''Player:''' Hey, Skippy!
* '''Skippy:''' Egad! Don't you know not to shout around a guy with a hangover?
* '''Skippy:''' Ahhhhhg...No more shouting for me...
* '''Skippy:''' What is it anyway?
* '''Player:''' I just came back to ask you something.
* '''Skippy:''' What?
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|How do I make that hangover cure again?}}
** '''Player:''' How do I make that hangover cure again?
** '''Skippy:''' Give me strength...Here's what you do. Pay attention!
** '''Skippy:''' You take a bucket of milk, a bar of chocolate and some snape grass.
** '''Skippy:''' Grind the chocolate with a pestle and mortar.
** '''Skippy:''' Add the chocolate powder to the milk, then add the snape grass.
** '''Skippy:''' Then bring it here and I will drink it.
** '''Skippy:''' Are you likely to remember that or should I go get some crayons and draw you a picture?
** '''Player:''' Hey! I remember it now, ok! See you in a bit.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Why do they call you 'Skippy'?}}
** '''Player:''' Why do they call you Skippy?
** '''Skippy:''' I think it may have something to do with my near- constant raving about mudskippers.
** '''Skippy:''' That or it's something to do with that time with the dress and the field full of daisies...
** {{tact|end}}

==Bringing him the hangover cure==
* '''Player:''' Hey, Skippy!
* '''Skippy:''' Egad! Don't you know not to shout around a guy with a hangover?
* '''Skippy:''' Ahhhhhg...No more shouting for me...
* '''Skippy:''' What is it anyway?
* '''Player:''' Well Skippy, you will no doubt be glad to hear that I got you your hangover cure!
* '''Skippy:''' Gimme!
* {{tbox|Skippy chugs the hangover cure... very impressive.}}
* '''Skippy:''' Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
* '''Skippy:''' Much better...
* '''Player:''' Feeling better?
* '''Skippy:''' Considerably.
* '''Player:''' Then tell me where the mudskippers are!
* '''Skippy:''' I wish you wouldn't go looking for them. Those vicious killers will tear you apart.
* '''Skippy:''' It's all becoming clear to me now...
* '''Skippy:''' I was fishing using a Fishing Explosive...
* '''Player:''' A Fishing Explosive?
* '''Skippy:''' Well, Slayer Masters sell these highly volatile potions for killing underwater creatures.
* '''Skippy:''' If you don't feel like lobbing a net about all day you can use them to fish with...
* '''Skippy:''' But this time I was startled by what I thought was a giant mudskipper.
* '''Skippy:''' What it was, infact, was a...
* '''Skippy:''' Dramatic Pause...
* '''Skippy:''' A Mogre!
* '''Player:''' What exactly is a Mogre?
* '''Skippy:''' A Mogre is a type of Ogre that spends most of its time underwater.
* '''Skippy:''' They hunt giant mudskippers by wearing their skins and swimming close until they can attack them.
* '''Skippy:''' When I used the Fishing Explosive I scared off all the fish, and so the Mogre got out of the water to express its extreme displeasure.
* '''Skippy:''' With an iron mace.
* '''Player:''' I take it the head injury is responsible for the staggering and yelling?
* '''Skippy:''' No, no.
* '''Skippy:''' My addiction to almost-lethal alcohol did that.
* '''Skippy:''' But if you are set on finding these Mogres just head south from here until you find Mudskipper Point.
* '''Player:''' The mudskipper-eating monsters are to be found at Mudskipper point?
* '''Player:''' Shock!
* '''Player:''' Thanks. I'll be careful.
* {{tact|end}}

{{Skippy and the Mogres}}
