content:
{{Transcript|miniquest}}
{{Incomplete|overhead dialogue, dialogue if the message was not received needs to be verified}}
{{Transcript list|Eva Cashien|Ivy Sophista|Armacus Selles|Alliance Navigator|Guardian of Armadyl (The Fractured Archive)|Druid (The Fractured Archive)|Temple Knight (The Fractured Archive)|Ocellus}}

==Entering the archive==
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Hello agai-
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Greetings, adventurer! Have you come to join the ranks of the Alliance?
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Armacus, this is [player name], the adventurer I told you about.
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Aha! Well met, young [player name].
* '''Eva Cashien:''' I have heard good things from my uncle. It is good to meet you, [player name].
* '''Player:''' Well met, and likewise. I received your message and came as soon as I could.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Thank you. This is Eva Cashien and Armacus Selles. They are leading the Temple Knights and the Guardians of Armadyl who have mobilised to defend the Archive.
* {{Tcond|If the player hasn't received the message:}}
** '''Player:''' The Archive?
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' You didn't receive my message? Concerning...
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' It seems the Stone of Jas wasn't the only thing Guthix hid down here. This Archive was built to house various other powerful artefacts, to stop them falling into the wrong hands.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' However, thanks to Lucien, it is now at risk. His followers are preparing to attack the Archive. Not only that, but it seems various other groups are also mobilising their forces.
** '''Player:''' I see. What's the current situation? Have your soldiers entered the Archive already?
** {{tact|continues}}
* {{Tcond|If the player has received the message:}}
** '''Player:''' What's the current situation? Have your soldiers entered the Archive already?
** {{tact|continues}}
* '''Eva Cashien:''' No, they are still on their way. We came ahead of time to scout out the situation.
* '''Player:''' And what do you make of it?
* '''Armacus Selles:''' It's quite the pickle we're in, I'm afraid! Our enemies approach from all sides. We have identified six vulnerable chambers altogether.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' What's more, the central chamber we intended to use to establish fortifications appears to be guarded by some sort of hostile creature.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' It is likely one of Guthix's creations, left behind to defend the Archive from intruders.
* '''Player:''' Could we leverage it to help us?
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' I'm afraid not... It might hold off some of the intruders, but it won't manage all of them. And without getting in there to establish defences of our own, we won't stand a much better of a chance.
* '''Player:''' I see... That's unfortunate.
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Indeed! But not all is bad news. Several of our enemies have clashed on their way to the Archive, and it's bought us some time.
* '''Armacus Selles:''' If a brave young adventurer were to appear and clear the way for us to set up our defences, whilst we gathered our troops...
* '''Armacus Selles:''' But wait! We have one right here!
* {{tact|Armacus laughs.}}
* '''Eva Cashien:''' Armacus' jesting aside, we're hoping you might be able to help us establish a foothold.
* '''Player:''' I see. And do we know anything specific about what artefacts are hidden here?
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' It seems to be all manner of things. Most of them likely aren't too valuable to our foes, but the Archive has an inner vault.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' We're not sure exactly what's inside, but we can't take any risks. We need to assume that the contents could have the potential to be on par with the Stone of Jas itself.
* '''Player:''' And our foes? What do we know about them?
* '''Eva Cashien:''' Lucien's forces are being led by someone called Moia. Our records have little information on her, but if Lucien has trusted her with this task, we must assume she is very dangerous.
* '''Armacus Selles:''' However, luckily for us, there does seem to have been some splintering within Lucien's ranks. The Dagon'hai no longer appear to be working with him. Instead, they seem intent on raiding the Archive for themselves.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' There is also a goblin warband that has somehow found out about this place. I fear we may have other foes as well that have not yet revealed themselves.
* '''Player:''' Sounds like we'd best not waste any time then.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' Thank you, [player name]. Once you've cleared the central chamber, we'll split up and tackle our enemies one at a time.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' We'll be leaning heavily on you once again, [player name]. Our forces will do what they can to lift your burden, but our enemies are powerful, and you have more experience than most.
* '''Player:''' Thank you, I'll-
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Indeed! They are powerful. But! You need not face them alone. I have no doubt that an enterprising young adventurer such as yourself has many capable and jolly allies.
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Now is the time to unite, and leverage the strength of our co-operation against the weakness of our foes' greed.
* '''Player:''' I'll see what I can do.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' We must go and ready our forces. We will see you inside.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Good luck, [player name].
* {{tact|All three of them leave, with Armacus bowing before he goes.}}

==During the raid==
===Alliance navigator===
* '''Alliance Navigator:''' Good work, [player name]. Our forces have held so far, but the next foes await.
* {{tselect|Are you ready to proceed?}}
* {{topt|Yes.}}
* {{topt|No.}}

===Talking to Armacus===
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Well met, [player name].
* '''Player:''' Well met, Armacus.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Thanks for helping the Alliance.}}
** '''Player:''' Thanks for helping the Alliance.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Ha! It is I that should be thanking you, young [player name]. I understand you were the first to help rally this group, and it is a fine group indeed.
** '''Player:''' Yes, that it is, and it will likely need to be, with what we're up against.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Yes... Our enemies are powerful. With the Staff and the Stone, Lucien approaches the power of the gods. Meanwhile, we have been left without ours.
** '''Player:''' You would rather you had Armadyl at your side, then?
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Do not mistake me, [player name], Guthix's choice expelled as much evil as it did justice, but it was perhaps naive of him to think that it would rid the world of its maluses.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Our current predicament is evidence enough of that.
** '''Player:''' Well, thank you for helping to defend the Archive in spite of your doubts.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Ha! I need not agree with my allies on every small matter. The important thing is that we've all chosen to work together on the things that are of importance.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' The Alliance's goals foster the justice I seek. That is enough for me. Now, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us deal with the remaining villains here.
** {{Tact|end}}
* {{topt|How are the defence efforts going?}}
** '''Player:''' How are the defence efforts going?
** '''Armacus Selles:''' They hold, if by a single thread. But! It is a single thread more than our enemies possess.
** '''Player:''' That's good news. I don't know how I feel about us hanging on by a single thread, but it's good to hear you in good spirits despite it.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Ha! It is important to remember, young [player name], that whilst the fight for goodness and justice may feel desperate, the fight for evil is twice as much so.
** '''Player:''' How is that?
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Tell me, [player name], despite all of its flaws, do you find the world to be a good place?
** {{tselect|Select an option}}
** {{topt|Yes, I suppose I do.}}
*** '''Player:''' Yes, I suppose I do.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' And is the world not assailed, unendingly, by those who wish to see that change?
*** '''Player:''' Yes, all of the time.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' And yet goodness remains. We often view our fight as one to keep the fragile flame of hope from being snuffed out.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' But we have extinguished a million embers of evil. Ha! It is they who are on the back foot!
*** '''Player:''' I can agree with that, I suppose.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' Good, good. Well, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us beat back these villains once more!
*** {{Tact|end}}
** {{topt|I... Recently, I'm not sure I do.}}
*** '''Player:''' I... Recently, I'm not sure I do.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' Ah... I am sorry to hear that, friend. It is true that evil's grip has been tight of late. Even the strongest resolves are being tested.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' Perhaps we could instead say that the world contains pockets of enduring goodness?
*** '''Player:''' Yes, I suppose that is true.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' And is the world not assailed, unendingly, by those who wish to see that change?
*** '''Player:''' Yes, all of the time.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' And yet goodness remains. We often view our fight as one to keep the fragile flame of hope from being snuffed out.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' But we have extinguished a million embers of evil. Ha! It is they who are on the back foot!
*** '''Player:''' I suppose I can see where you're coming from.
*** '''Armacus Selles:''' Good, good. Well, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us beat back these villains once more!
*** {{Tact|end}}
* {{topt|Do you need relief?}}
** '''Player:''' Do you need relief?
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Ha! I suppose I am a little winded. Our opponents are fierce, and our resources are few and spread thin. However, you need not worry about me.
** '''Player:''' You're more useful to us healthy and rested than injured. Everybody is. We can find somebody to take your place.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Your concern warms my old heart, young [player name]. But no, I am afraid everybody else is in need of respite as much as I am, if not more. That is simply the nature of our circumstances.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Though our trials might not weigh quite so heavy if we were to leverage the power held within the Archive.
** '''Player:''' We're here to protect the Archive from intruders, not to beat them to the punch.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' I am aware, I am aware... However, I would argue our willingness to protect this place might mark us as worthy to wield its power, if only for its defence.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' After all, should we fail, the power will end up in nefarious hands either way. But! Worry not. There is fight left in me yet. And whilst there is, such a future will not come to pass.
** '''Player:''' Yes, you're looking better already. Perhaps we should put you on double duty!
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Ha! A jape! At my expense, no less! Very well, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us return to battle once more!
** {{Tact|end}}
* {{topt|Goodbye.}}
** '''Player:''' Goodbye.
** '''Armacus Selles:''' Godspeed, [player name]!
** {{Tact|end}}

===Talking to him again===
* '''Armacus Selles:''' I believe that is all the chatter we can afford, young [player name]. Our foes will not wait.
* {{Tact|end}}

===Overhead dialogue===
* '''Armacus Selles:''' {{overhead|Pick a side and get to work!}}

====Alliance navigator====
* '''Alliance Navigator:''' Thank you, [player name]. We're almost there. There are only two sets of intruders left.
* {{tselect|Are you ready to proceed?}}
* {{topt|Yes.}}
* {{topt|No.}}

===Talking to Eva Cashien===
* '''Eva Cashien:''' [player name].
* '''Player:''' Eva.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|How are the Temple Knights faring?}}
** '''Player:''' How are the Temple Knights faring?
** '''Eva Cashien:''' Their training is being put to the test, but they are performing admirably.
** '''Player:''' The Alliance is lucky to have the Temple Knights' resources on its side.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' You are kind. The Alliance is lucky to have each other. As much as I wish it weren't so, the Temple Knights alone could not hold the Archive.
** '''Player:''' You sound slightly disappointed.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' Not disappointed, but worried. We have mounted an impressive defence at short notice, but it is barely holding. Had this alliance not existed, the Archive would have been breached.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' Even if we succeed here, there is a lesson to be taken. The forces of evil are many and strong, and we were unprepared.
** '''Player:''' They are many, but they are not united. We will win because we found allies, and because we worked together.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' You speak wisely, [player name]. Our time for discussion runs short, however. Let us return to our duties.
** {{Tact|end}}
* {{topt|What do you make of the Archive?}}
** '''Player:''' What do you make of the Archive?
** '''Eva Cashien:''' It is... Dangerous. This kind of magic, old magic, is unpredictable. Guthix did well to seal it away.
** '''Player:''' Yes, if the artefacts here fall into the wrong hands, we'll have an even bigger problem than we have now.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' You are not wrong, [player name], but even if they fell into the 'right' hands, if such an idea even exists, they would be a danger to the world.
** '''Player:''' I suppose you're right, but I imagine many would consider there to be grey areas. If the world were in severe danger, and an artefact could help, many would want to leverage it.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' But would they be right? We know very little about the artefacts here, which can be even more dangerous than knowing nothing at all.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' People make assumptions about things they think they understand. And assumptions about magic this complex and this powerful are dangerous.
** '''Player:''' I see your point. I'm not sure I'd want to commit to that stance completely, but I see your point.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' That is well with me. Variety of perspective, when measured, is an important part of order. The time for discussion runs thin, however. Let us return to our duties.
** {{Tact|end}}
* {{topt|It's good to have the Temple Knights on our side.}}
** '''Player:''' It's good to have the Temple Knights on our side.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' Do I detect a hint of surprise in your voice?
** '''Player:''' Perhaps. Saradominists often seem... at odds with Guthix and his followers.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' This much is true... but Saradominism is also the most widespread religion in Gielinor. We are not all of a single perspective.
** '''Player:''' So you don't have any troubles with Guthix?
** '''Eva Cashien:''' I could think of a couple if needed, but truthfully, no. While many Saradominists dislike Guthix for banishing Saradomin, they forget that we are connected to him through faith, not his physical presence.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' It's unlikely most of his followers were ever in his presence, even in the ages where he walked Gielinor. That doesn't diminish their bond.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' And through mine and the Temple Knights' actions, we practice and spread Saradomin's teachings. In that way, he is very much still present.
** '''Player:''' That's a nice perspective. I think King Roald's advisor would benefit from hearing it.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' With a religion as large as Saradominism, a few bad apples are inevitable. We make efforts to deal with a lot of them, but those victories are rarely seen by those outside the faith.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' My only wish is that people would not judge the faith only by those who wield it with malice. Either judge the faith itself, or judge each follower individually.
** '''Player:''' That's not an unreasonable request. I suppose I could do better myself.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' Thank you. Now, the time for discussion runs thin. Let us return to our duties.
** {{Tact|end}}
* {{topt|Goodbye.}}
** '''Player:''' Goodbye.
** '''Eva Cashien:''' Take care, [player name]!
** {{Tact|end}}

====Talking to her again====
* '''Eva Cashien:''' Our time for discussion runs short, [player name]. Let us return to our duties.
* {{Tact|end}}

===Overhead dialogue===
====Eva====
* '''Eva Cashien:''' {{overhead|Pick a side, and may Saradomin guide you!}}
* '''Eva Cashien:''' {{overhead|There's no time to waste, pick a side!}}

====Guardian of Armadyl====
* '''Guardian of Armadyl:''' {{overhead|More potions, coming up!}}

===Alliance navigator===
* '''Alliance Navigator:''' I am sorry to be the bearer of bad news, [player name]. There has been a disturbance in the inner vault. Ivy has requested your presence immediately.
* {{tselect|Are you ready to proceed?}}
* {{topt|Yes.}}
* {{topt|No.}}

===Ivy Sophista===
* '''Player:''' What's happening?
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' We're not sure. The defence has been a success. Only a small number of enemies remain for us to deal with. We were preparing to do just that when we heard a disturbance coming from within the inner vault.
* '''Player:''' How is that possible?
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' It shouldn't be. This is the only way in or out of the vault, and yet... someone... or something has managed to get in there all the same.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' [player name], I wish I weren't asking this of you, but you are one of the most capable warriors amongst us.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Please, enter the vault with your allies and report back with what you find. Defend it if necessary. Given there are still other enemies for us to deal with, I'm afraid it is unlikely we will be able to help.
* '''Player:''' Don't worry, Ivy, leave it with us.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Thank you. Good luck.
* {{Tact|end}}

====Talking to her again====
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Good luck in there, [player name].
* {{Tact|end}}

===Talking to Ivy subsequent times after beating the raid===
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' It seems Ocellus is trying to claim the Blade once more.
* '''Player:''' Don't worry, I don't intend to let him.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Thank you, [player name], and good luck.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|The Alliance has come together nicely.}}
** '''Player:''' The Alliance has come together nicely.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Yes, we have every reason to be proud. My only regret is that we were unable to convince more people to form the coalition.
** '''Player:''' Who else would you have taken?
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' With the current state of affairs, practically anybody willing to help. But if I had my choice, I would try to make the alliance less... lopsided.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' We represent one side of the sphere too much. Order, justice... They are in a similar space. Even I myself lean outside of my usual balance due to Lucien.
** '''Player:''' Are you saying you want some chaos in the mix? That seems... dangerous.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Perhaps, but there is also danger in imbalance. I would not trust the Dagon'hai quickly, but they've seemingly realised the error of their ways in supporting Lucien.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' It's unlikely, but they could take that further now. They could consider joining the fight against him.
** '''Player:''' I reckon that would be quite risky for us.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Yes, but it would potentially be one fewer enemy to fight. Besides, it would be easier to watch them carefully as tense allies than to defend from them as an unseen threat.
** '''Player:''' I suppose you have a point. It's just strange to think of them as potential allies, having fought them so recently.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' That is the way of the world. Rivers twist and turn, alliances shift and change. Guthix believed in the natural process. So do I.
** '''Player:''' Hasn't the natural process led to Lucien obtaining the Stone?
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' That... is a complicated question to answer. It has, partially, but Lucien's plans and hunger for power can be traced back to the ages in which the gods walked Gielinor. In that way, it has not.
** '''Player:''' How do you mean?
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' The gods once granted powers that rushed mortals through the natural process. This has its advantages, but it creates brittle and volatile ecosystems. Imbalance. The Stone is one such power.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Lucien will use the Stone to do as the gods once did. He will upset the balance so drastically, that it may not recover. This cannot be allowed to happen.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' That is why Crux Eqal intervened. Both because Lucien acts outside of the natural balance, and also because our actions are inherently natural. After all, we are a part of Gielinor.
** '''Player:''' When you put it like that, chaos does start to sound like an okay alternative.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Yes, quite. Now, I believe I have kept you long enough. Let us return to the Archive's defence.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|How is Crux Eqal doing?}}
** '''Player:''' How is Crux Eqal doing?
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' We are still recovering from our losses... but our enemies are not affording us much time. The opening of the Archive is taking its toll.
** '''Player:''' It has been difficult lately. It's a lot of threats, one after another. And it seems like it's always the same few groups of people who are willing respond.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' That is the burden carried by those of us who care for the world.
** '''Player:''' Is there not a way we could gain some sort of advantage? Could we maybe seal the Archive for good? This deep underground a few collapsed pillars might bury it and leave it completely unreachable.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' I have considered that myself, [player name], and you are right that it may bring us some much needed breathing room. However, I do not believe Guthix intended for it to be sealed forever.
** '''Player:''' He didn't? I thought the things inside were a danger to the world.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' I cannot say for certain, but it is my belief that he didn't. You are correct that the artefacts within are dangerous, but fire is also dangerous. It can burn down forests and raze cities.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' But tamed, fire gives us food and warmth. A dangerous thing isn't inherently bad, it just needs to be learned slowly and carefully.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' The problem with things like the Blade or the Stone of Jas is that the world was not prepared for their power.
** '''Player:''' So you think Guthix believed the world would be ready for them eventually, and you don't want to leave the Archive inaccessible?
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Yes, but it's clear that now is very much not the right time for it to be opened. And so our duty now is to guard it rather than bury it.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Speaking of which, I believe I have kept you long enough. Let us return to the Archive's defence.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Goodbye.}}
** '''Player:''' Goodbye.
** '''Ivy Sophista:''' Take care, [player name].
** {{tact|end}}

====Talking to her again====
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Good luck in there, [player name]. Leave the rest of the defence to us. We're almost there.
* {{tact|end}}

===Meeting Ocellus for the first time===
* '''Player:''' You... Who are you? And how did you get in here?
* '''Hooded Figure:''' Human... You stand before Ocellus... Chosen... of Guthix...
* '''Player:''' You serve Guthix?
* '''Hooded Figure:''' Yes... He charged me... to guard the source of his power... But his enemies approach... They are not worthy of it...
* '''Player:''' Well, then we're on the same side. I'm part of an alliance defending this place. The danger is mostly gone though. We held off the attackers.
* '''Hooded Figure:''' No... Your alliance... is false... Armadyl... Saradomin... They are no better... than the rest... They are not worthy... of this power...
* '''Player:''' We don't want it! We just want to keep this place safe!
* '''Hooded Figure:''' Wrong... Many try... but none can resist... You will try to take it... His blade...
* '''Hooded Figure:''' There is only one solution... Only Guthix himself is worthy... but he is long gone...
* '''Hooded Figure:''' To keep his power safe... I will take his place...
* '''Hooded Figure:''' The time has come... for ascension.
* {{tselect|Are you ready for the final challenge?}}
* {{topt|Yes.}}
* {{topt|No.}}

===Subsequent attempts===
* '''Ocellus:''' You... return... Do you not see... You can't resist...
* {{tselect|Are you ready for the final challenge?}}
* {{topt|Yes.}}
* {{topt|No.}}

==Finishing up==
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' [player name]! What happened?
* '''Player:''' It's hard to put into words... There was someone in the inner vault... but he was Guthixian!
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Ah, a new ally for our cause!
* '''Player:''' I wish that were so...
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' They opposed you? Who were they?
* '''Player:''' He called himself Ocellus.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' Ocellus? I'm not familiar with this name.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Surely it can't be so...
* '''Armacus Selles:''' You know who this Ocellus is, Ivy?
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' I have heard only stories... and very few at that. It is said that when the God Wars ended, Guthix tasked a select few with guarding items and areas of great power.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' There is Juna of course, but also Valluta... Aeternam... These are just some of the names passed down through our order. Ocellus was another.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' It is never said exactly what it was he was tasked with, but the stories call him the Guardian of Ascension.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' And he was guarding this vault? But then... what was in it?
* '''Player:''' It was... a sword of some sorts. It had been shattered, but Ocellus was still able to use it. Its power was... extraordinary.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' Fascinating... and terrifying...
* '''Armacus Selles:''' If you know of Ocellus, Ivy, then perhaps you are familiar with this blade as well?
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' I'm afraid not, but for Ocellus to be guarding it, I fear it is of a power far beyond our understanding.
* '''Player:''' Ocellus said none could resist its power. In truth, I think that might have included him. He claimed none were worthy of claiming it, and yet was happy to try and use it himself.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' Hmm... What was Ocellus' fate, [player name]?
* '''Player:''' He's dead.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' Forgive me, [player name], but I suspect that is unlikely. Ocellus will have been granted power by Guthix himself. He will not die easily.
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Then we must consider him another enemy.
* '''Eva Cashien:''' And our other foes will soon regroup. I fear our defence of the Archive has only just begun.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' I suspect you're right. Thank you, [player name], for all of your help here, but it seems we must prepare to resume our defence. Any help you can continue to provide would be greatly appreciated.
* '''Player:''' I'll do what I can.
* '''Ivy Sophista:''' That is all we can ever ask. Now, best we begin our preparations for the next wave of attacks.
* '''Armacus Selles:''' Yes! Time to beat back our foes once more!
* {{tbox|The others depart.}}

title: Transcript:The Fremennik Exiles
Transcript:The Fremennik Isles
content:
{{External|rs}}
{{Transcript|quest}}
{{Transcript list|Bork Sigmundson|Flosi Dalksson|Fridleif Shieldson|Guard (Jatizso)|Honour guard|HRH Hrafn|Hring Hring|Keepa Kettilon|King Gjuki Sorvott IV|Maria Gunnars|Mawnis Burowgar|Mord Gunnars|Raum Urda-Stein|Skuli Myrka|Slug Hemligssen|Thakkrad Sigmundson|Thorkel Silkbeard|Kjedelig Uppsen|Trogen Konungarde|Vanligga Gastfrihet|Brendt|Grundt|Magnus Gram|Eric (Jatizso)}}

==Starting off==
===Learning about Jatizso===
====Talking to Maria Gunnars====
* {{tcond|Before starting the quest:}}
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' Hello, are you [Fremennik name]?
** '''Player:''' I am, but who are you?
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' I am Maria Gunnars, Mord's wife.
** '''Maira Gunnars:''' You should speak with my husband. He has been looking for you.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|After starting the quest:}}
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' I am Maria Gunnars.
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' You should speak with my husband.
** '''Mord:''' Hello, [Fremennik name].
** {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Mord Gunnars in Rellekka====
* {{tcond|Before starting the quest:}}
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Hello, are you [Fremennik name]? by any chance?
** '''Player:''' Well my name is [player name], but I am known as [Fremennik name] by the Fremennik. May I ask who you are?
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Of course, I am Mord Gunnars, a humble ferryman.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' I come from an island north of here called Jatizso, while my wife Maria is from Neitiznot.
** '''Maria:''' Hello.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' The King of Jatizso has requested that I take you to him, as he has an important task for you.
** {{tselect|Start The Fremennik Isles quest?}}
** {{topt|Yes.}}
*** {{tact|(Show options below)}}
** {{topt|No.}}
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|After starting the quest:}}
** '''Player:''' Hello Mord.
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Tell me more about Jatizso's history.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me more about Jatizso.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Well now, the history of the isles is a bloody tale. When told in its intended form it takes 9 days and 9 nights. However, I will give you the abridged version.
** '''Player:''' Phew!
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Four generations ago there was a mighty king who ruled wisely and was loved by all.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' He had many sons, most of whom proved themselves in the usual Fremennik ways of fighting, sailing, drinking and so on.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' His youngest two sons, however, were a problem. Ever since they were old enough to hit one another they had bickered and fought.
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' Their names were Jatizso and Neitiznot.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Hey! Who's telling this story?
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Ahem. At the time it was customary for the Kings' sons to claim a prize from his treasury when they came of age.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Each brother rallied support and strode out to confront the other on the field of battle to claim the same prize.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' The brothers met on the field, limbs were bruised, bones were crushed and heads clashed.
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' They probably didn't notice the head-clashing bit. Too thick skulled!
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Can I finish the story without interruptions?
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' Carry on dear.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Anyway, long into the night they fought, until they stood alone, facing each other.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' On the second day the old king, whose patience was exhausted, strode out onto the field and demanded to know who had claimed his prize.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Jatizso looked at his father and told him yes, it was his, to which the other called out 'No! It's not'.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' And so, the argument continued through to the third day, with the sounds of 'Jah! 'tis so!', 'Ne! It's not!' echoing over the field, becoming more hoarse as the darkness enveloped the brothers.
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' Bah! What they needed was a good clip round the ear.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' At the end of the third day, when the brothers lay unable to move, let alone stand, the King stood between them in shame.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' As punishment for their squabbling he banished his sons from his realm, ordering that neither should return until they had conquered lands of their own.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Jatizso set sail with a band of loyal followers, sailing into the east, while Neitiznot went west.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Jatizso ventured far into uncharted oceans, his crew dwindling as the trials of sailing and sea monsters took them.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Jatizso's ship limped through the frozen wastes, in need of repairs, fighting off pirates who thought them easy pickings.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' At last a promising land was sighted, a land rich in minerals, deep fjords and sweeping mountains.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Jatizso claimed the land and named it after himself.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' A mighty citadel was constructed to protect his land; then Jatizso set forth to explore his new kingdom.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Crossing a few fjords, Jatizso spied an island which remained green and fertile, even at such latitude.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' With a mighty cheer Jatizso and his men marched on the island. Upon reaching the island, however, they discovered a wooden stockade.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Determined to be master of all the land, Jatizso stood in front of the gates. He looked up and demanded that those within the stockade surrendered.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Jatizso was horrified when his brother appeared on the battlements and cried 'This is my land! Go find yer own'. To which his brother replied 'No it's not!', throwing some rocks for good measure.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' And so the blood feud continued.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' The fighting between the towns has continued for generations with little sign of improvement.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Quite recently a massive troll army seized one of the islands to the north, while our townships' militias were busy fighting one another.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' They marched down and razed Neitiznot to the ground while Neitiznot's troops laid siege to Jatizso.
** '''Maria Gunnars:''' The smoke damage was atrocious, I had to replace my entire wardrobe.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Yes, dear.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Anyway, a hasty sort of peace has been agreed until the trolls are dealt with.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' But you can still see the bitter rivalry as guards hurl insults between the towns.
** {{tact|previous}}
* {{topt|Tell me more about the King of Jatizso.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me more about the King of Jatizso.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Ha! Our benevolent King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' He is short-tempered, arrogant and cares little about anything except outdoing Neitiznot's Burgher.
** '''Maria:''' He's not at all like Burgher Burowgar.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' I'm surprised King Sorvott wishes to talk to you. Don't expect much in the way of gratitude.
** {{tact|previous}}
* {{topt|Can you ferry me to Jatizso?}}
** '''Player:''' Can you ferry me to Jatizso?
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Of course.
** {{mes|Leaving Rellekka for Jatizso.}}
* {{topt|I'm too busy to help your King.}}
** '''Player:''' I'm too busy to help your King.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' I guess I won't be getting paid for finding you, then.
** '''Player:''' I may be back later.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' {{overhead|Bye}}
** {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Mord Gunnars in Jatizso====
* '''Mord Gunnars:''' Hi, [Fremennik name], you should speak with King Sorvott in the main chambers.
* '''Mord Gunnars:''' The chambers have the town's banner erected outside.
* '''Player:''' Thank you for bringing me here Mord.
* '''Mord Gunnars:''' Is there anything I can do for you?
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Tell me more about Jatizso.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me more about Jatizso.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Jatizso is a small Fremennik town, which is far less closed to the world than other Fremennik tribes.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' We maintain trade links with many powers in the world and have moved beyond some traditions to take advantage of modern advances.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' We do, however, continue to 'enlighten' our neighbours in Neitiznot. Unfortunately, some of the Islands are infested with trolls.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' We should really be trying to deal with the trolls, but the King tends to get a bit preoccupied with his cousin, the Burgher of Neitiznot.
** {{topt|I'm too busy to help your King.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'm too busy to help your King.
*** '''Mord Gunnars:''' I guess I won't be getting paid for finding you, then.
*** '''Player:''' I may be back later.
*** '''Mord Gunnars:''' {{overhead|Bye!}}
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Tell me more about the King of Jatizso.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me more about the King of Jatizso.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Ha! Our benevolent King Gjuki Sorvott IV. He doesn't have much of an opinion about anyone, apart from his cousin Mawnis who rules the other Island. He hates him with a passion that can occasionally be quite scary.
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' You might be able to talk to him if you help out around Jatizso. Don't expect much in the way of gratitude though.
** {{tact|previous}}
* {{topt|Can you ferry me to Rellekka?}}
** '''Player:''' Can you ferry me to Rellekka?
** '''Mord Gunnars:''' Sure.
** {{mes|Leaving Jatizso for Rellekka.}}
* {{topt|No, I'm fine right now.}}
** '''Player:''' No, I'm fine right now.
** {{tact|end}}

===First meetings in Jatizso===
====Talking to Keepa Kettilon====
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' Oh, hello stranger. If you're new to town you should speak with our ruler, King Gjuki Sorvott IV. He'll want to meet you - he always wants to have a chat with any strangers in town. They could be spies you know.
* '''Player:''' Spies?
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' Yes, spies from Neitiznot. They're everywhere. Apparently. That's what the King says anyway.
* '''Player:''' So what do you do here?
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' Me? I'm a cook. Fish dishes a speciality. I hate fish. But fish is about all we have. Except for yak. But we're not allowed to eat yak.
* '''Player:''' Why not, is yak meat bad for you?
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' Certainly not! Yak meat is both sweet and delicately flavoured. Yak is juicier than buffalo and elk - but never gamey. It goes wonderfully well with a glass of red wine, and it's healthy too!
* '''Player:''' So why aren't you allowed to eat it?
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' King's orders. They breed and eat yaks on Neitiznot, so WE'RE not allowed to. It's unjust I tell you! I had a dream last night about a juicy fillet of yak, served on a bed of deep-fried seaweed and topped with a garnish
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' of crumbly yak's cheese.
* '''Player:''' That's a little sad. So do you have any cooked food I could buy?
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' No. It would only be fish anyway. Why would you want to eat fish?
* '''Player:''' Well, I wouldn't mind a few shark and swordfish steaks as back-up you know.
* '''Keepa Kettilon:''' If you insist. Sorry the stock is so low, but I just can't be bothered to cook any more.
* {{tact|opens=Keepa Kettilon's store}}

====Talking to Vanligga Gastfrihet====
* '''Player:''' Hello. What's happening in town at the moment?
* '''Vanligga Gastfrihet:''' These dwarves have arrived from Keldagrim - the Chancellor has asked me to look after them, but they are eating all of our food and drinking all of our booze.
* '''Player:''' What are the dwarves doing here?
* '''Vanligga Gastfrihet:''' They are organising some sort of trade agreement. I don't know what they are trading.
* '''Player:''' Thanks.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Brendt or Grundt====
* '''Brendt:''' Hmm, interesting place this. It feels a little like Kelda, except without the good bits.
* '''Grundt:''' Bored, bored, bored. These Fremenniks are taking ages.
* '''Player:''' Hey, they're doing their best. You arrived early.
* '''Grundt:''' Hey, we arrived precisely when we told your representatives. Lack of planning on your part does not constitute an emergency on my part.
* '''Vanligga Gastfrihet:''' Please, someone get these guys their ore quickly. They are eating all the good food on the island, and complaining about it!
* '''Player:''' I'd better get a move on!
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to the throne room guard====
* '''Guard:''' Welcome, [Fremennik name].
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Thorkel====
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Please introduce yourself to our ruler, His Royal Greatness King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to King Sorvott IV===
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Guard, who is this outlander?
* '''Hrafn:''' Meeow? ''(An outlander, how unusual. Welcome.)''
* '''Guard:''' This is [Fremennik name], your majesty.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Is this true? You are the outlander who has been given a Fremennik name?
* '''Hrafn:''' Miouw...meow. ''(You have a human Fremennik name, how unusual.)''
* '''Player:''' Indeed I am.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Excellent.
* '''Player:''' How may I assist your Highness?
* '''Hrafn:''' Meouw! ''(Well, outlander, one requires a fish immediately.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Behave Hrafn!
* '''Hrafn:''' Meeeiouw! Mewwww! ''(Behave yourself human! One shall behave as one likes.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' I have a task that requires your unique-
* '''Hrafn:''' MEEEEOOOUW!!!! ''(Will you stop interrupting one? For the last time one requires tuna immediately.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Not now, Hrafn.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Now where was I?
* '''Player:''' You mentioned a task requiring my unique-
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Ah, yes.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Your unique position among Fremennik-
* '''Hrafn:''' MEEEIOOOOUW! MIOOOOOEW! YOOWLLL! ''(For goodness' sake! One might acquire the mistaken impression that the human rules this place. I command you to feed me.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Hrafn! Oh, alright, alright, I give in.
* '''Hrafn:''' Purrr. ''(And about time too, insolent human-pet.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Look, could you fetch my cat some fish?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Then we can finish our conversation in peace.
* '''Player:''' Yes, that's probably a good idea.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Thank you.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Hrafn will only eat raw tuna.
* '''Player:''' Will any raw tuna do?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Yes, fussy though Hrafn is, he doesn't care where the tuna comes from.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' If you don't already have any, you can catch some down by the docks, or you can buy some from my fishmonger, Flosi Dalksson.
* {{tact|end}}

===Tuna delivery===
====Talking to the throne room guard====
* '''Guard:''' Halt, in the name of King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
* '''Guard:''' Oh, its{{sic}} you again.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Thorkel====
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Hello, [Fremennik name]. That cat really is a pain isn't he? Always interrupting the King.
* '''Player:''' Oh, I've met worse. Still, I'd better get him his fish, otherwise he'll never keep quiet.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Oh, go and talk to Flosi Dalksson in his shop. He'll have some tuna if you don't have any. You could also fish it from one of the spots round here, if you prefer.
* '''Player:''' Thanks!
* {{tact|end}}

====Giving tuna to Hrafn directly====
=====When given cooked tuna=====
* '''Player:''' Here you go, enjoy your fish.
* '''Hrafn:''' What is the meaning of this serf? One specifically asked for RAW tuna, not fish defiled by human fire!
* {{tact|end}}

=====When given noted raw or cooked tuna=====
* '''Player:''' Here you go. Enjoy your fish.
* '''Hrafn:''' What is the meaning of this serf? How is one supposed to eat a piece of paper?
* {{tact|end}}

=====When given raw tuna=====
* '''Player:''' Here you go. enjoy your fish!
* '''Hrafn:''' Purrrrrrrrrr (One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.)
* Hopefully Hrafn won't disturb your discussion with the King now.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to King Sorvott IV====
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Hello again, [Fremennik name].
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Do you have a piece of raw tuna for Hrafn?
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have the raw tuna:}}
** '''Player:''' Not yet, your Highness.
** '''Hrafn:''' Miouw! ''(Then get a move on human!!)''
** '''King Sorvott IV:''' Well, what are you waiting for?
** {{tact|end}}
* '''Player:''' Yes, I have your pet's fish.
* '''Hrafn:''' Meow. ''(Hmmm, one will lower oneself to eat the fish, despite the human's insult.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Excellent.
* {{tbox|pic=Raw tuna detail.png|You feed Hrafn the tuna.}}
* '''Hrafn:''' Purrr. ''(One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Now, what was I saying?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Ah, yes, so the Burgher of Neitiznot Island is an enemy of free-thinking Jatizso citizens. My informants tell me an increased number of trade ships have been seen docking at their ports. They must be preparing for something. Chancellor, fill in the details.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Sire, Sire! The Kelda merchants have arrived, they are three days early. We're not ready!
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' What? We cannot afford to offend the Red Axe traders. Where are they now?
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' They are in the hall, eating and drinking us out of food and beer. It's costing us a fortune.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Another good reason to get them their ore and get them out of town. Get all our miners on the job now!
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' I already have. They'll never get enough ore in time, the bunch of lazy no-good layabouts.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Bah! Those miners haven't learned their lesson.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' It may be time for some extra incentives.
* '''Player:''' Wait a minute! I'm fairly handy with a pick axe. Maybe I can help; what do you need?
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' We need [six/seven/eight] pieces of [tin/coal/mithril] for Keldagrim's merchants.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' The entrance to our mines are to the north-east of the western gatehouse, outside the walls.
* '''Player:''' If I just happen to have the ore you need in the bank, do I need to go down to your mines?
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' If you bring us the ore, we won't ask where it came from. Don't worry we're discreet.
* '''Player:''' Hmmm, interesting. I'll get the ore then.
* {{tact|end}}

===Ore delivery===
====Talking to Flosi Dalksson====
* '''Player:''' Can you tell me where to find the nearest mines?
* '''Flosi Dalksson:''' Err, there are some mines just outside the western gatehouse. I don't know what the rocks contain there though, you'll have to have a look.
* '''Flosi Dalksson:''' Is there anything I can help you with?
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Can I have a look at your stock please?}}
** '''Player:''' Can I have a look at your stock please?
** {{tact|opens=Flosi's Fishmongers}}
* {{topt|No, nothing just now thanks.}}
** '''Player:''' No, nothing just now thanks.
** {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Thorkel====
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Do you have the ore?
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have the ore:}}
** '''Player:''' Can you remind me of what those Dwarven traders need?
** '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Of course. Please bring [six/seven/eight] pieces of [tin/coal/mithril] ore.
** '''Player:''' And the mines are...
** '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' The entrance to the mines is outside the western gatehouse, on the north side of the town.
** '''Player:''' Thanks.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has the ore noted:}}
** '''Player:''' I have bank notes to the value of the ore here.
** {{tact|continue}}
* {{tcond|If the player has the ore unnoted:}}
** '''Player:''' I have the ore here.
** {{tact|continue}}
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Excellent. This [man/woman] has gathered the [six/seven/eight] pieces of [tin/coal/mithril] ore needed by Keldagrim's merchants, sire.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Good, good. Please reward this [man/woman] for [his/her] efforts.
* {{tact|continue}}

====Talking to King Sorvott IV====
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Hello again, [Fremennik name].
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Do you have all the ore my Chancellor requested?
* {{tcond|If the player doesn't have the ore:}}
** '''Player:''' Not yet.
** '''King Sorvott IV:''' Please hurry back with [six/seven/eight] [tin/coal/mithril], Keldagrim's traders are drinking my cellars dry.
** {{tact|end}}
* '''Player:''' I have the ore here, sir.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' This [man/woman] has gathered the remaining ore needed by Keldagrim's merchants.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Excellent news, your majesty.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Please reward this [man/woman] for [his/her] efforts.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Of course, your majesty.
* {{tbox|Thorkel Silkbeard takes [six/seven/eight] lumps of [tin/coal/mithril].}}
* {{tbox|pic=Coins 250 detail.png|Thorkel Silkbeard hands you [amount] coins.}}
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Thank you [Fremennik name]. If only our miners were as efficient as you.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Right. Now let us get down to business, young [Fremennik name]. Let us hope we have no more interruptions.
* '''Player:''' Certainly, your Majesty.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Neitiznot's Burgher, Mawnis Burowgar, is a simpleton and a fool.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' I have bested him before and will do so again!
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' He is surely plotting a new plan to defeat me.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' He's up to something, he's always up to something.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' I will not be kept in the dark about his plans any longer. I must know what underhand tricks he'll use to undermine me. He's out to get me! Get me I say!
* '''Player:''' Ahem, I see, sir. How may I help in this matter?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Well, I have heard that some call you 'bard' in Rellekka. Your lyre-playing reputation has carried this far.
* '''Player:''' You want me to play the lyre? Well actually, I've been working on a few tunes in my spare time. I have this new song about-
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Silence! I do not wish to hear your wailing. All bards are charlatans and fools.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' However, a fool is exactly what I need right now.
* '''Player:''' Oh.
* '''Player:''' It's a great tune, very catching, you'll love-
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Bah! Bards are all the same, they never shut up! If I need to be entertained I'll hire a mime; maybe I'll get some rest then. Now if you'll listen, I'll explain what I need you to do.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' In the past I have sent my Spymaster to 'entertain' the Burgher, and to see what he can find out.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' You see, the Burgher of Neitiznot and his aides like a drink when they are being entertained, and their tongues are loose when they drink.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' However, yesterday my spy had an accident and could no longer help me in this task. However he is still stationed on Neitiznot.
* '''Player:''' So this is a covert operation into Neitiznot? You need me to infiltrate the Burgher's hall, undercover, and uncover his evil plans?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Exactly, [Fremennik name]. So are you interested?
* '''Player:''' Sounds like a task for an elite adventurer like myself. Mission accepted.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Excellent, [Fremennik name], you and I will get on very well.
* '''Player:''' So what is the easiest way to get to Neitiznot?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' I suggest you catch Mord's ferry back to Rellekka and then catch a ferry from there.
* '''Player:''' Are you sure that's the best way?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' You may find a way across the islands, but the bridges are almost certainly broken, and there are trolls which are a bit of a nuisance. The ferry is probably both quicker and safer.
* '''Player:''' I'll be off then
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Oh, there is one more thing. In order to gain an audience with the Burgher, you will need my Spymaster's, err, costume.
* '''Player:''' Costume?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' The costume is in my chest. Don't forget to pick up all the pieces.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Then travel to Neitiznot and talk to my Spymaster. He is still over there. He will fill you in with the details, and you may report to him.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Oh, the Spymaster is a secretive kind of guy. He will require a password. The password is 'free stuff please'.
* '''Player:''' What sort of password is that?
* '''King Sorvott IV:'''  Don't ask me, it was his idea.
* '''Player:''' Fine. What's his name?

* {{mes|Just inside the cave mouth lays the body of one of Jatizso's guards.}}
* {{mes|Maybe I should enter the caves to the east, so I can find Neitiznot's militia.}}

===Entering the eastern cave===
* '''Player:''' Hmm. Left, right, then left again... I'm lost. Best I head toward the sound of the fighting.
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' Hold your ground men!
* '''Honour guard:''' The Champion had better arrive soon. We can't wait much longer!
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' [He/She] will be here soon. The Burgher trusts [Him/Her]. That's good enough for me.
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' Sir, Champion [Fremennik name] has arrived! I knew [He/She] wouldn't let us down!
* '''Player:''' It was a hard journey here. I trust you all made it here intact?
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' A little bruised but nothing a true Fremennik can't handle!
* '''Player:''' Well said!
* '''Honour guard:''' Our supplies are starting to run a little low; we should make our charge soon.
* '''Honour guard:''' Once you have helped to slay 10 trolls then you should be able to assault the Troll King.
* '''Honour guard:''' We will hold back the troll forces while you cross the bridge to the south of the cave.
* '''Player:''' I will find the Troll King there, correct?
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' Yes [sir/madam]! I have some supplies with me if you need them, but I only have a small amount left. We took a heavy toll getting here.
* '''Player:''' The fact you've saved any at all proves your bravery.
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' Thank you [sir/madam]. We have food, Strength potions and Prayer potions to see us through this battle.
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' A fine tale we will tell once you have claimed the beast's head.
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' Men, follow [Fremennik name]'s orders.
* '''Player:''' Ready, men?
* '''Honour guard:''' {{overhead|Aye Champion!.}}{{sic}}
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' {{overhead|Aye [sir/madam]!}}
* '''Player:''' Warriors, advance!
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' {{overhead|Charge!}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Bork===
* '''Player:''' Bork! The battle rages on and we are strong, but I need supplies!
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' What do you need, brave [Fremennik name], [sir/madam]?
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Give me food, Bork!}}
** '''Player:''' Give me food, Bork!
** '''Player:''' {{overhead|Give me food, Bork!}}
** '''Bork Sigmundson:''' Here, take this tuna quickly, [sir/madam]!
** {{mes|Bork Sigmundson hands you some Tuna.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|I need Strength potions!}}
** '''Player:''' I need Strength potions.
** '''Player:''' {{overhead|I need Strength potions.}}
** '''Bork Sigmundson:''' Strength be with you, [Fremennik name]!
** {{mes|Bork Sigmundson hands you some Strength potions.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|I need Prayer potions!}}
** '''Player:''' I need Prayer potions.
** '''Player:''' {{overhead|I need Prayer potions.}}
** '''Bork Sigmundson:''' May the gods be with you [Fremennik name]!
** {{mes|Bork Sigmundson hands you some Prayer potions.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|I don't need anything.}}
** '''Player:''' I don't need anything.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Bork after claiming all supplies===
* '''Bork Sigmundson:''' I've run out of supplies, [Fremennik name]! Only our bravery remains.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to King Sorvott after the start of the battle===
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' My guards will beat you to your goal yet.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' The weakness of wood and leather will be bested by my steel and mithril; mark my words.
* '''Player:''' I sense defeat in your voice already, mighty King.
* '''Player:''' You and I both know that Burgher Burowgar's forces are better prepared and trained than your men.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Guards, prepare my gallows at once.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' I would be leaving now if I were you, [Fremennik name].
* '''Player:''' I think you're right Thorkel, goodbye.
* {{tact|end}}

===Trying to cross the bridge before killing 10 trolls===
* {{mes|You have X more trolls to kill before you can kill the Troll King.}}
* {{mes|You have one more troll to kill before you can kill the Troll King.}}

===After defeating 10 trolls===
* {{mes|You have defeated enough trolls to attack the King.}}

===Facing the Ice Troll King===
* '''Player:''' {{overhead|What was that!}}
* '''Ice Troll King:''' {{overhead|Gruurg!}}
* {{tact|end}}

==Returning victorious==
===Talking to King Sorvott===
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' What are you doing in my court? Guards!
* '''Player:''' I have come to inform you that you may recall your guards; the Troll King was slain by my hand.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Preposterous. Lies, I tell you, lies!
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Yes, your majesty, of course your majesty.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Guards.
* '''Player:''' Guards! Where are your Guards?
* '''Player:''' Oh. Are they still recovering from their defeat against the trolls?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Outlander, leave me in peace before I am forced to bear arms against you myself.
* '''Player:''' Very well, your Highness, I leave you to contemplate this...
* '''Player:'''  Should you have approached me honestly and truthfully, rather than with lies and secrecy,
* '''Player:'''  then it could have been you holding the head of the Troll King aloft today.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Be gone with you. I have heard enough of your insults for one day.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Thanks, [Fremennik name], you are the first person to stand up to the King's bullying in many a year. Maybe he has learnt something today?
* '''Player:''' We can but hope Thorkel.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Fare thee well brave warrior, fare thee well.
* '''Hrafn:''' Purrrrz! ''(One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for [him/her] to stay.)''
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Useless, disloyal cat.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Mord Gunnars===
* '''Mord Gunnars:''' Hail the conquering hero!
* '''Player:''' Heh. Thanks - I was pretty heroic even if I say so myself.
* '''Mord Gunnars:''' Is there anything I can do for you?
* {{tact|above}}

===Talking to Thakkrad or Fridleif===
* '''Thakkrad Sigmundson/Fridleif Shieldson:''' Congratulations on defeating the Troll King. I hope you have collected the fine rewards that the Burgher Mawnis Burowgar has for you.
* {{tact|end}}

===Returning to Mawnis victorious===
* '''Player:''' I have returned victorious, Mawnis Burowgar.
* {{tcond|Without the ice troll king head:}}
** '''Fridleif Shieldson:''' Do you bring proof of your victory?
** '''Player:''' Nope.
** '''Fridleif Shieldson:''' You should bring proof to present to the Burgher.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|With the ice troll king head:}}
** '''Player:''' I have returned victorious, Mawnis Burowgar.
** '''Fridleif Shieldson:''' Hail, Champion of Neitiznot.
** '''Player:''' I offer the beast's head as proof that I have completed your task, sir.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' I thank you for bringing me this trophy, [Fremennik name], you have done much to bring honour to this isle.
** {{tbox|pic=Decapitated head (The Fremennik Isles) detail.png|You hold aloft the Troll King's head.}}
** '''Player:''' My thanks for the honour you have bestowed upon me, Mawnis Burowgar.
** {{tbox|pic=Decapitated head (The Fremennik Isles) detail.png|You hand the Troll King's head to Mawnis Burowgar.}}
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' As a mark of my gratitude for slaying my nemesis, the foul Troll King, I offer you my helm.
** {{tbox|pic=Helm of Neitiznot detail.png|The Burgher hands you his crown.}}
** '''Player:''' I thank you for presenting me with such a finely crafted helm, sir.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' It makes me proud to know that the helm of my ancestors will be worn in battle.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' I thank you on behalf of all my Kinsmen, [Fremennik name].
** '''Fridleif Shieldson:''' Praise be to our brave Champion.
** '''Thakkrad Sigmundson:''' Hail, Champion [Fremennik name].
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Thakkrad, I believe you have finished repairing the remaining bridge.
** '''Thakkrad Sigmundson:''' That I have sir, we should be able to mine 'runite' once again; now that I have repaired the north-eastern bridge.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Ah, so that is how we compete with the mineral wealth of Jatizso.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Indeed, the wealth of these isles may not be spread evenly, but we certainly make the most of what we have.
** '''Player:''' I look forward to any other tasks you may have for me in the future, Burgher Burowar.{{sic}}
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' My next task is to make peace with the King of Jatizso.
** '''Player:''' I do not think I can help you with that sire. I don't think King Sorvott is speaking with me anymore.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Ah, I see you too have angered King Sorvott IV.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Not to worry, I have my ways of pacifying the King.
** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Fare thee well, my Champion.
** '''Fridleif Shieldson:''' Fare thee well.
** '''Player:''' Fair thee well, kinsmen of Neitiznot.
** {{qact|Congratulations! Quest complete!}}

==Post-quest==
===Talking to Mawnis Burowgar===
* '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' I am proud that the helm of my ancestors will be worn in battle. I thank you on behalf of all my kinsmen, [Fremennik name].
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|I thank you again for presenting me with such a helm.}}
** '''Player:''' I thank you again for presenting me with such a helm.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Have you got any more of those helms?}}
** '''Player:''' Have you got any more of those helms?
** {{tcond|If the player does not have any helms of Neitiznot in their inventory or bank:}}
*** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' What, the priceless heirloom that I gave to you as a sign of my trust and gratitude?
*** '''Player:''' Err yes, that one. I may have mislaid it.
*** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' It's a good job I have alert and loyal men who notice when such a precious item is left laying around, and who pick it up.
*** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' I'm afraid I'm going to have to charge you a 50,000 coin handling cost.
*** {{tact|continue}}
** {{tcond|If the player does have a helm of Neitiznot in their inventory or bank:}}
*** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Well, yes, I do. But I'm going to have to charge you 50,000 coins - these are precious, you know!
*** {{tact|continue}}
** {{tcond|If the player doesn't have 50,000 coins in their inventory:}}
*** '''Player:''' I don't have that much money on me.
*** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Well, come back when you do.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tselect|Select an Option}}
** {{topt|Very well, I accept.}}
*** '''Player:''' Very well, I accept.
*** {{tact|Reclaim interface opens}}
*** {{tcond|If buying 1 helm:}}
**** {{tbox|pic=Helm of Neitiznot detail.png|The Burgher hands you his helm.}}
**** {{tact|end}}
*** {{tcond|If buying more than 1 helm:}}
**** {{tbox|pic=Helm of Neitiznot detail.png|The Burgher hands you [number] helms.}}
**** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|I don't think I can afford that, sorry.}}
*** '''Player:''' I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
*** '''Mawnis Burowgar:''' Well, come back when you can.
*** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to King Sorvott===
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' What are you doing in my court? Guards!
* '''Player:''' I have come to inform you that you may recall your guards; the Troll King was slain by my hand.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Preposterous. Lies, I tell you, lies!
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Yes, your majesty, of course your majesty.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Guards.
* '''Player:''' Guards! Where are your Guards?
* '''Player:''' Oh. Are they still recovering from their defeat against the trolls?
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Outlander, leave me in peace before I am forced to bear arms against you myself.
* '''Player:''' Very well, your Highness, I leave you to contemplate this...
* '''Player:'''  Should you have approached me honestly and truthfully, rather than with lies and secrecy,
* '''Player:'''  then it could have been you holding the head of the Troll King aloft today.
* '''King Sorvott IV:''' Be gone with you. I have heard enough of your insults for one day.
* '''Thorkel Silkbeard:''' Thanks, [Fremennik name], you are the first person to stand up to the King's bullying in many a year. Maybe he has learnt something today?
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Trogen or Kjedelig===
* '''Trogen Konungarde/Kjedelig Uppsen:''' Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!
* '''Player:''' It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!
* '''Trogen Konungarde/Kjedelig Uppsen:''' I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.
* '''Player:''' It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Thakkrad===
* '''Thakkrad Sigmundson:''' Thank you for leading the Burgher's militia against the Troll King.
* '''Thakkrad Sigmundson:''' Now that the trolls are leaderless I have repaired the bridge to the central isle for you as best I can.
* '''Player:''' Thanks Thakkrad. Does that mean I have access to the runite ores on that island?
* '''Thakkrad Sigmundson:''' Yes, you should be able to mine runite there if you wish.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Fridleif===
* '''Fridleif Shieldson:''' Congratulations, Champion [Fremennik name]. Thank you for defeating the Troll King.
* {{tact|end}}

content:
{{Transcript|scenery}} King Shayzien VII has ordered a Great Expedition to explore the lands to the west. His Royal Highness is keen to explore and expand the territory of Kourend. We are to gather the brightest minds and bravest warriors from Kourend and form an expedition party. I have requested a team to survey the immediate area to the west. We will need this information to determine the level of danger and scope of the mission. 1,740 - 36 The survey team reports findings of a mountain to the west of their encampment beyond a swampy area. The mountain will be the focus of the expedition. We have appointed Captain Magnus Rimor leader of the party. 1,773 - 36 Following a week of interviewing and selection process, Captain Rimor has selected the remainder of the expedition party. - Doctor B. Crushim
- Lieutenant T. Berlin
- Sergeant H. Garvie
- Corporal R. Edshirt
- Corporal K. Jones 1,780 - 36 Profile - Magnus Rimor
Rank: Captain
City: Shayzien
D.O.B: 312 - 32 Captain Rimor is fearless; he seeks to serve King Shayzien with all of his will. Having completed three expeditions to the Northern Tundras in recent years, he is the bravest soldier and most seasoned explorer we have. Profile - Bev Crushim
Rank: Doctor
City: Hosidius
D.O.B: 3,002 - 31 Doctor Crushim is Kourend's most renowned field physician having saved the life of the King himself during an excursion last decade. Her expertise in healing and tactical ability will be invaluable to the party. Profile - Thomas Berlin
Rank: Lieutenant
City: Piscarilius
D.O.B: 781 - 33 Though young, Lieutenant Thomas Berlin is the finest navigation officer in the fleet. He was the first officer to sail from Port Piscarilius to the Frozen Tundra of the north and live to tell the tale. Profile - Henno Garvie
Rank: Sergeant
City: Shayzien
D.O.B: 2,127 - 31 Sergeant Garvie is a tactical expert, known for his skills with explosives and a longbow, his scouting skills will be a necessity as the party encounters unknown dangers. Profile - Rytin Edshirt
Rank: Corporal
City: Shayzien
D.O.B: 505 - 33 Corporal Edshirt recently returned from a trek to the north and will serve as a weapons officer on the expedition. Profile - Keith Jones
Rank: Corporal
City: Shayzien
D.O.B: 2,007 - 29 A veteran of the Shayzien Army, Corporal Jones is known for his strength and ability with a longbow. Watch out for Keith. King Shayzien VII has approved the expedition plans. 250 Days to ascend the western mountain and return with details of the findings. Captain Rimor and his party leave at first light! 1,800 - 36

{{transcript|quest}}

Missing Servius' dialogue if completing the quest without meeting the requirements for The Final Dawn.}}
{{Transcript list|Prince Itzla Arkan|Queen Zyanyi Arkan|Bartender (The Windbreaker)|Shopkeeper (Quetzacalli Gorge)|Nova|Caritta|Felius|Sergius|Forebearer Janus|Tenoch|Silia|Adrius|Eleuia|Forebearer Fides|Metzli, Teokan of Ranul|Furia Tullus|Ennius|Forebearer Vulcan|Emissary Acolyte|Amoxliatl|Servius, Teokan of Ralos}}
==Starting the quest==
===Talking to Prince Itzla Arkan===
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Nilsal, [player name].
* '''Player:''' Hey, Itzla. How are things going?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Father should make a full recovery, though given that his would-be killers are still out there, that's not anywhere near as much comfort as it should be.
* {{tcond|If the player does not meet the quest requirements:}}
** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. Once I have, we can start planning our next move.
** {{tbox|You do not meet all of the requirements to start The Heart of Darkness quest.}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player meets the quest requirements:}}
** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. However, in the meantime, I've devised a little plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.
** {{tselect|Start The Heart of Darkness quest?}}
** {{topt|Yes.}}
*** '''Player:''' What is it?
*** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' We're going to go... undercover!
*** '''Player:''' Undercover? What do you mean?
*** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' The Twilight Emissaries of course! If they are the ones responsible for what is now two attempts on my father's life, their deaths will be swift and brutal.
*** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' However, given we're somewhat civilised people, we can't exactly start executing cultists without definitive proof. How do we get that? By joining up of course!
*** '''Player:''' You want us to join the cult?
*** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Exactly! Quite a clever plan, if I do say so myself.
*** '''Player:''' Right...
*** '''Guard:''' Prepare for the arrival of Queen Zyanyi Arkan!
*** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Ah... This should be fun.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|No.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'd love to hear it, but I have some things I need to do first.
*** '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Very well. I'll be here when you're ready.
*** {{tact|end}}

==Meeting with Queen Zyani Arkan to begin planning the infiltration==
* {{qact|A cutscene begins in which Queen Zyani Arkan meets with Prince Itzla Arkan.}}
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Mother.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' As I stand here, the healers toil to save the life of the Teokan of Ralos.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' Why?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' He wished to return to the Teomat. I advised against it, but...
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' So you would blame him?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Not exactly...
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' Then take responsibility. You were charged with rooting out those who would plot against us. You failed. Why?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' With respect, progress has been made. We believe the Twilight Emissaries to be responsible, but we need to obtain proof before we can act.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' How?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' We will infiltrate the cult and gather any information we can. Once we have confirmed their guilt, they will be eradicated.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' We?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' This is a task of upmost{{Sic|Unless intended to be the character's idiolect, the word intended is "utmost".}} importance. I intend to lead the infiltration myself.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' So you would chase glory like it is gold to be hoarded? You are the heir to Varlamore. It is not your place.
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' In Varlamore we lead from the front!
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' You do not lead at all, boy! You command the Knights of Varlamore. Use them!
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' I cannot trust them. We have been infiltrated and our enemies now sit beside us.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' You speak of Metzli?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' It could be more than just her. One of my knights was implicated, but another may have incriminated him.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' Who?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' There have been suspicions directed at Furia and Ennius.
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' Then all the more reason that you exclude yourself. Determine who you can trust and send them on this mission of yours.
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' And if there is no one I can trust?
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' Then you have failed as a leader.
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Mother...
* '''Queen Zyanyi Arkan:''' Now go. You have work to do. I don't expect you to fail me again.
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Yes, my Queen. May the sun light your way.
* {{qact|The cutscene ends and Prince Itzla Arkan returns to The Teomat.}}
* {{tact|continue}}
===Talking to Prince Itzla Arkan after meeting with Queen Zyani Arkan===
* '''Player:''' So...
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' It would seem I won't be able to join you on this mission, iknami. Still, I have no doubt you will be successful all the same.
* '''Player:''' What do I need to do?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Head to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge and ask to rent the basement room. I have a contact who will meet you there.
* '''Player:''' Someone you can trust?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' One of the only people left that I can trust. They'll fill you in on the details of how you'll infiltrate the Emissaries. Good luck, [player name]. May the sun light your way.
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to Itzla again====
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Nilsal, [player name]. You should head on over to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge. Remember, you'll need to rent the basement room. My contact will meet you there.
* '''Player:''' I'll head over there shortly.
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Good luck.
* {{tact|end}}

==Visiting the Windbreaker Bar==
===Talking to the Bartender at Quetzacalli Gorge===
* '''Bartender:''' Welcome to the Windbreaker. We've got the best drinks around.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|quest=no|Let's see what you have.}}
* {{topt|I'd like to rent the basement room.}}
** '''Player:''' I'd like to rent the basement room.
** {{tcond|If the player is asking about the basement room for the first time:}}
*** '''Bartender:''' We don't have a basement room... but I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.
*** {{tact|continue}}
** {{tcond|If the player is asking about the basement room again:}}
*** '''Bartender:''' Like I said, we don't have a basement room. However, I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.
*** {{tact|continue}}
** {{tcond|If the player does not have enough money:}}
*** '''Player:''' I don't have that much on me right now.
*** '''Bartender:''' Well you know where we are if that changes.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tselect|Select an option}}
** {{topt|I'll take it.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'll take it.
*** {{tbox|pic=Coins_25.png|You give 30 coins to the bartender.}}
*** '''Bartender:''' Thank you very much. The room is all yours. Enjoy!
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|That's too much.}}
*** '''Player:''' That's too much.
*** '''Bartender:''' Well you know where we are if you change your mind.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|quest=no|What's with those big gates out there?}}
* {{topt|quest=no|Nothing for me, thanks.}}

===Resting in the bed===
* '''Player:''' Guess I may as well have a little rest while waiting for this contact.
* {{tbox|You lie down on the bed and quickly fall asleep.}}
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Rise and shine!
* '''Player:''' Itzla? Is that you? What are you doing here?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Isn't it obvious? I'm your contact!
* '''Player:''' But... no?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Look, I fully appreciate what my mother said. I have carefully considered her instructions, but in this one very specific situation, I have come to the conclusion that they must be disregarded.
* '''Player:''' But you're the heir to the throne of Varlamore... What if someone recognises you?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Well that's why I've covered my face of course. Simple!
* '''Player:''' This seems like a bad idea...
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' You may well be right, iknami, but that is a bridge we will cross, and then quite possibly burn, when we get to it.
* '''Player:''' Okay...
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' I can see you're still not convinced, so let me be frank. I wasn't lying when I spoke to mother. The number of people we can trust is concerningly low.
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' Metzli, one of the most important people in the entire kingdom, has seemingly betrayed us. If your suspicions are right, Furia and Ennius are guilty as well. For all we know, there could be even more.
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' At this point, the fewer people who know about our mission, the better.
* '''Player:''' But you trust me?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' The irony is, my friend, that as an outsider, you're actually far more trustworthy than any Varlamorian now. You almost certainly can't be part of this conspiracy.
* '''Player:''' Okay, I'm still not sure if I like this plan, but I see your point. What's our next move?
* '''Prince Itzla Arkan:''' We need to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries and confirm their guilt. I've done some digging, and rumour has it that they're on a bit of a recruitment spree at the moment. That's our way in.
